paper.title: The Evolution of Mixture-of-Experts Architectures in Large Language Models: Routing, Topology, Load Balancing, and Expert Parallelism
paper.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts models increase parameter capacity while keeping the computation activated by each token bounded, but their architectural evolution cannot be explained by a chronological list of model releases alone. This technical survey synthesizes primary papers, official technical reports, and prior surveys to organize modern Mixture-of-Experts systems along five coupled dimensions: expert granularity, expert topology, routing freedom, the scope of load balancing, and execution structure.

summary.core_problem: 如何用一个结构化框架解释 MoE LLM 架构的演进：不是按年份罗列模型，而是回答“每一次结构变化解决了哪个瓶颈、瓶颈如何迁移”，并把 MoE 的关键设计变量拆成可分析的控制平面（Topology / Routing / Balance / Expert Parallelism）。
summary.importance: 这是一篇技术综述而非新方法论文，对预训练研究的价值在于：把 MoE 的设计空间从“路由算法”扩展成闭环系统（语义路由、负载统计反馈、物理并行与通信约束相互制约），更贴近真实训练中的瓶颈（all-to-all、small GEMM、straggler、capacity factor、expert placement）。如果正在做 MoE 预训练 recipe、稳定性与吞吐优化，这种分层视角能帮助定位问题属于哪一层、该调哪个旋钮。
summary.technical_approach:
文章给出两个核心组织方式：
1) 统一形式化：把 MoE 写成稀疏函数组合，路由决定每个 token 激活的专家集合 K_t，并指出 MoE 同时在优化“总容量 P_total 增长”与“单 token 激活量 P_active 受控”，但这只是近似口径（attention/embedding/shared experts/宽度差异都会影响）。
2) 四个控制平面（闭环）：
- Expert Topology：专家如何组织（粒度、是否 shared experts、层内/层间结构），属于慢变量。
- Routing：token 级离散决策（top-k、路由自由度、可见专家集合），快变量。
- Balance：在统计窗口上聚合负载 n_i，并通过 bias/aux loss/capacity 等反馈调节；强调“负载均衡不等于一个 aux loss”，还包括运行时复制、expert placement 等系统手段。
- Expert Parallelism (EP)：把逻辑路由映射到物理设备与通信调度（π 映射、σ 调度），决定 all-to-all、fan-out、kernel 形状与 straggler。
文章还提出“八个里程碑”用依赖图而非年代序列组织，标准是：引入可独立调的设计变量、迁移主要瓶颈、并被后续继承。并指出两条“分支”分别放松了固定计算预算与语义路由-物理通信绑定等假设。
方法论取舍很明确：不做跨论文能力数字的因果比较（数据/训练设置不一致），而是用瓶颈迁移解释架构选择。
summary.experiments: 综述性质文章，不提供统一可复现的实验主张；文中明确提示能力数字不能跨论文做因果比较。可期待的“证据”主要是对典型系统的结构拆解、瓶颈分析与工程约束总结，而不是新的 benchmark 结果。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 30–45 分钟）：
- 先读 Problem Definition and Analysis Scope：它限定讨论对象（decoder-only、FFN MoE、预训练），并解释为什么不用时间线。
- 精读四控制平面的形式化（Topology/Routing/Balance/EP）以及公式 (5) 的闭环关系，尤其是两类反向依赖：物理拓扑约束语义路由、以及 balance 可通过 placement/replication 改善而不改 K_t。
- “Eight Evolutionary Milestones” 章节适合当索引：按瓶颈迁移去回忆/定位你关心的系统（如 top-k、capacity factor、shared experts、device-limited routing、通信优化）。
如果目标是指导 MoE 预训练落地，阅读时把每个问题映射到四平面之一：是路由不稳、负载 CV 太高、还是 all-to-all/小 GEMM/权重 I/O 才是主瓶颈。

summary_en.core_problem: Provide a structural explanation of how sparse MoE architectures for decoder-only LLM pretraining evolved: identify which bottleneck each architectural change removed and where the bottleneck moved next, instead of listing models chronologically.
summary_en.importance: As a technical survey, its value is in the systems-aware decomposition of MoE design into interacting layers: semantic routing decisions, load-balancing feedback, and physical expert parallel execution are a coupled control loop. This framing is useful for pretraining practitioners because many MoE failures are not “routing-algorithm issues” but EP/all-to-all/straggler/capacity-factor/placement constraints that feed back into routing and specialization.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Two main organizing devices:
1) Unified formalization: MoE as a sparse combination of expert functions where routing selects an expert set K_t per token. The survey highlights the dual objective—grow total capacity while bounding per-token active compute—while noting practical deviations (shared experts, attention/embedding overhead, heterogeneous widths).
2) Four control planes forming a closed loop:
- Expert Topology: expert granularity and structural choices (incl. shared paths), slow-changing.
- Routing: token-level discrete decisions (top-k, routing freedom, visibility constraints).
- Balance: windowed load statistics n_i and feedback knobs (router bias, auxiliary loss strength, capacity), plus non-loss mechanisms like runtime replication and expert placement.
- Expert Parallelism (EP): mapping experts to devices and scheduling communication/compute (all-to-all, fan-out, kernel shapes), which constrains feasible routing.
It also proposes eight “milestones” organized as a dependency graph, with criteria: introduce an independently tunable variable, shift the dominant bottleneck, and be inherited by later systems. The survey explicitly avoids capability-number causal comparisons across papers due to confounders.
summary_en.experiments: No new experimental results; capability numbers are used illustratively and the text cautions against cross-paper causal interpretation. Evidence is primarily architectural case analysis and bottleneck reasoning.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
- Start with the scope section to understand what is included/excluded (decoder-only FFN MoE pretraining).
- Read the four control planes carefully; treat it as a debugging map for MoE training and throughput issues.
- Use the “eight milestones” section as an index to locate design knobs relevant to your setting (top-k, capacity, shared experts, device-limited routing, EP constraints).
When applying it, always ask which plane is the current bottleneck: routing instability, load CV/stragglers, or EP communication/small-GEMM/weight I/O.

recommendation.zh: 作为 MoE 设计空间索引值得扫，重点看四个 control planes；不要把它当新证据。
recommendation.en: Worth skimming as an MoE design-space index; read the four control planes, but do not treat it as new evidence.

paper.title: CoBa: Cost-Effective Test-Time Scaling via Compute-Balanced Routing
paper.abstract: Test-time scaling is often implemented by spending more compute along one axis: sampling more solutions, extending a chain of thought, or applying a stronger evaluator. Under a fixed inference budget, these choices compete. This paper formulates test-time reasoning as a compute-allocation problem in which a system must decide whether the next unit of compute should be spent on generation, verification, or stopping. We introduce CoBa, a compute-balanced routing policy that first obtains a small s

summary.core_problem: 测试时推理的算力分配缺乏统一框架：现有测试时缩放方法（多候选采样、长思维链、强验证器）被当作独立调节旋钮，在固定推理预算下互相挤占算力，无法在生成、验证、停止三类动作间做最优分配。
summary.importance: 分层算力路由的思路可反哺预训练阶段的生成-验证联合设计：一是为测试时算力效率导向的预训练目标设计提供参考，二是为固定总算力约束下生成大模型与验证小模型的容量配比提供量化依据。
summary.technical_approach: 将测试时推理形式化为统一的算力分配问题，动作空间包含生成候选、轻量验证、强验证、停止四类，定义总token成本、参数加权token成本两种度量（后者按模型参数量缩放token成本，反映不同规模模型的算力差异）。提出分阶段路由策略：先用少量固定预算生成少量候选保证多样性，再用轻量验证（答案频次+小模型裁判分）给所有候选打分，基于分数决定停止、继续采样、还是将高不确定性候选路由到更强的验证器。最终排序分结合答案频次、轻量验证分、可选过程验证分、强验证分，未路由到强验证的候选不会因缺失对应分数被人为惩罚或加分。设置三个变体覆盖不同成本区间：Light版（2个候选+轻量验证）、Routed版（最多4个候选+2个送强验证）、Routed-Strong版（最多8个候选+4个送强验证）。
summary.experiments: 使用Qwen3-14B、Phi-4-reasoning、Qwen3-8B作为生成器和验证器，在MATH-500、AIME 2024/2025、AMC 2023、程序符号推理共3129个示例-生成器评估对上测试。CoBa-Routed-Strong达到85.13%的宏观准确率，与best-of-16采样、自评估加权投票的准确率相当，但参数加权算力成本更低。所有对比基于离线预生成的16候选池做受控回放，保证公平性。
summary.reading_guide: 先读第2节问题形式化部分，理解统一算力分配框架的定义和两种成本度量的设计逻辑；再读第3节方法部分，重点看分阶段路由的决策流程和三个变体的配置；实验部分重点关注成本-准确率帕累托前沿的对比结果。预计阅读时间20-25分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Test-time reasoning scaling strategies (multi-candidate sampling, extended chain-of-thought, strong verifiers) are treated as independent tuning knobs that compete for fixed inference compute, with no unified framework to optimally allocate resources across generation, verification, and stopping actions.
summary_en.importance: The tiered compute routing principle informs joint generator-verifier co-design in pretraining: it provides a reference for test-time efficiency-oriented pretraining objective design, and offers quantitative guidance for capacity splitting between large generator models and small verifier models under fixed total compute budgets.
summary_en.technical_approach: CoBa formulates test-time reasoning as a unified compute allocation problem with four action types: candidate generation, lightweight verification, strong verification, and stopping. Two cost metrics are defined: total token cost (sum of input and output tokens across all model calls) and parameter-weighted token cost (tokens scaled by model parameter count to reflect relative compute of different model sizes). The staged routing policy first uses a small fixed warm-up budget to generate a diverse candidate pool, then scores all candidates with cheap verification (answer frequency + small model judge scores). Based on these scores, the system decides to stop, sample more candidates, or route high-uncertainty candidates to stronger verifiers. The final ranking score combines answer frequency, lightweight judge scores, optional process verifier scores, and strong verifier scores; unrouted candidates are not artificially penalized or boosted by missing strong verification signals. Three variants trace a cost-accuracy curve: CoBa-Routed-Light (2 candidates + lightweight verification), CoBa-Routed (max 4 candidates + 2 routed to strong verification), and CoBa-Routed-Strong (max 8 candidates + 4 routed to strong verification).
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on 3,129 example-generator pairs across MATH-500, AIME 2024/2025, AMC 2023, and procedural symbolic reasoning, using Qwen3-14B, Phi-4-reasoning, and Qwen3-8B as generators and verifiers. CoBa-Routed-Strong reaches 85.13% macro accuracy, matching the performance of best-of-16 sampling and self-evaluation weighted voting, with lower parameter-weighted compute cost. All comparisons use controlled replay on pre-generated 16-candidate pools for fair evaluation.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with Section 2 (problem formulation) to understand the unified compute allocation framework and cost metric definitions. Then read Section 3 for the staged routing logic and variant configurations. For experiments, focus on the cost-accuracy Pareto frontier comparisons. Estimated reading time: 20-25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: test-time scaling的算力分配问题被干净地形式化了，路由策略值得在内部推理服务复现；重点看§3的分配公式和Table 2的token节省
recommendation.en: Clean formulation of compute allocation in test-time scaling; the routing policy is worth reproducing in internal inference serving—focus on §3 allocation and Table 2 token savings.

paper.title: EntropyMoE: Entropy-Aware Sparse Expert Routing for Tokenizer-Free LLMs
paper.abstract: Recent byte-level large language models (LLMs) have made tokenizer-free modeling increasingly competitive by grouping bytes into dynamically sized patches. However, existing byte-patch architectures still apply the same dense feed-forward computation to every patch. This uniform computation cannot adapt model capacity to variations in patch semantics and granularity. We address this limitation with EntropyMoE, a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture designed for dynamic byte patches. EntropyMoE

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 tokenizer-free LLM 中动态 byte patch 已经按预测不确定性调节粒度，但后续 Transformer 仍对所有 patch 使用同一套 dense FFN 计算的问题。作者想验证：BLT patcher 已经计算出的 next-byte entropy，能否同时作为 MoE 路由信号，用更低成本组织稀疏专家计算。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在两个点。第一，tokenizer-free 路线不只是在输入表示上绕开 BPE，还会改变条件计算的基本单位：路由对象从 token 变成变长 byte patch。第二，论文把“patch 粒度”“专家选择”“负载统计”拆开处理：entropy 决定路由，patcher 决定粒度，byte coverage 决定 workload accounting。这比直接把常规 MoE 搬到 BLT 上更干净。贡献量级偏探索性，不足以证明 tokenizer-free MoE 的明确 scaling 优势，但给出了一个可复现实验设置，说明低维不确定性信号有可能比 hidden-state router 更适合作为 byte-patch MoE 的路由坐标。
summary.technical_approach: EntropyMoE 基于 BLT 风格的 byte-patch pipeline。BLT 先用 next-byte entropy 决定 patch 边界：低不确定性区域形成更长 patch，高不确定性区域切成更短 patch。论文将 global patch Transformer 中的 dense FFN 替换为 Top-2 MoE 层，每个动态 patch 是一个路由单元。关键设计是 router 不看 patch hidden state，只使用该 patch 的标量 entropy，通过每个 expert 一个 slope 和 bias 的仿射变换得到 expert logits。hidden state 仍作为被选中 FFN expert 的输入，因此语义信息没有从专家计算中移除，只是不参与专家选择。作者没有让高 entropy patch 激活更多专家；每个有效 patch 固定激活 2 个 expert。计算自适应来自 patcher 的粒度变化，而不是 Top-K 的动态变化。负载统计按 patch 覆盖的 byte 数加权，而不是简单按 patch 个数计数，这一点适配了变长 patch。与 Hidden-only MoE、Hidden+Entropy MoE 相比，EntropyMoE 的区别是去掉高维 hidden-state projection，用一个一维不确定性信号形成路由几何。
summary.experiments: 实验是 continuation-training 风格的受控比较，模型和数据设置围绕 Dense BLT、Hidden-only MoE、Hidden+Entropy MoE 和 EntropyMoE 展开。稀疏模型使用 25 层、每层 8 个 experts、Top-2 激活，并匹配 active parameters、训练数据、更新步数以及 dense-copy 初始化。EntropyMoE 的有效 router 参数量约为 400，而 hidden-state router 对照超过 4×10^5，减少约三个数量级。主要结果是 EntropyMoE 取得最低 held-out bits per byte；Hidden-only 和 Hidden+Entropy MoE 接近 dense baseline，说明“有专家容量”本身不能解释收益。作者还用第二个 continuation-training seed 复现了 EntropyMoE 相对 Hidden-only MoE 的优势。下游任务上没有一致提升，较明确的正向结果主要出现在 HellaSwag。消融上，byte-weighted accounting 在两个 seed 上都优于 patch-count accounting。路由分析显示 EntropyMoE 对低 entropy 和高 entropy patch 的 assignment distribution 分离更清楚，但专家使用集中在少数 expert 上，说明还不能证明 learned expert identity 是不可替代的。效率上，EntropyMoE 在稀疏模型中 iteration time 和 valid-byte throughput 最好，但由于 dispatch、通信和内存移动，仍慢于 Dense BLT。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20 到 30 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对 BLT patching、entropy 和 MoE routing 的拆分，这是论文最有用的概念部分。然后看 Method 里 router 公式、Top-2 选择、byte-weighted load accounting，这些决定了它不是普通 MoE 的简单替换。实验部分重点看 Dense BLT、Hidden-only、Hidden+Entropy、EntropyMoE 的受控比较表，以及 byte-weighted vs patch-count 的消融。路由分布图也值得看，因为它能判断 entropy router 是真的形成了不同专家路径，还是只是在少数专家上塌缩。可以略读下游 benchmark，那里更多说明收益边界，而不是主要贡献。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether a tokenizer-free LM should also make its sparse computation tokenizer-free in structure. BLT-style models already use next-byte entropy to form variable-length byte patches, but the global patch Transformer still applies the same dense FFN computation to every patch. EntropyMoE tests whether that same entropy signal can serve as the routing coordinate for MoE layers.
summary_en.importance: The useful contribution is not just adding MoE to a byte-level model. It clarifies how conditional computation changes when the routed unit is a variable-length byte patch rather than a fixed tokenizer token. The paper separates three roles that are often entangled: patching controls computational granularity, entropy controls expert selection, and byte coverage controls load accounting. This is a relevant design point for tokenizer-free pretraining. The evidence is still exploratory and continuation-training based, so it should not be read as a compute-matched argument against dense BLT. Its value is in showing that a low-dimensional uncertainty signal can be a stronger router than a high-dimensional hidden-state projection under this setup.
summary_en.technical_approach: EntropyMoE starts from a BLT-like byte-patch pipeline. The patcher uses next-byte entropy to create longer patches in predictable regions and shorter patches in uncertain regions. The dense FFN blocks in the global patch Transformer are replaced with Top-2 MoE layers, and each dynamic patch is routed as one unit. The central design choice is that the router only consumes the scalar entropy assigned to the patch. For each expert, a learned slope and bias map this scalar to a routing logit. The patch hidden state is deliberately excluded from expert selection, but it remains the input to the selected experts. The model therefore uses uncertainty for path selection while preserving semantic and contextual information inside expert computation. Every valid patch activates exactly two experts; the number of active experts does not grow with entropy. Byte length is used for workload accounting, which matters because patches cover different numbers of bytes.
summary_en.experiments: The controlled comparisons include Dense BLT, Hidden-only MoE, Hidden+Entropy MoE, and EntropyMoE, with matched data, updates, active parameters, and dense-copy initialization. The sparse setup uses 25 layers, 8 experts per layer, and Top-2 routing. The entropy-only router has about 400 effective routing parameters, compared with more than 4×10^5 parameters for hidden-state routing controls. EntropyMoE obtains the lowest held-out bits per byte, while the hidden-state MoE variants stay close to the dense baseline despite having the same expert pool and active capacity. The advantage over Hidden-only MoE is reproduced with a second continuation-training seed. Downstream accuracy is broadly similar; the clearest supported gain is on HellaSwag rather than a uniform task-level improvement. Byte-weighted accounting improves BPB over patch-count accounting in both tested seeds. Routing analysis shows clearer separation between low- and high-entropy patch assignments, but also concentration on a small subset of experts. Among sparse variants it has the best iteration time and valid-byte throughput, although sparse execution remains slower than Dense BLT because of dispatch, communication, and memory movement.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20 to 30 minutes. Focus first on the introduction where the authors distinguish patch granularity, routing, and byte-level workload. Then read the method details for the entropy-only affine router, Top-2 expert selection, and byte-weighted load accounting. The most informative experiments are the controlled comparisons against Hidden-only and Hidden+Entropy MoE, plus the accounting ablation. The routing distribution plots are worth checking because they reveal whether entropy creates meaningful expert pathways or merely concentrates traffic. The downstream benchmark table is secondary; it mainly helps bound the claim.

recommendation.zh: 只看 entropy 路由与负载计量的消融；若结果干净，值得在 byte-level MoE 内部实验复现。
recommendation.en: Read the entropy-routing and workload-accounting ablations; if clean, this is worth reproducing in an internal byte-level MoE setup.

paper.title: Routing Is Least Learnable Where It Is Most Valuable: Bounds on Representation Routing for Web Agents
paper.abstract: Web agents observe a browser through text, pixels, or both, and the choice is usually fixed once for all tasks. We measure six observation modes across eight site-model combinations (cells) on VisualWebArena and WebArena and ask what choosing per task would buy. The modes are complementary: each solves tasks the others miss, they fail in structurally different ways, and the best choice reverses between task sets. The obvious prize, an oracle that picks a winning mode for every task, looks large

summary.core_problem: 解决 web agent 中 observation mode（文本、像素或多模态）应否按任务动态路由，以及这种路由在真实噪声下是否真的值得学的问题。
summary.importance: 这篇工作的价值不在提出更强 agent，而在把 web agent 常见的“按任务选表示”设想拆开测量，指出 oracle 增益常被运行噪声高估，并给出更现实的成本边界。
summary.technical_approach: 作者在 VisualWebArena 和 WebArena 上系统比较六种 observation mode、八个 site-model 组合，先测模式互补性，再估计 per-task oracle 的理论收益，并显式量化 run-to-run noise。随后测试五种 routing policy，包括基于任务文本的零成本规则、confidence cascade 等，分析何时值得把任务送到更强但更贵的模式。
summary.experiments: 核心实验发现：同一 mode 在同一任务上重复运行会带来 12-14% 的结果变化，因此 naive oracle 对动态路由收益的估计偏乐观；在 8/8 个 cell 中，把只有当前 mode 解决不了的任务送到最便宜的补充 mode，可在成功率不变下节省 9.5-30.6% 成本。工作主要基于 WebArena/VisualWebArena，属于 agent 系统分析而非预训练实验。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 UCL 与 Holistic AI。

summary_en.core_problem: It asks whether web agents should dynamically route between text, pixel, or multimodal observation modes per task, and whether such routing is actually learnable and worthwhile under realistic noise.
summary_en.importance: The value is not a stronger agent but a cleaner measurement study: it shows that oracle gains from per-task routing are often inflated by run-to-run variance, and derives a more realistic cost bound.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper compares six observation modes across eight site-model cells on VisualWebArena and WebArena, measuring complementarity, estimating per-task oracle gains, and explicitly quantifying run-to-run noise. It then evaluates five routing policies, including a zero-cost rule from task text and confidence cascades, to study when expensive modes are worth invoking.
summary_en.experiments: A key result is that rerunning the same mode on the same tasks changes outcomes by 12-14%, which makes naive oracle estimates overly optimistic. In all 8/8 cells, sending only tasks unsolved by one mode to the cheapest complementary mode reduces cost by 9.5-30.6% at unchanged success. This is an agent systems analysis, not a pretraining study.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from UCL and Holistic AI.

recommendation.zh: 对 pretrain 不直接，但它提醒一个常被忽略的坑：agent 路由收益很容易被评测噪声吹大；只看噪声分析和 cost bound 即可。
recommendation.en: Not directly about pretraining, but it nails an easy-to-miss issue: routing gains in agents are often overstated by evaluation noise; read the noise analysis and cost-bound sections only.

paper.title: SpecDrop: Parameter-Free Category-Conditioned Routing for Modular Specialization
paper.abstract: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) networks pursue specialization through learned routers, gates, and load-balancing losses, yet at matched total-parameter budgets learned routers can underperform equal-weight No-Routing baselines. Is the bottleneck the routing algorithm, or the alignment between training-signal granularity and the target categories? We probe the question with SpecDrop, a fixed parameter-free routing scheme: each of $K$ branches receives weight $p_a$ for its assigned category and a small

summary.core_problem: 这篇文章研究的是模块化网络里一个常被混在一起的问题：专家是否能学出真正的 specialization，究竟取决于路由器本身，还是取决于训练信号与划分类别之间是否对齐。作者的结论很明确：在很多场景里，瓶颈不在 learned router，而在 partition granularity 和 category clarity。也就是说，如果每个训练样本天然对应一个清晰类别，哪怕不用可学习路由，只用固定的按类 dropout，也能诱导出模块分工；如果样本本身跨域、跨技能、标签模糊，换更复杂的 router 也未必有用。
summary.importance: 对 LLM 预训练的直接启发有限，但对 MoE/模块化 specialization 的研究有一个值得记住的负面结果：不要把专家不专门化简单归咎于 router 学得不好。对于语言建模，token、sequence、document 往往天然是 fuzzy partition，一个样本同时含多主题、多技能、多风格，因此 vision 里那种按单标签类别路由的收益未必能迁移到 LM。这个结论对做 domain-aware MoE、data-aware routing、instruction-specialized adapter 的人有参考价值：如果监督标签与训练单元不对齐，增加路由复杂度可能只是增加系统负担，而不会带来稳定 specialization。它更像一篇机制澄清论文，而不是能直接搬进大规模 pretrain recipe 的方法论文。
summary.technical_approach: SpecDrop 的设计很简单，也正因为简单，实验归因更干净。模型由 shared stem、K 个并行模块和 shared head 组成。作者先定义类别到模块的固定 assignment matrix，最简单是 round-robin，把 M 个类别均匀分给 K 个模块。训练时，对属于类别 c 的样本，其被分配模块以较高 keep probability p_a 激活，其他模块以较小 leakage probability p_i 激活，不是硬路由，因此仍保留少量跨类共享梯度。多个分支输出通过一个与类别无关的固定分母 S 做归一化合并，作者给出这个 fixed denominator 的性质：它让训练和测试的前向期望一致，并把 merged branch 的量级校准到单分支尺度，避免因为 dropout 采样导致幅度漂移。还可以加一个 always-on shared expert，承担通用表示。整个方法没有 learned routing parameter，也没有 load-balancing loss。作者的核心论证不是“固定路由优于 learned routing”，而是用一个几乎最小化设计的 routing scheme 去隔离变量：如果连这种无参数方案在清晰类别划分上都能学出 specialization，而在模糊划分上不能，那么问题更可能出在 partition alignment，而不是 router sophistication。文中还设计了 information-matched masking control：给 dense model 同样的类别标签信息，只在输出侧做掩码控制，用来区分“标签本身带来的性能增益”和“通过路由诱导模块结构带来的额外作用”。这个对照做得比较到位。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖四个设置，横跨 vision 和 language。结果最强的是对齐良好的视觉分类：在 CIFAR-100 和 ImageNet-1K 的 superclass 划分上，SpecDrop 明显优于不使用标签的参数匹配基线。摘要给出的数字是：CIFAR-100 上相对 dense 提升 +4.75 个 top-1 点；ImageNet-1K 上相对 matched No-Routing+SE 提升 +6.53 点，并且在作者评测的多分支 routing baseline 中最好。与此同时，作者用 information-matched masking control 说明，如果目标只是分类精度，直接把标签信息用于 dense 输出掩码往往更强；SpecDrop 的价值不在“更会用标签”，而在“把标签转成训练出来的模块结构”。到了 fuzzy partition 的 NLP 设定，结论反过来：在 SlimPajama-6B 语言建模和基于 Llama-3.2-1B 的 SuperNI/LoRA 指令微调上，SpecDrop 与匹配架构基线基本持平，落在 seed noise 范围内，没有稳定收益。这一点很重要，因为它直接限制了方法对 LLM 预训练的外推。换句话说，文章最有信息量的结果不是视觉上的正增益，而是语言上的“没有明显增益”，并且作者把原因归到训练单元的类别模糊性，而不是实现细节不足。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1，理解作者为什么把问题从“router 设计”转向“partition alignment”。然后看 Method 里的 assignment matrix、p_a/p_i dropout、fixed denominator S，这三处足够把方法吃透。实验部分重点看两类对照：一类是 aligned vision vs fuzzy NLP 的分裂结果，另一类是 information-matched masking control，它决定你如何解读性能来源。若你做 MoE 或 domain routing，预计 20 到 30 分钟能读完主线。若你做 LLM pretrain，只需要把语言实验和作者对 fuzzy partition 的解释看清楚，不必在视觉细节上停太久。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a clean question about modular specialization: when experts fail to specialize, is the problem the routing algorithm, or the granularity and clarity of the partition used to supervise specialization? The main answer is that partition alignment matters more than router sophistication. If each training unit carries a clean category label, even a fixed parameter-free routing rule can induce specialization. If the training unit is intrinsically mixed or fuzzy, better routers do not buy much.
summary_en.importance: The direct impact on LLM pretraining is limited, but the paper is useful as a cautionary result for MoE and modular design. It argues against a common reflex: blaming weak specialization on the learned router alone. In language modeling, tokens, sequences, and documents are often fuzzy mixtures of topics, skills, and styles, so the clean single-category assumptions that help in vision may not transfer. For work on domain-aware MoE, data-aware routing, or instruction-specialized adapters, the practical lesson is that routing complexity cannot compensate for poorly aligned supervision. This is more of a mechanism-clarification paper than a recipe paper for large-scale pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: SpecDrop is intentionally simple. The model has a shared stem, K parallel modules, and a shared head. Categories are assigned to modules through a fixed assignment matrix, implemented in the simplest case by round-robin mapping from M categories to K modules. During training, for an example with category c, the assigned module is kept with high probability p_a, while all other modules are kept with a small leakage probability p_i. So this is not hard routing; some cross-category gradient sharing remains. The branch outputs are merged using a category-independent fixed denominator S. The paper argues that this denominator makes train and test forward passes match in expectation and keeps the merged activation scale calibrated to the single-branch scale, avoiding magnitude drift from stochastic dropout. An optional always-on shared expert can capture general features. There are no learned routing parameters and no auxiliary load-balancing losses. The point is not that fixed routing is universally better than learned routing. The point is to isolate the variable: if a minimal parameter-free routing scheme already works on clean partitions and fails on fuzzy ones, then the bottleneck is likely partition alignment rather than router design. A strong part of the paper is the information-matched masking control, where the same category label is given to a dense model through output masking. This separates the value of label information itself from the value of turning that information into modular structure.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments span four settings across vision and language. The strongest positive results appear in aligned vision partitions. On CIFAR-100 and ImageNet-1K with superclass labels, SpecDrop clearly outperforms parameter-matched baselines that do not use the category label. The abstract reports +4.75 top-1 over dense on CIFAR-100 and +6.53 over matched No-Routing+SE on ImageNet-1K, while also leading the multi-branch routing baselines evaluated by the authors. At the same time, the information-matched masking control shows that if the only goal is accuracy, directly using the label to mask a dense model can be even stronger. SpecDrop’s contribution is therefore not superior label usage per se, but the induction of trained modular structure. The language results are the more important constraint. On fuzzy partitions in SlimPajama-6B language modeling and SuperNI/LoRA instruction tuning over Llama-3.2-1B, SpecDrop is essentially tied with matched-architecture baselines within seed noise. That negative result is central: it limits how far the method can be extrapolated to LLM pretraining and supports the paper’s claim that partition clarity, not router complexity, is the binding condition.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction and Figure 1, because they reframe the problem from router design to partition alignment. Then read the method section just far enough to understand the assignment matrix, the p_a/p_i category-conditioned dropout, and the fixed denominator S. Those three pieces are the whole method. In the experiments, focus on two comparisons: aligned vision versus fuzzy NLP, and SpecDrop versus the information-matched masking control. Those are what determine the correct interpretation of the gains. If you work on MoE or routing, 20–30 minutes is enough to get the main message. If your focus is LLM pretraining, the language experiments and the discussion of fuzzy partitions are the parts that matter most.

recommendation.zh: 结论在 CV 小模型且需推理时给标签，外推到语言 MoE 很弱；但“无参数路由打赢 learned gating”值得做个内部 ablation。
recommendation.en: Results are on small vision models and require labels at inference, so extrapolation to language MoE is weak; still worth a quick ablation on internal setups.

paper.title: Elbow-Based MoE Routing: A Training-Free Inference Time Plugin for Expert Selection
paper.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models enable model scaling while maintaining low inference-time compute by activating only a subset of experts per token. However, conventional routing relies on a fixed top-k selection, forcing the model to spend the same compute regardless of how many experts are relevant. We introduce elbow-based routing, a training-free inference-time modification that dynamically adjusts the number of experts on a per-token basis. Our method examines the sorted router probability d

summary.core_problem: MoE模型传统固定top-k路由机制不区分token的专家需求度——部分仅需少量专家的token浪费算力，而需要更多专家的token可能被分配不足；现有动态路由方案均需要重新训练或超参数搜索，成本高且无法直接复用已训练完成的MoE checkpoint。
summary.importance: 提出了首个无需训练、无需额外超参数的MoE动态路由插件，可直接部署于已训练完成的MoE模型，在不损失精度的前提下降低推理延迟，为MoE推理优化提供了轻量可落地的新路径。
summary.technical_approach: 对每个token的路由概率做降序排序，使用Kneedle算法识别概率曲线的肘点（即快速衰减的头部过渡到平坦尾部的拐点），将肘点作为该token的动态激活专家数，上限为原模型的固定top-K值；该方法仅裁剪原top-K中的低概率专家，不改变专家排序或引入新路径，从信号-噪声分解角度解释：高概率头部对应与输入相关的信号专家，平坦尾部对应正交残差驱动的噪声专家，肘点即为二者的分界。
summary.experiments: 在OLMoE模型上测试，覆盖MMLU、ARC-Easy、ARC-Challenge、HellaSwag、PIQA、WinoGrande六个基准；分析超过200万条路由概率曲线，99.7%存在清晰的尖锐肘点，且肘点分布跨数据集、跨层、跨学科主题一致；随机替换肘点后的低概率专家不影响精度，替换肘点前的专家则精度显著下降；最终实现平均5.3%的推理延迟降低，同时保持精度与专家负载平衡。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看第2节的肘点检测算法和信号-噪声解释，图2的尾部分布随机化实验和图3的肘点分布统计；预计阅读时间15-20分钟，适合快速了解MoE推理侧的无训练优化思路。

summary_en.core_problem: Conventional fixed top-k routing in Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models applies uniform expert allocation across all tokens, wasting compute on tokens that only need a small number of relevant experts while potentially under-provisioning tokens that require more. Existing dynamic routing methods all require retraining, auxiliary losses, or expensive hyperparameter grid search, limiting their deployability on finished pretrained MoE checkpoints.
summary_en.importance: This work introduces the first training-free, hyperparameter-free dynamic routing plugin for MoE models that can be directly applied to existing checkpoints. It delivers measurable latency reduction without accuracy loss, providing a lightweight, production-ready path for MoE inference optimization.
summary_en.technical_approach: For each token, router probabilities are sorted in descending order. A Kneedle-style algorithm detects the elbow point on the sorted probability curve — the inflection point where the rapidly decaying high-probability head transitions to a flat low-probability tail. The number of active experts for the token is set to the minimum of the elbow index and the model's original fixed top-K value. The method only prunes low-probability experts from the original top-K set, preserving expert ordering and introducing no new routing paths. A signal-noise decomposition framework explains the approach: high-probability head experts correspond to signal aligned with input-relevant routing directions, while flat tail experts reflect noise from orthogonal residual variation, with the elbow marking the boundary between the two.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluations are conducted on the OLMoE model across six benchmarks: MMLU, ARC-Easy, ARC-Challenge, HellaSwag, PIQA, and WinoGrande. Analysis of over 2 million router probability curves shows 99.7% have clear, sharp elbows, with elbow distributions consistent across datasets, router layers, and MMLU subject categories. Randomly replacing post-elbow low-probability experts has no measurable impact on accuracy, while replacing pre-elbow experts causes significant accuracy drops. The method achieves an average 5.3% inference latency reduction while preserving full benchmark accuracy and expert load balance.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 2 for the elbow detection algorithm and signal-noise interpretation, Figure 2 for the tail randomization validation experiment, and Figure 3 for elbow distribution statistics. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes. It is suitable for a quick overview of training-free MoE inference optimization strategies.

recommendation.zh: 只看路由分布分析和 latency setup；5.3% 不大，但 training-free，值得放进 MoE serving 消融。
recommendation.en: Read the router-distribution analysis and latency setup; 5.3% is modest, but the training-free nature makes it worth a MoE serving ablation.

paper.title: EASy: Towards Efficient LLM-Based Agentic System
paper.abstract: Agentic systems have emerged as a promising paradigm for solving complex tasks by coordinating specialized LLM-based agents. However, most existing systems primarily optimize task success while giving limited consideration to execution efficiency under practical constraints such as executor capability and computational cost. Existing router-based methods have limited ability to reason over rich, evolving task contexts, multi-step dependencies, and intermediate execution feedback, and often gener

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是异构 LLM agent 系统里的一个老问题：如何让 orchestrator 不只追求任务成功率，还能在真实约束下同时考虑执行器能力、调用成本、延迟和中间反馈，学会做动态、分阶段、可泛化的调度决策。现有 router 往往是轻量分类器或打分器，适合单步分发，不擅长处理长程依赖、任务分解、并行执行和执行后再规划；固定工作流则更难适应任务过程中不断变化的上下文。EASy 把这个问题表述成一个可训练的 sequential decision problem：给定一组能力和成本不同的 executors，由 LLM orchestrator 在 milestone 级别做分解、规划、分配和重规划，并用强化学习直接优化性能与效率的折中。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练本身，它不是直接的 pretrain recipe 论文；但对 pretrain↔posttrain 接口有现实意义。第一，它把“模型能力”与“系统级成本”放进同一个训练目标里，这和近来 RLVR、test-time compute allocation、mixture routing 的研究方向是连着的。第二，它说明如果要让 LLM 学会资源感知决策，仅靠静态 prompt 或外部 router 不够，训练信号需要覆盖中间状态、分支策略和不完整轨迹。第三，它提供了一种把 executor profile 显式写入上下文、再通过 RL 学习泛化到未见执行器的做法，这对未来的 model routing、tool routing、MoE-style external expert selection 都有参考价值。贡献量级更像系统训练范式上的扎实推进，而不是改变基座建模范式。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心有三层。第一层是 milestone-plan-act 工作流。orchestrator 先把复杂任务拆成若干 milestones，而不是直接细到原子步骤。这样做有两个目的：一是减少低层执行噪声，让策略学习看到更稳定的状态转移；二是给并行执行留空间，因为 milestone 内部可以构建 dependency-aware execution graph，把互不依赖的步骤并发交给不同 executors。第二层是显式 executor profiling。每个 executor 都带有能力描述和成本信息，orchestrator 在决策时不仅看任务内容，也看“谁更强、谁更贵、谁适合当前子任务”。这和传统 router 只基于 query embedding 或历史统计做分发不同，EASy 让调度模型直接在语言上下文里推理 executor 的 profile，因此更容易适应 executor 集合变化。第三层是 end-to-end RL 训练。作者采用 tree-structured rollout，从一个初始轨迹出发，对 milestone 节点或 plan 节点展开替代分支，得到在相近上下文下的多种策略样本。奖励由三部分组成：任务正确性、执行效率、轨迹完整性。前两项对应效果与成本，后一项用于避免策略通过提前终止或局部完成来投机。奖励还做了 node-level 和 query-level normalization，目的是让不同分支、不同任务之间的学习信号可比，降低高方差。和普通单轨迹 RL 相比，这种树状展开更像在局部决策点上做 counterfactual exploration，监督密度更高，也更适合多步 orchestration。
summary.experiments: 全文给出的实验覆盖三类任务：数学推理、具身决策、deep research。摘要明确声称 EASy 在 performance-efficiency trade-off 上稳定优于现有 agentic baselines，且消融显示 milestone-plan-act、tree rollout、reward design 和对未见 executors 的泛化能力都各自有明显贡献。就论文定位看，关键结果不是单纯最高成功率，而是在相同或更低成本下取得更高任务完成度，或者在相同成功率下显著降低 executor 开销。作者还特别强调了 generalization to unseen executors，这一点比很多只在固定 executor pool 上调 prompt 的系统更有方法价值。当前给出的全文片段没有包含完整表格数字、模型规模、训练步数和具体成本降幅，因此无法安全填写精确数值；但从实验设计可以确认，论文重点看的是 Pareto front，而不是单点 accuracy。读的时候应特别留意：1）效率指标如何定义，是否统一折算为 token cost / latency / API cost；2）tree rollout 的分支深度和扩展策略；3）reward normalization 是否显著改善训练稳定性；4）未见 executor 泛化实验到底是 profile 改写、能力替换，还是新增 executor。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议先抓三处。第一看方法总览图和 milestone-plan-act 的例子，理解它为什么不做 step-level 全细粒度规划。第二看 RL 训练部分，重点是 tree-structured rollout 如何选节点扩展、奖励三项各自怎么定义、normalization 怎么做。第三看主结果图，确认作者比较的是成功率、成本和两者折中，而不是只报一个 aggregate score。预计 25–35 分钟能抓住主线。如果只想判断是否值得深读，优先看 introduction、method overview、reward design、generalization/ablation 四部分。需要带着一点保留：这类 agent orchestration 论文常见问题是 benchmark 依赖较强、成本模型容易任务特定、以及 RL 收益是否来自更强的 search budget 而非更好的 policy。读实验时要主动检查这些点。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a practical orchestration problem in heterogeneous LLM agent systems: how to train an orchestrator that does not optimize only task success, but also reasons over executor capability, cost, latency, intermediate feedback, and changing task context. Existing routers are usually lightweight predictors for one-shot dispatch. They are weak at multi-step dependencies, adaptive replanning, and generalization to unseen executors. EASy formulates orchestration as a trainable sequential decision problem where an LLM orchestrator decomposes a task into milestones, plans dependency-aware execution, assigns executors, and updates decisions based on intermediate outcomes, while reinforcement learning directly optimizes the performance-efficiency trade-off.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, but it matters for the pretrain-to-posttrain interface. First, it puts model capability and system cost into one training objective, which is closely related to current work on RLVR, compute allocation, and routing under resource constraints. Second, it shows that resource-aware decision making is hard to get from prompting or static routers alone; the training signal needs to cover intermediate states, alternative branches, and incomplete trajectories. Third, the explicit use of executor profiles inside the context, combined with RL for generalization to unseen executors, is relevant to future model routing, tool routing, and even external-expert selection in MoE-like systems. The contribution is best read as a solid systems-and-training advance rather than a new base modeling paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has three main components. First is the milestone-plan-act workflow. Instead of planning at the finest step granularity from the start, the orchestrator first decomposes a complex query into milestones. This reduces low-level execution noise and gives the policy a more stable state abstraction. Within each milestone, it builds a dependency-aware execution graph and can run independent steps in parallel across executors. Second is explicit executor profiling. Each executor comes with textual descriptions of capability and cost, so the orchestrator reasons jointly over task requirements and executor profiles rather than routing by query features alone. This differs from standard learned routers that often rely on shallow signals and fixed executor sets. Third is end-to-end RL with tree-structured rollout. Starting from an initial trajectory, the system expands selected milestone or plan nodes into alternative branches, producing multiple strategies under comparable contexts. Rewards combine task correctness, execution efficiency, and trajectory completeness. The completeness term is important because otherwise the policy may exploit partial execution or early stopping. Rewards are normalized at both node and query levels to make signals more comparable across branches and tasks and to reduce variance. Compared with standard single-trajectory RL, this branch-based exploration gives denser supervision around local decision points and is better aligned with multi-step orchestration.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover three task families: mathematical reasoning, embodied decision making, and deep research. The main claim is consistent improvement on the performance-efficiency frontier over prior agentic baselines. The key result is not simply higher success rate, but better task completion at the same or lower cost, or lower executor cost at comparable performance. The paper also emphasizes generalization to unseen executors, which is more informative than evaluations on a fixed executor pool. The provided full-content excerpt does not include the final tables with exact numbers, model sizes, training steps, or cost reductions, so it would be unsafe to invent precise metrics. Still, the experimental structure makes clear what to inspect: how efficiency is measured, whether cost is token-based or latency-based, how deep the rollout tree goes, whether reward normalization stabilizes training, and what “unseen executor” means operationally—new profiles, swapped capabilities, or newly introduced executors.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a quick pass, focus on three parts. First, read the method overview and the milestone-plan-act example to understand why the paper avoids fully atomic planning. Second, read the RL section carefully, especially node expansion in tree rollout, the three reward components, and the normalization scheme. Third, inspect the main result figures to verify that the comparison is really about the Pareto trade-off between performance and cost, not a single blended score. A 25–35 minute skim should be enough to capture the main ideas. If deciding whether it deserves deeper reading, prioritize the introduction, method overview, reward design, and the generalization/ablation sections. Keep a healthy skepticism on three common failure modes in this line of work: benchmark-specific cost models, gains that come from larger search budget rather than a better policy, and weak transfer outside the curated executor pool.

recommendation.zh: 只看 RL reward 和 unseen-executor 实验；若成本记账干净，它可作为 agentic test-time compute 分配的弱基线。
recommendation.en: Read the RL reward and unseen-executor experiments; if the cost accounting is clean, it is a useful weak baseline for agentic test-time compute allocation.

This conditional-computation paradigm has enabled autoregressive language models to scale model capacity without a proportional increase in per-token computation. In diffusion language models (DLMs), however, each denoising forward jointly revisits all token positions despite their sharply different refinement demands, while the default fixed token-choice routing assigns them

summary.core_problem: 扩散语言模型（DLM）的 MoE 推理默认对所有 token 使用固定 top-k 专家选择，但在同一次 denoising forward 中，不同 token 所处的 refinement 状态差异很大——有的还在结构探索阶段，有的已接近确定。固定专家预算造成计算与 refinement 需求错配：低需求 token 浪费专家，高需求 token 预算不足。
summary.importance: 对 diffusion LM 这一非 AR 建模范式的推理效率有实际意义，也触及 MoE 与 DLM 结合时的一个新问题：AR MoE 的可变专家策略以 router score 或全局预算为依据，而 DLM 中 token 是联合迭代精炼的，分配单元应是 token 的 refinement state。论文把这一问题形式化为受约束的 state-wise 分配问题，对后续 DLM-MoE 架构和训练-推理协同设计有参考价值。属于推理优化方向，对 pretrain 本身启发间接。
summary.technical_approach: REFLEX 是 training-free 方法，保留默认 router 学到的专家排序，只改变每个 token 分配到的专家数量。它用两个维度刻画 refinement state：(1) Refinement-Role Budgeting，根据 token 在 block-wise 扩散中的结构角色给出先验分配；(2) Frontier-Guided Expert Reallocation，用 Frontier-Progress Score 衡量 token 向确定状态推进的动态进度，在保持每个 block 总专家预算不变的前提下做粗到细的再分配。与 dMoE（限制每 block 唯一专家数以降加载开销）和 EC-DLM（按 timestep 全局调度专家容量）不同，REFLEX 以 token refinement state 为分配单位，且不改动 router。
summary.experiments: 在 LLaDA-MoE 和 LLaDA2.0-mini 上，针对数学推理和代码 benchmark 评测。相比默认 Fixed TC top-8 routing，REFLEX 平均减少 15% 的 selected expert-token pairs，在多数 benchmark 上保持甚至提升生成质量；与 AR 风格的可变专家路由方法相比，quality-computation 权衡更稳定。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读。建议重点看引言中对 DLM-MoE 与 AR-MoE 推理差异的问题刻画，以及方法部分两个维度（structural role + frontier progress）的定义。实验部分关注 15% 专家削减下的质量保持情况即可。预计 20 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: MoE inference in diffusion language models defaults to fixed top-k expert selection for every token, yet within a single denoising forward different tokens occupy very different refinement states — some are still under structural exploration while others are near commitment. A uniform expert budget mismatches compute with refinement demand, wasting experts on low-demand tokens and under-provisioning tokens that still benefit from refinement.
summary_en.importance: Practical for inference efficiency of non-AR diffusion LMs, and it surfaces a genuine new problem at the MoE–DLM intersection: variable-expert strategies for AR MoEs rely on router scores or global budgets, but in DLMs tokens are refined jointly and iteratively, so the natural unit of allocation is the token refinement state. The paper formalizes this as a constrained state-wise allocation problem, which is useful for future DLM-MoE architecture and training–inference co-design. The relevance to pretraining itself is indirect, sitting mainly in inference optimization.
summary_en.technical_approach: REFLEX is training-free and keeps the default router's learned expert ranking; it only changes how many experts each token receives. Refinement state is characterized along two axes: (1) Refinement-Role Budgeting produces a structural prior based on a token's role within block-wise diffusion; (2) Frontier-Guided Expert Reallocation uses a Frontier-Progress Score as dynamic evidence of progress toward commitment and reallocates experts coarse-to-fine while preserving each block's total expert budget. Unlike dMoE (which limits unique experts per block to reduce loading overhead) and EC-DLM (which adapts expert capacity across timesteps via a global schedule and expert-choice routing), REFLEX allocates at the token-refinement-state granularity without modifying the router.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on LLaDA-MoE and LLaDA2.0-mini over mathematical reasoning and coding benchmarks. Relative to default Fixed TC top-8 routing, REFLEX reduces selected expert-token pairs by 15% on average while preserving or improving generation quality on most benchmarks, and yields a more consistent quality–compute trade-off than autoregressive-style variable-expert routing.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim. Focus on the introduction's framing of how DLM-MoE inference differs from AR-MoE, and on the two refinement-state dimensions (structural role and frontier progress) in the method. In experiments, the key takeaway is quality retention at a 15% expert reduction. Estimated 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: DLM+MoE 的推理预算不该照搬 AR；只看方法和预算曲线，值得在内部 DLM ablation 里复现。
recommendation.en: Do not inherit AR-style MoE budgeting for DLMs blindly; the compute-allocation curves are worth reproducing in an internal DLM ablation.

paper.title: From Expert Reduction to Behavioral Divergence: Tracing Numerical State through Sparse MoE Inference
paper.abstract: Mathematically equivalent expert-reduction orders can produce observably different sparse-MoE executions. We isolate this effect in native DeepSeek-V4-Flash by freezing local MoE state and varying only aggregation semantics. Four schemes separate operand representation from accumulator precision. At one layer-5 fork, 720 A-mode orders yield 10 continuation basins; 720 B-mode orders form 360 exact structural classes and 11 basins. Under one Chinese prompt, the B classes split into 202 layoffs, 11

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究的是稀疏 MoE 推理中的一个容易被低估的问题：在专家输出加权求和时，数学上等价的 reduction 顺序，在有限精度实现里并不等价。这个差异不是只停留在最后几位数值误差上。对动态 MoE 解码器来说，小的 hidden state 扰动可能先改变后续 router 的 top-k 选择，再改变 greedy decoding 的下一个 token；即使当前 token 仍然相同，扰动也可能写入 KV/cache 等持久状态，在后续 decode step 延迟触发输出分叉。论文的核心问题是：专家聚合的数值语义是否已经成为 MoE 模型执行语义的一部分，以及应该如何定位、复现和验收这种差异。
summary.importance: 对基座 MoE 研究和工程落地的启发很直接：MoE 的“同权重、同图、同输入”并不自动保证同一行为。专家 aggregation 的 operand 表示、accumulator 精度、reduction topology 都可能改变后续路由和文本轨迹。这个结论影响三类工作。第一，MoE backend qualification 不能只看最终文本是否一致，也要看持久状态、层状态、router 轨迹和 operator 级误差。第二，训练和推理复现需要把数值 contract 写清楚，否则跨 GPU/NPU、跨 kernel、跨并行拓扑的行为差异会被误认为模型随机性或数据问题。第三，对稀疏 MoE 的机制分析也要谨慎，route divergence 可能来自实现细节，而不是输入语义或专家专长本身。
summary.technical_approach: 论文使用 trace-freeze-fork intervention。做法是先在原生 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 推理中记录并冻结局部 MoE 状态，然后只替换专家聚合语义，其他输入、gate、专家输出和后续解码流程保持受控。这样可以把差异归因到 expert reduction，而不是 prompt、sampling、router 或 replay harness。技术上，论文把两个因素拆开：operand representation，即参与求和的专家输出以什么格式表示；accumulator precision，即累加器用什么精度。P32、C、A、B 四种 scheme 用来分离这两个因素，并和 same-mode canonical reference 对齐。A/B 还枚举不同 reduction order，把一个 layer-5 fork 后的 post-mHC 状态映射到 continuation-text basin。这里的 basin 不是概率，也不是部署频率估计，而是“不同内部状态最后压缩到相同 continuation 文本”的等价类。论文还做了两个 state-boundary sufficiency 控制：精确重建 post-mHC endpoint 可以复现同一个 decode forward 内的下游轨迹；精确重建 decode-boundary 的 full persistent state，可以在相同自然生成 next token 下复现跨 token 的分支。这比只比较输出文本更强，因为它证明了被测边界足以承载并传播分叉。
summary.experiments: 关键实验有几组。首先，native-reference replay 覆盖 13 个 prompts，所有 replay 都保持原始 route trajectory、greedy token sequence 和生成文本一致，且 c_moe_max_abs = 0。这排除了 replay 工具本身引入差异的可能。其次，在“why the sheep”的单层实验中，A mode 枚举 720 个 raw permutations，得到 10 个不同 continuation texts；B mode 的 720 个 raw permutations 折叠成 360 个 exact structural classes，得到 11 个不同文本。所有分支的 post-mHC 状态都不同于 native reference：A 为 720/720，B 为 360/360。这个实验没有对每个 branch 都打开 next-router comparison，所以它证明的是 post-mHC 状态和文本 basin 分叉，不是逐分支路由标签。第三，在一个中文 prompt 下，B 的 360 个 structural classes 分成 202 个“layoffs”方向 continuation、113 个“hiring”方向 continuation 和 45 个其他 continuation，说明分叉可以进入语义上可区分的文本区域。第四，使用 maximum-L∞ B-branch selection 做 50-prompt exploratory breadth study，累计文本分离在 8、16、32 token horizon 分别出现在 12、24、36 个 prompts。第五，论文报告在 persistent trajectories 上，P32、A、B 会改变全部 192 条 native-reference route trajectories，而 C 在评估状态和 schedule 上稳定，并保持 native-reference 行为。最后，post-mHC endpoint reconstruction 和 full persistent state reconstruction 两个控制实验分别验证了 intra-token 和跨 decode-step 的可复现分支。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读 Introduction 里的三个研究问题，尤其是 routing boundary、token argmax boundary、persistent state boundary 的区分。这是全文最重要的概念框架。然后读 P32/C/A/B ablation 的方法部分，重点看作者如何把 operand representation 和 accumulator precision 拆开；这个设计决定了结论是否能归因到 reduction semantics。结果部分建议重点看 layer-5 fork 的 720-order/360-class basin 表、中文 prompt 的 semantic split、50-prompt breadth study，以及 192 route trajectories 的对照。state-boundary sufficiency 那一节也值得细读，因为它给出了 backend conformance 的分层验收思路：先验 persistent state，再验 layer state，再验 routing，再落到 operator。限制部分也要看。作者明确没有测真实硬件或分布式 runtime 自然产生各类 permutation 的频率，也没有 frozen-route mediation control 和端到端性能测量，因此不应把 basin volume 解读成部署概率。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a concrete numerical-semantics issue in sparse MoE inference: expert aggregation is mathematically permutation-invariant, but finite-precision reductions are not. In a dynamic MoE decoder, a small hidden-state perturbation can cross a later router top-k boundary, change the selected expert subgraph, and eventually change greedy token selection. Even when the current token remains unchanged, the perturbation can be written into persistent attention state and surface several decode steps later. The central question is whether expert reduction order has become part of the model’s effective execution semantics, and how such differences should be traced, replayed, and qualified.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly about MoE reproducibility, backend compatibility, and numerical contracts. It shows that identical weights, graph structure, gates, and inputs do not necessarily imply identical behavior if expert aggregation semantics differ. This matters for pretraining-scale MoE work because training, evaluation, checkpoint conversion, and inference backends often change kernels, accumulation precision, or parallel reduction topology. A backend qualification procedure that only checks final generated text can miss internal divergence. The paper argues for conformance checks at multiple boundaries: persistent state, layer state, routing, and operator execution.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method is a trace-freeze-fork intervention on native DeepSeek-V4-Flash. The authors first validate deterministic replay of the native reference, then freeze the local MoE state and vary only aggregation semantics. This isolates reduction effects from prompt handling, sampling, router changes, or replay bugs. The paper separates operand representation from accumulator precision through four schemes, P32, C, A, and B, and compares each scheme against a same-mode canonical reference. A and B enumerate reduction orders and map post-mHC states to continuation-text basins. These basins are equivalence classes of executions that yield the same continuation; they are not deployment probabilities. The paper also validates two replay boundaries. Exact reconstruction at the post-mHC endpoint reproduces the measured downstream trajectory within a decode forward. Exact reconstruction of the full persistent state at a decode boundary reproduces the branch across later token boundaries when the next input token is the same naturally generated token.
summary_en.experiments: The native-reference replay check covers 13 prompts. Every replay preserves the reference route trajectory, greedy token sequence, and generated text, with c_moe_max_abs = 0. In a single-layer fork for the “why the sheep” case, A mode enumerates 720 raw permutations and produces 10 distinct continuation texts. B mode maps 720 raw permutations into 360 exact structural classes and produces 11 distinct texts. Every evaluated branch has a post-mHC state different from the native reference: 720/720 for A and 360/360 for B. The direct next-router comparison was disabled in this sweep, so these counts should be read as state-to-text basin compression rather than per-branch route-divergence labels. For one Chinese prompt, the B structural classes split into 202 layoff continuations, 113 hiring continuations, and 45 other continuations. In a 50-prompt exploratory breadth study using maximum-L∞ B-branch selection, cumulative text separation appears in 12, 24, and 36 prompts by horizons of 8, 16, and 32 tokens. The paper also reports that P32, A, and B alter all 192 native-reference route trajectories in the persistent-trajectory comparison, while C is stable over the evaluated states and schedules and preserves native-reference behavior.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the introduction carefully for the three boundary types: routing, token selection, and persistent state. That framing is the most useful part for MoE systems work. Then focus on the P32/C/A/B ablation design, because it explains how operand format and accumulation precision are separated. In the results, the key items are the layer-5 fork enumeration, the 720-order and 360-class basin counts, the Chinese-prompt semantic split, the 50-prompt breadth study, and the route-trajectory comparison. The state-boundary reconstruction experiments are also worth close reading; they provide a practical template for hierarchical backend conformance tests. The limitations are important: the paper does not estimate how often real GPU, NPU, or distributed runtimes realize each permutation, and it does not include frozen-route mediation or end-to-end performance measurements.

recommendation.zh: 生产MoE上精确隔离浮点reduction顺序对路由/输出的放大效应，C方案bitwise复现是硬结果，立即纳入内部MoE精度ablation。
recommendation.en: Clean isolation of how floating-point reduction order amplifies into routing and text divergence in a production MoE; the bitwise-matching C scheme is a hard result worth immediate internal ablation.

paper.title: UniMem: Complementary Episodic-to-Parametric Memory for Boundary-Agnostic Task Streams
paper.abstract: Memory is essential for LLM agents to accumulate task experience and reuse task-specific execution strategies. However, real-world deployment over boundary-agnostic and evolving task streams exposes a fundamental stability-plasticity dilemma. External retrieval-based memory can rapidly absorb new evidence, but it often fails to internalize recurring execution patterns and incurs inference-time retrieval overhead. Parametric memory enables stable and efficient execution once learned, but typicall

summary.core_problem: 解决边界未知、持续变化的任务流中，LLM agent 记忆系统在快速适应新任务与稳定复用旧策略之间的稳定性-可塑性冲突。
summary.importance: 这是一个 agent 长期运行中的记忆管理问题，贡献类型偏方法设计与系统机制，而不是基座预训练本身。对 pretrain 研究员的价值主要在于“外部记忆与参数记忆如何分工”的接口启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 UniMem，自路由地协调 episodic memory 与 parametric memory。核心做法是用可学习 routing tokens 作为记忆控制器：新颖或稀疏任务先写入 episodic buffer 供检索增强执行；重复出现的模式再逐步 consolidation 到参数记忆中，以减少推理时检索开销并提升稳定复用能力。
summary.experiments: 从摘要看，实验重点应是 boundary-agnostic task streams 下的持续任务表现、检索开销与长期稳定性对比，但当前给出的摘要被截断，缺少模型规模、数据集、baseline 和具体增益数字，暂时只能判断其验证场景偏 continual agent memory，而非 clean 的 pretraining setup。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the stability-plasticity trade-off in LLM agent memory under boundary-agnostic, evolving task streams, where agents must absorb new tasks without forgetting reusable execution patterns.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an agent memory-management paper rather than a foundation-model pretraining paper. Its value to pretraining researchers lies in the interface between external episodic memory and internal parametric memory.
summary_en.technical_approach: UniMem introduces a self-routing framework that coordinates episodic and parametric memory via learnable routing tokens. Novel or sparse tasks are stored in an episodic buffer for retrieval-augmented execution, while recurring patterns are gradually consolidated into model parameters for more efficient and stable reuse.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, the evaluation likely focuses on continual task streams, retrieval overhead, and long-horizon stability. However, the provided abstract is truncated, so model sizes, datasets, baselines, and quantitative gains are not available; the setup appears more agent-centric than pretraining-centric.

recommendation.zh: 更像 agent memory 系统论文，不会直接改写 pretrain prior；若你在想 RAG memory 如何向参数记忆迁移，可只看路由与 consolidation 设计。
recommendation.en: This is more of an agent-memory systems paper than a pretraining one; read only if you care about how retrieval memory might consolidate into parametric memory.

paper.title: cMoLLM at Scale: Horizontal Scaling Laws for Mixture-of-LLMs
paper.abstract: Scaling large language models (LLMs) has driven their success, yet dense Transformers couple capacity and computation: every parameter is activated for every token, making training and inference costs grow linearly with model size-a critical bottleneck as models approach trillion-parameter regimes. We aim to scale capacity through MoE-style mixture throughout the LLM pipeline rather than only the FFN. Prior pipeline-level approaches include ParaScale, which introduces virtual tokens and parallel

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文试图解决 dense Transformer 中容量和计算强绑定的问题：参数越多，每个 token 激活的参数也越多。作者希望把 MoE 的条件计算从 FFN 层扩展到整个 LLM pipeline，同时避免已有 pipeline-level mixture 方法中的虚拟 token 开销、路由同质化和训练不稳定。
summary.importance: 这是一篇架构与扩展方法论文，对预训练研究的价值在于提出了一种“横向扩容”的实现路径。它不只是把 FFN 换成专家，而是把完整 stream / sub-model 作为混合对象，并用动态卷积视角统一解释 MoE-style mixture。贡献量级目前更接近可跟进的架构探索：实验基于 GPT-2 风格模型和 FineWeb，能说明训练可行性与趋势，但还不能直接证明在大规模预训练下优于成熟 MoE 路线。
summary.technical_approach: 核心理论点是把 MoE-style mixture 等价改写为输入相关的 dynamic convolution：每个 expert 可看成一个 1×1 convolution kernel，router 产生输入相关的 kernel mixing 权重。基于这个视角，作者提出 cMoLLM。模型维护多个端到端 stream，每个 stream 对应独立的 1×1 kernel；轻量 gating network 为输入生成 soft mixture weights；最终通过 grouped pointwise convolution 完成混合。与 Top-K MoE 不同，它使用连续可微的 soft gating，不做离散路由；与 ParaScale 不同，它不引入虚拟 token，避免增加序列长度；与 AltUp 不同，它不依赖辅助预测分支，适应性更强。
summary.experiments: 实验在 GPT-2 风格模型上进行，预训练数据使用 FineWeb，并在 perplexity、GLUE、SQuAD 等指标上比较 dense baseline、ParaScale-style 方法和 AltUp-style 方法。论文报告 cMoLLM 在相近成本下匹配或优于 dense baseline，并表现出更好的 stream utilization、更稳定的训练动态和更好的 scaling 趋势。给定材料没有提供具体参数规模、训练 token 数、困惑度数值或任务提升幅度；这些需要重点查 Section 5.3 和附录实验表。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 30–40 分钟。先看 Theorem 4.1，确认 MoE 与 dynamic convolution 的等价关系是否只是形式重写，还是能约束实际设计。然后看 cMoLLM 的 stream、gating、grouped pointwise convolution 细节，重点关注计算图是否真的保持硬件友好。实验部分优先看 Section 5.3 的 scaling 曲线、训练稳定性、stream utilization，以及与 ParaScale / AltUp 的公平成本对齐。若资源有限，可跳过一般 MoE 背景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the tight coupling between capacity and compute in dense Transformers: increasing parameters also increases the number of parameters activated for every token. It aims to extend conditional computation from FFN-only MoE layers to the whole LLM pipeline, while avoiding the overhead and instability seen in prior pipeline-level mixture methods.
summary_en.importance: The relevance to pretraining research is architectural. The paper proposes a horizontal capacity-scaling mechanism where entire streams or sub-model pipelines are mixed, rather than only replacing FFNs with experts. Its current impact should be read as an architecture exploration with useful design signals. The experiments are on GPT-2-style models trained on FineWeb, so they support feasibility and scaling trends, but do not yet settle whether this approach beats mature large-scale MoE training recipes.
summary_en.technical_approach: The central idea is a formal equivalence between MoE-style mixture layers and dynamic convolutions with input-dependent kernels. Each expert can be interpreted as a 1×1 convolutional kernel, and the router produces input-dependent weights for mixing those kernels. Based on this view, the authors introduce cMoLLM. The model keeps multiple end-to-end streams, associates each stream with a distinct 1×1 kernel, uses a lightweight gating network to produce soft mixture weights, and implements the final mixing through grouped pointwise convolution. Unlike Top-K MoE, it uses fully differentiable soft gating. Unlike ParaScale, it does not add virtual tokens and therefore avoids increasing sequence length. Unlike AltUp, it does not rely on an auxiliary prediction branch.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical study uses GPT-2-style models trained on FineWeb, with evaluations on perplexity, GLUE, and SQuAD. The paper reports that cMoLLM matches or improves over dense baselines under comparable cost, and shows better stream utilization, more stable training dynamics, and favorable scaling compared with ParaScale-style and AltUp-style pipeline mixtures. The provided text does not include exact parameter counts, training-token budgets, perplexity values, or task-level gains; these should be checked in Section 5.3 and the appendix tables.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 30–40 minutes. Start with Theorem 4.1 to judge whether the MoE-to-dynamic-convolution equivalence provides design constraints or is mainly a useful reformulation. Then read the cMoLLM architecture details: streams, gating, and grouped pointwise convolution. In the experiments, focus on Section 5.3, especially scaling curves, training stability, stream utilization, and cost matching against ParaScale and AltUp. The general MoE background can be skipped if already familiar.

recommendation.zh: 值得看的是它把 MoE 解释成动态卷积这一步；若实验做得干净，这会改变你对“专家只该放 FFN” 的先验，但先别急着信 headline，先查路由熵和 collapse 分析。
recommendation.en: The interesting part is the MoE-as-dynamic-convolution reframing; if the experiments are clean, it weakens the prior that experts belong only in FFNs, but verify routing entropy and collapse diagnostics before buying the scaling claim.

paper.title: Codifying the Judge: Scalable Evaluation via Program Distillation
paper.abstract: LLM-as-a-judge has become the standard for automated evaluation, but it suffers from high cost, significant latency, and opaque decisions -- limitations that undermine its scalability and reliability. We address these with a simple, efficient alternative: program distillation. Instead of prompting an LLM at the evaluation time, we distill its decision logic into a committee of programs that score candidates directly. These programmatic judges offer transparency, are easily inspected or edited, a

summary.core_problem: 这项工作要解决 LLM-as-a-judge 在大规模评测和偏好标注中的成本、延迟、不可解释和重复推理问题。核心思路是把评测时调用大模型，改成先用大模型合成可执行的 judge 程序，再用程序在本地批量打分。
summary.importance: 它和预训练本身不是同一层问题，但对 post-train 数据生产、reward model 训练、自动评测流水线有实际意义。当前很多 SFT/RL 数据筛选、偏好比较和 reward distillation 都依赖 LLM judge。如果 judge 成本随样本数线性增长，百万级数据处理会很贵，也很难追踪判分逻辑。程序化 judge 的价值在于把一部分评测信号变成可复用、可检查、可编辑的规则集合。它不能替代强模型处理开放复杂案例，但可以承担高频、结构清晰、可规则化的评测子任务。
summary.technical_approach: 系统名为 PAJAMA。流程分三步。第一步，用 LLM 根据不同 rubric 生成一组 Python judge 程序，而不是只生成单个规则。这样做是为了增加判分逻辑的多样性，避免一个程序覆盖不足。第二步，在 held-out validation set 上校准每个程序的输出，筛选有效程序，并把多个程序的 verdict 聚合成最终偏好判断。聚合不是简单投票，因为不同 rubric 的分数尺度和噪声不同，需要建模冲突和置信度。第三步，引入 confidence-aware fallback：当程序委员会没有覆盖输入，或聚合结果置信度低时，再路由给 LLM judge。这个设计承认程序 judge 的边界，把它定位成高吞吐前端，而不是完全替代模型推理。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 5 个偏好数据集和 4 个模型家族。独立的 programmatic judges 能达到 OLMo-2-13B-Instruct 级别的准确率，同时运行速度快 47.25 倍。与 LLM fallback 结合后，PAJAMA 改善准确率—吞吐折中：搭配 OLMo-2-7B-Instruct 时，准确率提升 5.0%，吞吐为 2.9 倍；相对 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct，准确率提升 2.6%，吞吐为 2.2 倍。在 RewardBench 上，用程序 judge 标签训练的 reward model 超过使用 proprietary LLM 偏好标签训练的模型，API 成本低 50 倍，并且评测阶段不需要 proprietary 调用。工作还测试了偏置样本，结果显示程序 judge 对某些风格偏置更稳；配合 coding agent 迭代校准程序后，鲁棒性进一步提高。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 30–40 分钟。重点看 Framework 中程序合成、程序输出校准、committee aggregation 和 fallback router 的设计。实验部分优先看 accuracy-throughput Pareto 曲线、RewardBench reward model 蒸馏结果、biased samples 鲁棒性分析。对做预训练或 post-train 数据流水线的人，最值得看的不是具体 benchmark 分数，而是它把 judge 从黑盒推理变成可缓存、可审计评测资产的工程模式。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles the cost, latency, opacity, and repeated-inference burden of LLM-as-a-judge pipelines. Instead of calling an LLM for every evaluation example, it asks an LLM to synthesize executable judging programs once, then runs those programs locally at scale.
summary_en.importance: This is more relevant to evaluation and post-training data pipelines than to base-model pretraining itself. Still, it matters because preference labeling, reward distillation, SFT data filtering, and automated regression tests often rely on LLM judges. If the judge must be re-run for every sample and every rubric change, large-scale data production becomes expensive and hard to audit. Programmatic judges offer a different operating point: reusable, inspectable, editable decision logic for cases where the rubric can be partially expressed as code. They are not a full replacement for strong model judges on open-ended cases, but they can serve as a high-throughput front end.
summary_en.technical_approach: The system is called PAJAMA. It has three main components. First, an LLM synthesizes a diverse pool of Python judging programs from rubric prompts. The use of a committee is important because a single generated program usually has limited coverage and brittle logic. Second, the system calibrates program outputs on a held-out validation set, selects useful programs, and aggregates their decisions into a final preference verdict. This is not just majority voting, since different rubrics produce scores with different scales and noise levels. Third, a confidence-aware router sends uncovered or low-confidence examples to an LLM fallback. The design treats programs as a cheap and transparent first pass, while retaining model inference for ambiguous cases.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses five preference datasets and four model families. Standalone programmatic judges match the accuracy of OLMo-2-13B-Instruct while running 47.25 times faster. In the hybrid setting, PAJAMA improves the accuracy-throughput trade-off: with OLMo-2-7B-Instruct as fallback, it reports a 5.0% accuracy gain at 2.9 times throughput; compared with Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, it reports a 2.6% accuracy gain at 2.2 times throughput. On RewardBench, a reward model trained from programmatic-judge labels outperforms one trained on proprietary LLM preference labels, with 50 times lower API cost and no proprietary calls at evaluation time. The paper also reports robustness tests on biased samples and shows further gains when a coding agent iteratively calibrates the judge programs.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 30–40 minutes. Focus on the framework details: program synthesis, output calibration, committee aggregation, and the confidence-based fallback router. In the experiments, prioritize the accuracy-throughput curves, the RewardBench reward-model distillation result, and the bias robustness analysis. For researchers building pretraining or post-training data pipelines, the main lesson is the engineering pattern: convert part of a black-box judge into a cached and auditable evaluation asset, while reserving LLM inference for the hard tail.

recommendation.zh: 只看 program distillation 和 fallback routing；有用点是把 judge 信号从黑盒 API 变成低成本可审计程序。
recommendation.en: Read program distillation and fallback routing; the useful idea is turning black-box judge calls into cheap, inspectable programs.

paper.title: Is MoE Routing a Huffman Code? Discovering the Frequency-Diversity Law in Chain-of-Thought
paper.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts architectures have revolutionized scaling, yet the underlying logic of their routing remains a black box. In this paper, we uncover a fundamental governing principle: MoE routing is not merely selection, but a manifestation of Huffman Coding. We introduce the Frequency-Diversity Law, revealing that state-of-the-art models, such as Phi-3.5-MoE and Gemma-4-27B-A4B, spontaneously act as information-theoretic engines. These models allocate sparse expert resources for common tokens

summary.core_problem: 这项工作试图解释 MoE 在 CoT 推理中的路由规律：专家激活数量是否随语义事件的稀有度增加而增加，以及负载均衡是否会诱导冗余专家。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在 MoE 训练动态和路由诊断。它把路由模式看成一种“语义操作编码”，用任务频率、专家多样性、有效稀疏度来分析 expert allocation，而不是只看负载均衡指标或专家利用率。这个角度对设计 MoE 辅助损失、选择 top-k/E 比例、判断 expert redundancy 有参考价值。不过，Huffman coding 的表述更像一个解释框架，是否构成严格的信息论等价还需要看定义、统计样本和反例验证。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上，作者把 CoT 按换行切成 reasoning step。对每个 step、每一层，统计该 step 内所有 token 激活过的专家集合，并用 unique expert count 作为“码长”代理。任务稀有度用 -log p(o) 表示，然后检验平均专家多样性是否与稀有度正相关。核心假设是：常见语义操作应复用少量核心专家，罕见或复杂操作会调用更分散的专家组合。进一步，作者引入 effective sparsity k/E_eff，指出当有效稀疏度过低且负载均衡压力较强时，模型可能生成语义功能相近的 expert clone。为处理这种冗余，作者提出 Subset Difference Pruning，通过移除中等冗余专家来改变路由拓扑，让模型重新编码推理路径。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Phi-3.5-MoE、Gemma-4-27B-A4B 和 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B。文中报告 Phi-3.5-MoE 与 Gemma-4-27B-A4B 上，平均 unique experts/layer 与任务稀有度 -log p(o) 呈强正相关，示例图中 Spearman ρ=1.00。Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 被作为反例分析：虽然活跃专家数较高，但在较低 k/E_eff 条件下出现功能冗余，负载均衡可能让多个专家学到相似语义功能。SDP 剪枝后，模型推理轨迹发生变化，但仍能把逻辑重新压缩到更少、更有效的专家路径中。已给出的内容没有提供完整 benchmark 分数、剪枝比例和性能保持曲线，精读时需要核对表 4 及 SDP 实验细节。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25 分钟。重点看三处：第一，Temporal Expert Combination Encoding 中 unique expert count 的定义，它决定了 Huffman 类比是否站得住；第二，Frequency-Diversity Law 的统计设计，尤其是 p(o) 如何估计、任务稀有度如何分桶、不同层是否一致；第三，Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 的 redundancy trap 和 Table 4，看作者如何区分“专家多样性”与“功能冗余”。SDP 部分可快速看剪枝准则和剪枝后能力是否下降。需要保持一个判断：这项工作最有用的是 MoE 路由诊断指标，不一定是 Huffman 等价命题本身。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether MoE routing in chain-of-thought traces follows a frequency-dependent allocation pattern, and whether load balancing can create redundant experts under aggressive sparsity.
summary_en.importance: Its main value for pretraining is in MoE diagnostics. It reframes routing as a semantic coding problem and analyzes expert allocation through task frequency, expert diversity, and effective sparsity, rather than only through load balance or utilization. This is relevant to auxiliary-loss design, top-k/E choices, and redundancy analysis in sparse models. The Huffman analogy should be read with care: it is a useful explanatory lens, but the strict information-theoretic equivalence depends on how code length, rarity, and semantic events are operationalized.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method segments CoT traces into reasoning steps using newline boundaries. For each step and each layer, it takes the union of all experts activated by tokens in that step, then uses the number of unique experts as a surrogate for code length. Task rarity is represented by -log p(o), and the paper tests whether rarer operations activate more diverse expert committees. The proposed Frequency-Diversity Law states that common semantic operations reuse a small set of core experts, while rare or complex operations recruit broader expert combinations. The paper also introduces effective sparsity, k/E_eff, and argues that very low effective sparsity combined with load-balancing pressure can produce functional expert clones. Subset Difference Pruning is then used to remove moderately redundant experts and force the model to re-encode reasoning paths through a leaner routing topology.
summary_en.experiments: The analysis covers Phi-3.5-MoE, Gemma-4-27B-A4B, and Qwen3.5-35B-A3B. For Phi-3.5-MoE and Gemma-4-27B-A4B, the paper reports a strong positive relationship between mean unique experts per layer and task rarity, with an example Spearman correlation of ρ=1.00. Qwen3.5-35B-A3B is used to illustrate a redundancy failure mode: high active expert counts do not necessarily imply useful diversity when k/E_eff is too small and load balancing encourages semantically overlapping experts. After Subset Difference Pruning, the routing trajectories shift, but the model reportedly re-encodes reasoning through more compact expert paths. The provided content does not expose the full benchmark table, pruning ratios, or capability-retention curves, so those details should be checked before drawing strong conclusions.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25 minutes. Focus first on the definition of unique expert count in the temporal encoding section, because it carries the Huffman-style interpretation. Then inspect the Frequency-Diversity Law experiments: how p(o) is estimated, how rarity bins are constructed, and whether the effect is stable across layers and models. Finally, read the Qwen3.5-35B-A3B analysis and Table 4 to see how the paper separates expert diversity from functional redundancy. The SDP section is worth a quick pass for the pruning criterion and post-pruning capability checks. The most reusable part is the routing diagnostic framework, not necessarily the stronger claim that MoE routing is Huffman coding.

recommendation.zh: 标题过满，但 MoE 路由频率—多样性曲线值得看；先查 Fig 和 pruning ablation，别急着接受 Huffman 解释。
recommendation.en: The title overreaches, but the routing frequency-diversity curves are worth checking; inspect the figures and pruning ablations before buying the Huffman story.

paper.title: Multi-level context Modeling for consistent expert selection in Mixture-of-Experts
paper.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) enables efficient scaling of Transformer models by routing tokens to a small subset of experts. However, existing routers typically condition expert selection on shallow or isolated token representations, which often produce unstable and semantically inconsistent routing decisions across layers. In this work, we revisit expert selection from a representation perspective and identify context incompleteness as a key bottleneck limiting effective expert specialization. To a

summary.core_problem: MoE 路由器只依赖当前层、当前 token 的局部表示，容易导致跨层专家选择不一致、同一语义片段内路由不连贯，进而削弱专家分工。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对 MoE 预训练的启发在于：路由质量不只取决于 top-k、负载均衡或路由正则，路由输入表示本身也可能是瓶颈。它把问题定位为“上下文不完整”，并尝试用跨层语义信息和局部 token 关系来稳定专家选择。贡献更偏 MoE router 设计，量级属于可泛读的结构改进；是否能用于大规模基座预训练，还要看额外显存、通信和延迟成本。
summary.technical_approach: MCF-MOE 的核心做法是先构造更完整的路由表示，再做专家选择。第一部分是跨层语义聚合：当前层 hidden state 生成 query，过去 k 层 hidden state 加上层索引 embedding 后作为 key/value，通过带 causal mask 的跨层 attention 聚合历史层信息，避免自回归场景下看到未来 token。第二部分是局部语义一致性建模：在固定半径窗口内建模 token 之间的相似性和局部关系，让相邻或语义相关 token 的路由更连贯。与 HyperRouter、RMOE 这类偏路由参数生成或跨层激活记忆的方法不同，MCF-MOE 更强调路由前的表示构造。代价是需要维护历史层输出缓存，并引入额外 attention 或局部相似度计算；在长序列和大模型 MoE 中，这部分开销需要单独评估。
summary.experiments: 给出的全文片段展示了两类诊断：全局跨层一致性和局部语义一致性。作者观察到常规 MoE 的跨层专家分配一致性很低，序列内部的语义连贯性也不稳定，并据此引出 MCF-MOE。实验部分声称在多个 benchmark 上改善下游表现，并提升专家选择一致性，但提供的内容没有包含具体模型规模、数据规模、benchmark 名称、提升数字或消融表。泛读时应重点确认两个问题：跨层聚合和局部融合各自贡献多少；性能收益是否超过额外训练与推理开销。
summary.reading_guide: 建议用 20–30 分钟泛读。优先看 Figure 1 的路由一致性诊断，因为这是方法成立的主要依据。然后看 Method 中跨层 attention 的 causal 设计、历史层缓存方式、局部窗口融合方式。实验部分如果可获取，应直接查三类结果：下游任务增益、路由一致性指标、计算开销。若没有大模型规模或真实 MoE 预训练实验，这篇更适合作为 router 表示设计的参考，而不是训练 recipe 依据。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses unstable and semantically inconsistent expert routing in MoE models, caused by routers that rely on shallow, layer-local token representations.
summary_en.importance: The useful signal for pretraining research is that MoE routing should not be treated only as a top-k selection or load-balancing problem. The representation fed into the router can be under-specified. The work proposes to make routing decisions from richer contextual evidence across layers and within local token neighborhoods. This is a router-design contribution rather than a full-scale pretraining recipe, and its practical impact depends on the memory and latency overhead introduced by cross-layer caches and extra context fusion.
summary_en.technical_approach: MCF-MOE builds a context-enriched routing representation before expert selection. It first performs cross-layer semantic aggregation: the current layer hidden states form queries, while hidden states from the previous k layers, augmented with layer-index embeddings, provide keys and values. A causal mask is used so that autoregressive generation does not leak future-token information. It then adds local similarity-aware fusion over a fixed-radius token neighborhood to capture fine-grained sequence structure. Compared with methods that modify routing parameters or maintain expert-activation memory, the main change here is the construction of the router input itself. The trade-off is extra hidden-state storage and additional attention or similarity computation, which may matter in long-context and large-scale MoE training.
summary_en.experiments: The provided text reports two diagnostics: low global cross-layer consistency of expert assignments and weak local semantic coherence within sequences. The authors claim improved downstream performance and more consistent expert specialization across multiple benchmarks, but the supplied content does not include model sizes, training data scale, benchmark names, numerical gains, or ablation tables. The key experiments to verify are the separate contributions of cross-layer aggregation and local fusion, and whether the routing gains justify the added compute and memory cost.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is enough. Start with Figure 1, since the routing-consistency diagnosis is the main motivation. Then inspect the method details around causal cross-layer attention, historical hidden-state caching, and local-window fusion. If the full experimental section is available, focus on downstream gains, routing-consistency metrics, and overhead measurements. Without large-scale MoE pretraining evidence, the paper is best read as a router-representation idea rather than as a production training recipe.

recommendation.zh: 只看路由一致性定义和消融即可；若实验规模偏小，可当作 MoE router 表示设计的弱信号。
recommendation.en: Read only the routing-consistency metric and ablations; if the scale is small, treat it as a weak signal for MoE router representation design.
