paper.title: ContinuityBench: A Benchmark and Systems Study of Stateful Failover in Multi-Provider LLM Routing
paper.abstract: In production large language model (LLM) deployments, high API availability guarantees do not equate to conversational continuity. When a primary provider experiences an outage or strict rate-limiting, naive stateless failover mechanisms successfully maintain uptime but silently discard conversation history, severely disrupting the user experience. To rigorously quantify and resolve this failure mode, we introduce two novel metrics: Continuity Preservation Rate (CPR) and Continuity Latency Overh

summary.core_problem: 评估并缓解多 LLM provider 路由中的 failover 问题：API 可用性保持了，但对话历史在切换 provider 时丢失，导致会话连续性中断。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是评测协议和系统研究，提出面向生产 LLM 路由的连续性指标与开源压力测试 harness；它更偏 serving reliability，不直接推进预训练方法，但对部署侧评估有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出两个指标：Continuity Preservation Rate，衡量故障切换后上下文是否被保留；Continuity Latency Overhead，衡量转发历史带来的延迟代价。系统上实现 stateful multi-provider proxy，用 History-Forwarding 在异构 LLM endpoint 之间重建会话状态。
summary.experiments: 实验包含 750 次 failover 事件，测试高并发 provider 故障下的上下文保存情况。摘要未列出具体 provider、模型规模、延迟数值或相对 baseline 的完整提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates and mitigates conversational state loss during failover in multi-provider LLM routing.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is an evaluation protocol and systems harness for production LLM reliability. It is about serving continuity rather than pretraining, but the failure mode is real in deployed LLM systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce Continuity Preservation Rate for measuring whether context survives failover, and Continuity Latency Overhead for measuring the latency cost of forwarding history. They implement a stateful multi-provider proxy that reconstructs conversation state across heterogeneous LLM endpoints via history forwarding.
summary_en.experiments: The study reports 750 failover events under high-concurrency provider-failure conditions. The abstract does not provide detailed model/provider choices, exact latency numbers, or full baseline deltas.

recommendation.zh: 这是部署可靠性评测，不是模型研究；只看指标定义和 failover setup，别把结论外推到训练侧。
recommendation.en: This is a deployment-reliability benchmark, not model research; read the metric definitions and failover setup, but do not extrapolate it to training.

paper.title: Uncertainty-Aware Sequential Decision Rules for Event-Triggered LLM Invocation in Streaming Systems
paper.abstract: Streaming inference pipelines increasingly pair lightweight fast models with Large Language Models (LLMs) that provide rich semantic understanding at substantial cost. The central question of when to invoke the LLM has received limited formal treatment. We cast this as a risk-based sequential stopping problem, where a trigger policy fires when a risk functional over the observation history exceeds a threshold. Within this framework, we prove six results: a minimum inter-event time bound excludin

summary.core_problem: 在流式推理系统中，如何用形式化规则决定何时调用成本较高的 LLM，而不是一直调用或完全不用。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理成本控制和级联系统的形式化分析。它不推进预训练方法，但对 fast model + LLM 的在线 serving、路由和触发策略有工程参考。
summary.technical_approach: 将 LLM 调用时机建模为基于风险的 sequential stopping 问题：当历史观测上的风险函数超过阈值时触发 LLM。论文把 event-triggered、optimal stopping、SPRT、CUSUM、Bayesian triggers 等触发族统一到同一框架，并分析阈值策略、在线阈值更新和校准误差传递。
summary.experiments: 摘要主要列出理论结果：最小触发间隔可避免 chattering；阈值策略具有 smooth pasting 意义下的最优性；估计参数下有近似 SPRT 保证；平稳流 regret 为 O(sqrt(T log T))，含 C_T 个 changepoints 时为 O(sqrt((C_T+1)T log T))；在线梯度下降阈值收敛率为 O(1/sqrt(T))。未见具体 LLM、数据流或系统吞吐实验信息。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies when a streaming inference pipeline should invoke an expensive LLM instead of relying only on lightweight fast models.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a formal treatment of inference-cost control and cascaded serving. It does not advance pretraining, but it is relevant to online LLM routing and trigger policies in production systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: It formulates LLM invocation as a risk-based sequential stopping problem: a trigger fires when a risk functional over the observation history crosses a threshold. The framework subsumes event-triggered, optimal stopping, SPRT, CUSUM, and Bayesian triggers, and analyzes threshold optimality, adaptive thresholds, and calibration-to-miss-rate transfer.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract emphasizes theory: minimum inter-event time to prevent chattering, smooth-pasting optimality of threshold policies, approximate SPRT guarantees under estimated parameters, O(sqrt(T log T)) regret for stationary streams, O(sqrt((C_T+1)T log T)) regret under changepoints, and O(1/sqrt(T)) convergence for online threshold updates. No concrete LLM, stream dataset, or serving-throughput experiment is specified.

recommendation.zh: 只看形式化触发框架和 regret 条件；它是 serving 路由材料，不是 pretrain 信号。
recommendation.en: Read only the trigger formulation and regret assumptions; this is serving-routing material, not a pretraining signal.

paper.title: Route, Communicate, and Reason: Gated Routing and Adaptive Depth for Efficient Multi-Agent Reasoning
paper.abstract: Multi-agent ensembling multiplies active parameters and inference cost without answering three basic questions: which agents to consult, how deeply a query should traverse a hierarchy of agents, and when inter-agent communication is worth its cost. summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是多智能体 LLM 系统里的一个老问题：如果用一组较小、异构、专长不同的模型协同推理，怎样才能让系统按题目难度自适应地决定‘找谁来做、做到多深、谁和谁需要通信’，而不是像固定 ensemble 那样每次都把所有 agent 全跑一遍。作者还额外处理了一个很实际的问题：当某个 expert 在部署时被替换后，原先学到的 gate 阈值会失效，系统需要一种低成本的重新校准机制。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练的直接相关性有限，它更接近 post-train 阶段的多智能体推理系统与 RL 协调方法，而不是预训练方法本身。启发点主要有两类。第一，它把 MoE/conditional compute 的思想搬到了 agent 层：query-dependent routing、adaptive depth、selective communication，这些设计和大模型里 token-level 或 expert-level 路由有相通之处。第二，它展示了在冻结专家、只训练轻量协调层的设定下，RL 可以学到比手工协议更细的协作策略，这对研究 pretrain 与 post-train 接口、以及如何把计算预算分配给不同推理路径，有一定参考价值。但如果只从预训练研究优先级看，这篇不属于必须精读的那类。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，作者提出 GRADE，一个分层多智能体框架。系统分三层：最上层是一个小型 orchestrator M0，负责接收共享 encoder 产出的 query 表示并做初步决策；中间层是两个 manager，用 MLP 形成分组信号，把相关 specialist 组织到各自子池中；底层是若干 sub-agent，每个 agent 绑定一个冻结的 expert LLM，同时带有少量可训练模块，包括把 expert 输出映射到共享 d 维空间的 adapter、answer head，以及用于热替换后的 calibration map。

核心机制是四个 gate。Assignment Gate 决定激活哪些 sub-agent；Depth Gate 决定是否继续下探到更深层级或提前停止；Communication Gate 决定 agent 间哪些消息需要传递，避免全广播；Pruning Gate 则在分支展开后裁掉低价值路径。这样做的目标很明确：把多智能体系统从固定拓扑、固定通信、固定深度，改成按 query 自适应分配计算。

训练上，作者提出 CoGRPO，可以看成 group-relative policy optimization 在多智能体层级系统里的改写。它不需要 critic，而是基于 rollout 的相对奖励给所有参与当前轨迹的 gate 和 agent 分配 advantage。这里的关键不是 RL 名字本身，而是 credit assignment：因为最终只有一个 correctness reward，系统必须把这个稀疏信号回传给路由决策、通信决策和具体回答 agent。作者的做法是把所有对当前 rollout 有贡献的模块都纳入同一个相对优势更新框架。

另一个比较实用的设计是 Expert Registry + calibration。每个 agent 不直接和某个固定 expert 强绑定，而是通过 registry descriptor 与可替换 expert 关联。部署时如果替换 expert，只需用 64 个 anchor queries 对该 agent 的 calibration map 做重新校准，而不必重训 gates。作者强调这是因为不同 expert 的输出分布会漂移，若不校准，原有 gate 阈值和通信决策都会偏掉。
summary.experiments:
实验主要回答五件事：是否比 monolithic 或 flat ensemble 更省算力；四种 gate 各自贡献多大；CoGRPO 的 credit assignment 是否优于替代方案；expert hot-swap 后校准是否必要；以及难题是否真的会触发更多 agent 和更深层级。

结果上，GRADE 在平均约 17B active parameters 下，GSM8K 达到 94.8±0.3%，MMLUPro 78.2±0.6%，GPQA 57.4±1.8%，相对 Puppeteer 在 MMLUPro 提升 4.8 个点、在 GPQA 提升 3.3 个点。AIME-2025 上，Puppeteer 的 4-model brute-force ensemble 仍高 1.9 个点，说明在高强度数学推理上，单纯增加并行大模型推理深度仍有优势。

消融方面，论文的主线结论是：层级路由、选择性通信、深度自适应不是可互相替代的小组件，去掉任一部分都会带来明显退化；而 CoGRPO 比若干简单 credit assignment 方案更稳，因为它能把最终正确性奖励更合理地分给参与轨迹的 gate 与 agent。关于部署鲁棒性，去掉 calibration 后，expert 热替换会立刻造成约 18 个点的准确率下降，且需要 20+ 查询才能自然恢复；加入 calibration 后，恢复只需 0–9 个查询。这个结果虽然偏系统工程，但很实用。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时建议先看方法总览图和四个 gate 的定义，弄清楚系统到底在哪些位置做条件计算。然后重点看 CoGRPO 的 credit assignment 设计，因为这是区别于手工 orchestration 的核心。实验部分优先看三类表：一是和 Puppeteer、flat ensemble、monolithic baseline 的主结果；二是 gate/communication/depth 的消融；三是 expert substitution 与 calibration 的恢复曲线。

如果你的兴趣点是预训练，只需要花 25–35 分钟抓住 conditional compute 和 routing 设计即可，不必深挖所有 benchmark。若你做 post-train、agent RL 或 inference-time orchestration，这篇可以再细看训练细节和热替换实验。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a practical coordination problem in multi-agent LLM systems: given a heterogeneous pool of smaller experts, how can the system decide per query which agents to activate, how deep the reasoning hierarchy should go, and which agents should communicate, instead of running every expert every time? It also addresses a deployment issue that many agent papers ignore: when an expert is swapped at inference time, previously learned gate thresholds can become miscalibrated.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to core pretraining is limited. This is primarily a post-training and inference-time coordination paper, not a pretraining-method paper. The useful connection to foundation-model research is indirect. First, it brings conditional-compute ideas to the agent level: query-dependent routing, adaptive depth, and selective communication resemble MoE-style allocation, but at a coarser granularity. Second, it shows that RL can learn collaboration policies over frozen experts better than fixed prompt protocols, which is relevant if one cares about the interface between pretrained experts and downstream orchestration. Still, for a pretraining-focused reader, this is a skim rather than a must-read.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The proposed system, GRADE, is a hierarchical multi-agent architecture with three levels. At the top is a lightweight orchestrator M0 that consumes a shared query representation from an encoder and makes initial routing decisions. The middle layer contains two manager modules, implemented as small MLPs, which provide grouping signals over subsets of specialists. The bottom layer consists of sub-agents, each backed by a frozen expert LLM plus lightweight trainable components: an adapter into a shared latent space, an answer head, and a calibration map used after expert substitution.

The main design is a set of four learned gates. The Assignment Gate selects which sub-agents are activated. The Depth Gate decides whether the system should continue deeper into the hierarchy or stop early. The Communication Gate learns pairwise message passing masks so that agents do not always broadcast to one another. The Pruning Gate removes low-value branches during execution. Together, these gates turn a fixed multi-agent pipeline into a query-adaptive conditional-compute system.

For training, the paper introduces CoGRPO, a multi-agent variant of group-relative policy optimization. It avoids a critic and instead assigns relative advantage to all gates and agents that contributed to a rollout under a final correctness reward. The important point is credit assignment: the system must propagate a sparse end reward back to routing, communication, and answering decisions jointly.

A practical addition is the Expert Registry with lightweight recalibration. Agents are associated with swappable experts through registry descriptors, and when an expert is replaced at inference time, only a small calibration step on 64 anchor queries is needed. The gates themselves are left untouched. This is meant to handle distribution shift in expert outputs after substitution.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments are organized around five questions: whether GRADE beats monolithic and flat-ensemble baselines at lower active-parameter cost, how much each gate contributes, whether CoGRPO improves credit assignment, whether calibration is necessary after expert hot-swap, and whether harder tasks trigger deeper and broader agent usage.

Reported results show 94.8±0.3 on GSM8K, 78.2±0.6 on MMLUPro, and 57.4±1.8 on GPQA with about 17B average active parameters. Relative to Puppeteer, the gains are +4.8 on MMLUPro and +3.3 on GPQA. On AIME-2025, however, Puppeteer’s brute-force four-model ensemble remains ahead by 1.9 points, suggesting that for very hard mathematical reasoning, simply allocating more large-model compute still helps.

The ablations indicate that hierarchical routing, selective communication, and adaptive depth each matter; they are not interchangeable extras. The calibration study is one of the more practical results: removing calibration causes an immediate accuracy drop of about 18 points after expert swap and requires more than 20 queries to recover, whereas with calibration the recovery takes only 0 to 9 queries.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a quick read, start with the system overview and the definitions of the four gates. Then focus on CoGRPO, since learned credit assignment is the main methodological difference from prompt-engineered orchestration. In the experiments, prioritize three parts: the main comparison against Puppeteer, flat ensembles, and monolithic baselines; the gate and communication ablations; and the expert-substitution calibration results. If your main interest is pretraining, 25 to 35 minutes is enough to extract the conditional-compute lessons. If you work on agent RL or inference-time orchestration, the training details are worth a closer read.

summary.core_problem: LLM serving 中请求在线到达时，如何在 batch-size 与 KV-cache 约束下做路由，并显式控制多种 SLO（延迟/吞吐/收益）权衡。

summary.technical_approach: 将路由建模为在线线性规划：每个请求有 SLO 加权收益，资源约束由 KV-cache、并行 decode worker、batch 约束表达；用 bid-price control（对偶变量/影子价格）决定接收与分配；为毫秒级决策实现 warm-start 的投影一阶更新，在线跟踪对偶价格以保证稳定运行时延。

summary_en.importance: Replaces ad-hoc routing heuristics with an interpretable online optimization objective (online LP + shadow prices). Not pretraining-facing, but relevant to the training–inference cost loop and controllable serving trade-offs.

paper.title: Mixture of Debaters: Learn to Debate at Architectural Level in Multi-Agent Reasoning
paper.abstract: Existing multi-agent debate frameworks suffer from two critical limitations: they rely on static architectures where agent roles and coordination patterns are fixed at design time, and they require instantiating multiple model copies, incurring substantial computational overhead. We propose Mixture of Debaters (MoD), a unified framework that enables dynamic self-debate within a single model by leveraging the Mixture-of-Experts paradigm. We address three key challenges in adapting MoE for dialect

summary.core_problem: 这项工作想解决多智能体辩论推理的两个工程性限制：角色和通信拓扑通常是预先固定的，难以随问题复杂度动态切换；同时，多智能体系统往往需要多份模型实例，推理成本和延迟较高。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练的直接影响有限，更接近推理架构和参数高效微调方法。但它有一个有用的观察：MoE 的路由不一定只服务于容量扩展，也可以被设计成“推理过程控制器”，让不同专家承担提出、反驳、综合等功能。这个方向对研究 MoE 专家分工、推理时动态计算、以及多角色能力是否能内化到单模型里，有一定参考价值。贡献量级仍偏早期，关键还要看规模化训练和消融是否支持这些设计。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 Mixture-of-Debaters。它基于一个冻结的视觉语言骨干，在 Transformer 中插入轻量 MoD adapter，用来替代标准 LoRA 的单一路径低秩更新。标准 LoRA 是一个固定的低秩旁路，MoD 则把低秩模块拆成多个专家池，并通过动态路由选择专家。核心有三点。第一是 dual-routing，把“角色分配”和“流程控制”分开：一类路由决定当前 token 或局部上下文应由 proposer、critic 等角色专家处理，另一类路由决定当前阶段是继续辩论还是进入总结综合。这样做的动机是，辩论不是普通 MoE 的单一专家选择问题，角色和阶段是两个不同维度。第二是 momentum switching，用局部上下文聚合来平滑 token 级路由，减少专家在短片段内频繁切换。这个设计针对辩论场景很具体：如果模型在一句话中不断从支持方切到反驳方，推理轨迹会变得不连贯。第三是 unified self-debate，把多个辩论角色封装进同一个模型的专家模块，避免外部多模型编排和多轮通信。与传统多智能体辩论相比，它把“多角色交互”改成了模型内部的动态专家选择；与普通 MoE 相比，它显式区分了角色路由和阶段路由。
summary.experiments: 给定全文片段没有包含完整实验表、具体 benchmark、参数规模、训练数据规模和消融数字，因此不能确认实际增益幅度。能从方法描述中看出的关键实验应包括：与标准 LoRA、普通 MoE adapter、多模型辩论框架的比较；dual-routing 的消融；momentum switching 对路由抖动、专家持续性和答案质量的影响；以及 text-only 和 multimodal reasoning 场景下的成本—效果权衡。若缺少这些消融，方法的主要证据会停留在架构合理性层面。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。优先看 §3.1 的 MoD adapter 结构，尤其是 dual-routing 的数学定义和 momentum switching 如何计算；再看 §3.2 的指令微调数据，因为显式 viewpoint shift 监督会直接影响专家是否真的学到不同角色。实验部分如果完整可见，重点看三类消融：去掉流程路由、去掉角色路由、去掉 momentum smoothing。真正需要判断的是收益来自“辩论结构”，还是来自更大的 adapter 容量和额外指令数据。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses two practical limits of multi-agent debate systems: fixed role and communication patterns, and the cost of running multiple model instances to simulate debate.
summary_en.importance: The work is not a pretraining recipe, but it is relevant as an architectural probe into how MoE routing can be used for reasoning control rather than only for capacity scaling. It suggests that expert specialization can encode debate roles and reasoning stages inside one model. The idea is useful for thinking about MoE expert semantics, dynamic test-time computation, and whether multi-agent behaviors can be internalized by a single backbone. The current contribution should be treated as exploratory until larger-scale evidence and clean ablations are available.
summary_en.technical_approach: Mixture-of-Debaters builds on a frozen vision-language backbone and inserts lightweight MoD adapters in place of standard LoRA modules. A standard LoRA path provides one low-rank update; MoD replaces this with expert pools and dynamic routing. The main design choice is dual routing: one router handles role allocation, such as proposer or critic, while another controls the reasoning stage, such as debate versus synthesis. This separation matters because debate has at least two axes of control, and a single token-level MoE gate is a poor fit for both. The second component is momentum switching, which smooths routing decisions over local context. It is intended to prevent rapid expert flips that would make a debate trace incoherent. The third component is unified self-debate: instead of coordinating several external agents, the model stores debating personas in internal expert modules and activates them within one forward process.
summary_en.experiments: The provided full-text excerpt does not include complete experimental tables, model sizes, data scale, benchmark results, or ablation numbers. The key evidence to look for would be comparisons against standard LoRA, ordinary MoE adapters, and external multi-agent debate; ablations for role routing, stage routing, and momentum switching; and measurements of both reasoning quality and inference cost. Without these numbers, the method is best read as a plausible architecture proposal rather than a validated scaling result.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on §3.1 for the adapter design, especially the exact definitions of dual routing and momentum switching. Then check §3.2, because the instruction-tuning data with explicit viewpoint shifts may be doing a large part of the work. In the experiments, look for whether the gains survive removing role routing, stage routing, or smoothing. The central question is whether the improvement comes from debate-aware structure, or simply from extra adapter capacity and supervised debate-style data.

paper.title: Before Thinking, Learn to Decide: Proactive Routing for Efficient Visual Reasoning
paper.abstract: Large multimodal models have achieved strong reasoning on complex visual tasks, but their inference efficiency is often restricted by long chains of thought. Yet, the remaining bottleneck is to establish a reliable query difficulty

summary.core_problem: 在多模态视觉推理中，如何在不依赖“生成完长 CoT 后再看 token 概率”的滞后信号、也不依赖对采样分布敏感的 SFT 特殊 token 方案的前提下，提前判断样本难度并进行 draft/target 模型路由，从而降低推理成本。
summary.importance: 这篇更偏推理效率与路由策略，不是预训练主线。对预训练研究的间接启发在于：它把“难度/可解性”建模成可学习的评分头，并用 RL（GRPO）训练在生成前给出可用信号；这种“前置评分信号”如果迁移到 pretrain/posttrain 接口上，可能用于数据课程、动态采样或训练时的 compute routing（例如 MoE/early-exit 的数据侧信号）。但论文的核心贡献仍在推理阶段系统设计。
summary.technical_approach:
提出 Proactive Routing Paradigm (PRP)：在生成开始前就做路由。
- DRL (Draft Rating Learning)：让 draft 模型在不生成推理链的情况下，直接对输入给出“我能否解”的细粒度评分分布。
- JRL (Joint Rating Learning)：进一步同时预测 target 模型对该样本的适配度/收益，使路由不仅把难题交给大模型，也能把“大模型特别擅长”的样本交给它。
- 训练方法：使用 GRPO 风格的强化学习来学评分（全文应给出 reward 设计与采样细节）。
- 推理策略：基于评分的三阶段路由与排序策略；DRL 侧重置信分布，JRL 侧重 draft/target 的相对能力评估。
summary.experiments:
文中明确给出的数字：在 MathVista 上，JRL 路由达到 2.41× 加速，并且“略微超过更强的 target model”。此外作者在 MathVerse 等数据上展示 token-probability routing 与准确率相关性不成立（Fig.2 a/b），以及特殊 token 路由对正负轨迹采样分布敏感。
由于你提供的全文片段未包含完整实验表，draft/target 的具体模型规格、不同阈值下的 cost-accuracy 曲线、以及在更多基准上的稳定性需要到实验章节核对。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读即可，优先抓三块：
- Sec.2 的失败分析（为什么 token 概率与准确率在多模态长推理下脱钩；为什么特殊 token 路由对数据分布敏感）。
- DRL/JRL 的 reward 与训练细节（评分信号如何定义、如何避免学成“长度/格式”代理）。
- MathVista 的 cost-accuracy 曲线与路由阈值敏感性。预计 30–45 分钟能把方法与主要结论读清楚。

summary_en.core_problem: How to obtain a reliable, early difficulty/solvability signal for multimodal visual reasoning so that queries can be proactively routed between a small draft model and a large target model before generating long chains-of-thought, avoiding both post-hoc token-probability heuristics and SFT-based special-token routing that is sensitive to trajectory sampling.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an inference-efficiency/routing paper rather than pretraining. The pretraining-relevant takeaway is the framing of “instance difficulty / model suitability” as a learnable rating signal trained with RL, produced before generation. Similar signals could potentially inform curriculum sampling, compute-aware training, or data-conditioned routing (e.g., MoE/early-exit) at training time, but that is not the paper’s main focus.
summary_en.technical_approach:
They propose Proactive Routing Paradigm (PRP), making routing decisions at the start of generation.
- Draft Rating Learning (DRL): trains the draft model to output a fine-grained solvability/confidence distribution for an input without generating reasoning steps.
- Joint Rating Learning (JRL): additionally predicts the target model’s suitability/expected benefit, enabling routing based on both models’ strengths rather than only the draft’s uncertainty.
- Training uses a GRPO-style RL procedure (details depend on the full paper: reward definition, sampling, and stabilization).
- Inference uses score-based, multi-stage routing/selection strategies: DRL leverages confidence distributions; JRL leverages joint draft/target capability estimates.
summary_en.experiments:
A concrete number stated: on MathVista, JRL achieves 2.41× speedup while slightly outperforming the stronger target model. They also provide diagnostic evidence (e.g., on MathVerse) that mean token probability is not monotonically correlated with accuracy in multimodal long reasoning, and that special-token routing is sensitive to the distribution of correct/incorrect trajectories.
The excerpt does not include full result tables; you should verify model sizes, routing thresholds, and cost–accuracy trade-off curves in the experiments section.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim with focus:
- The failure analysis section explaining why token-probability routing breaks in multimodal long reasoning and why special-token routing is data-sensitive.
- The DRL/JRL training objective and reward design (to ensure the rating is not a proxy for length/format).
- The MathVista cost–accuracy curves and threshold sensitivity. About 30–45 minutes for a solid pass.

recommendation.zh: 看 cost-accuracy frontier 和失败路由分析；若 solvability 估计干净，可借鉴到推理计算分配。
recommendation.en: Read the cost-accuracy frontier and routing failures; if solvability is estimated cleanly, it informs test-time compute allocation.

paper.title: When Does Combining Language Models Help? A Co-Failure Ceiling on Routing, Voting, and Mixture-of-Agents Across 67 Frontier Models
paper.abstract: Multi-model LLM systems such as routing, voting, cascades, fusion, and mixture-of-agents are used to beat single-model accuracy. We show that their gain is capped by a quantity the field rarely reports. For any policy whose output is one member model answer, accuracy cannot exceed one minus beta, where beta is the rate at which every model is wrong on the same query. In contrast, the usual diagnostic, average pairwise error correlation rho, cannot identify beta: error laws with identical margina

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究多模型 LLM 系统什么时候真的能提升准确率。核心结论是，对于 router、vote、cascade 这类最终输出来自成员模型答案的策略，性能上限不是由平均两两错误相关性决定，而是由所有模型在同一问题上同时失败的比例 β 决定；准确率不可能超过 1−β。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对预训练本身不是方法贡献，但对模型评测、模型组合和服务层决策有明确价值。它提醒研究者：模型多样性不能只用 pairwise error correlation ρ 来判断。两个模型池可以有相同的边际错误率和相同的两两相关性，却有不同的共同失败率 β。对基座模型研究来说，这会影响如何衡量模型互补性、如何评估不同训练数据或训练路线带来的能力差异，以及如何判断多模型系统是否还有可实现的收益空间。
summary.technical_approach: 论文没有提出新的 routing 算法，而是给出一个上限分析和测量框架。设 β 为模型池中所有模型在同一 query 上都答错的概率。任何只从成员模型答案中选择输出的策略，包括 oracle router、learned router、majority vote 和 cascade，都无法在这些共同失败样本上答对，因此准确率上限为 1−β。相对于单一最强模型，oracle 可获得的最大增益等于“单一最强模型答错但至少一个其他模型答对”的概率，也就是 Pr[single-best wrong]−β。作者进一步证明，常用的平均两两错误相关性 ρ 不能识别 β：即使边际错误率和 pairwise correlation 一样，高阶共同失败结构仍可能不同。实用上，作者用 Clopper–Pearson 区间从一个带标注的 held-out query set 给出 β 的有限样本置信界，从而提前估计组合系统的最大可能收益。
summary.experiments: 实验分两层。第一层是预注册的 15 个当前模型、9 个 provider family，覆盖 frontier、mid、cheap 三档模型，在 GSM8K、MMLU、ARC-Challenge、MATH-500、MMLU-Pro 等 100 到 200 个问题规模的数据集上测试。第二层扩展到 67 个模型、21 个 provider family，来自 OpenRouter catalog，并加入更难的开放式数学与科学任务。主要观察是：oracle routing 的确存在正收益，但 learned router 几乎没有实现这些收益；随着模型池扩大，β 与 ρ 的差距会显现，ρ 往往低估共同失败带来的上限约束。作者还区分了两类场景：开放式数学更容易受到 ceiling-bound 限制，即很多强模型一起错；部分科学任务更像 realizability-bound，即理论上存在可选对的模型，但路由器难以识别。论文也提醒，共同失败样本的计数通常很小，因此有限样本置信界比点估计更可靠。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 30 到 40 分钟。优先看 Introduction 中关于 β ceiling 的定义和三个主张，再看 Problem Formulation 与 Proposition 1、Proposition 2。实验部分重点看 67 模型测量、oracle gain 与 learned router gain 的差距、β/ρ gap 随模型池大小变化的结果，以及 open-ended math 与 science 两类 regime 的对比。Appendix A 的 priced assignment、cost-aware fusion 和 cascade calibration 对做 serving 经济性分析的人有用；若只关心基座模型评测，可以略读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks when multi-model LLM systems actually improve accuracy. Its central point is that for policies whose final answer is one of the member models’ answers, such as routing, voting, and cascades, the hard ceiling is the all-model co-failure rate β. Accuracy cannot exceed 1−β.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining method paper, but it is useful for evaluation and model portfolio design. It gives a cleaner diagnostic for model complementarity than average pairwise error correlation. Pairwise correlation ρ can be identical across two model pools while the all-model failure probability β differs. For foundation-model research, this matters when comparing training recipes, data mixtures, or model families: apparent diversity at the pairwise level may not translate into recoverable gains under orchestration.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper provides an upper-bound and measurement framework rather than a new routing method. Let β be the probability that every model in the pool is wrong on the same query. Any policy that must output one member model’s answer is wrong on those queries, so its accuracy is upper-bounded by 1−β. The oracle improvement over the single best model is localized to Pr[single-best wrong]−β: the cases where the best model fails but at least one other model succeeds. The authors also show that average pairwise error correlation ρ does not identify β, because higher-order co-failure structure can vary even when marginal error rates and pairwise correlations are fixed. They use a Clopper–Pearson interval to turn one graded held-out query set into a finite-sample certificate on the largest possible gain.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical study has two scales. A pre-registered experiment uses 15 models from 9 provider families, grouped into frontier, mid, and cheap tiers, on GSM8K, MMLU, ARC-Challenge, MATH-500, and MMLU-Pro with roughly 100–200 queries per dataset. A larger measurement expands to 67 models across 21 provider families from the OpenRouter catalog and adds harder open-ended math and science domains. The main findings are that oracle routing gains are positive, but a learned router realizes little of them; the gap between β and what ρ would suggest becomes visible as the pool grows; and tasks split into different regimes. Open-ended math is often ceiling-bound because strong models fail together. Some science tasks are more realizability-bound: gains exist in principle, but the router struggles to pick the right model. The paper is careful that all-model-wrong counts can be small, so interval estimates matter more than raw point estimates.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 30–40 minutes. Read the Introduction for the β ceiling and the distinction from ρ. Then read the problem formulation and the statements around Proposition 1 and Proposition 2. In the empirical sections, focus on the 67-model measurement, the oracle-versus-learned-router gap, the β/ρ gap as pool size changes, and the contrast between open-ended math and science tasks. Appendix A is useful for serving economics, including priced assignment, cost-aware fusion, and cascade calibration; it can be skipped if the goal is only model evaluation.

recommendation.zh: 只看理论界限和开放数学实验即可；它会校正“多模型投票总能榨收益”的直觉，尤其是共同失败尾部。
recommendation.en: Read the ceiling proof and the open-math results; it usefully corrects the intuition that model voting always has exploitable headroom.

paper.title: SARA: Unlocking Multilingual Knowledge in Mixture-of-Experts via Semantically Anchored Routing Alignment
paper.abstract: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures have emerged as an increasingly influential paradigm as they offer a strategic balance between parameter scalability and computational efficiency. However, low-resource languages, which suffer from a scarcity of high-quality training data, often have their tokens routed to different experts than those predominantly activated by high-resource inputs, which limits cross-lingual expert sharing. This cross-lingual routing divergence consequently hinders

summary.core_problem: SARA 解决的是多语言 MoE 中的路由错配问题：低资源语言和高资源语言表达相同语义时，router 往往激活不同专家，导致低资源语言无法稳定调用高资源语言中已经学到的能力，尤其是推理和知识类能力。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对 MoE 预训练和持续训练有一定启发。它指出多语言能力差距不只来自参数中缺少知识，也可能来自 router 没有把语义等价输入送到同一组高能力专家。贡献量级偏方法增量，但问题定位清楚。它把优化目标从输出 logits 蒸馏转向路由分布对齐，对后续做 multilingual MoE、低资源语言扩展、router regularization 有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: SARA 使用高资源语言作为 semantic anchor，显式约束低资源语言输入的路由分布靠近高资源输入的路由分布。流程分三步。第一，构造语义严格对齐的平行指令数据，并用 correctness-based filtering 保证高资源 anchor 的推理结果可靠。第二，对高资源语言样本做离线前向，提取各 MoE 层的 router probability distribution，作为路由先验。第三，在微调时加入 Jensen-Shannon divergence 约束，使低资源语言样本在中间层的路由概率分布接近对应 anchor。它不同于常规 instruction tuning 或 logits distillation：优化对象不是最终 token 分布，而是 MoE 内部的专家选择逻辑。这样做的假设是，模型已经在高资源语言路径中形成较强专家组合，低资源语言主要需要学会触发这些路径。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 2 个 MoE 模型和 3 个多语言 benchmark。文中明确报告，在 Global-MMLU 上，Qwen3-30B-A3B 提升约 0.8 个百分点，Phi-3.5-MoE-instruct 提升约 1.2 个百分点，并优于标准 instruction tuning。结果幅度不大，但方向一致。关键消融应关注 JS 路由对齐相对于普通指令微调的增益、不同中间层施加约束的效果、以及高资源 anchor 质量对最终低资源表现的影响。由于摘要和正文片段给出的数字有限，具体语言维度和任务维度的增益需要在实验表中核对。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读为主，预计 30 分钟。重点看 Proposed Framework，尤其是 parallel instruction data 的构造、routing prior 的提取方式、JS divergence 约束施加在哪些层。实验部分建议看 Global-MMLU 等 benchmark 的主表，以及 ablation 中关于 router alignment、anchor language、layer selection 的结果。对做 MoE 预训练的人，最值得深挖的是 router 是否应该显式学习跨语言语义不变性，以及这种约束会不会损害专家专化和负载均衡。

summary_en.core_problem: SARA targets routing misalignment in multilingual MoE models. Semantically equivalent inputs in high-resource and low-resource languages often activate different experts, which prevents low-resource inputs from accessing expert pathways that already encode stronger reasoning or knowledge capabilities.
summary_en.importance: The work is relevant to MoE pretraining and continual adaptation. It frames multilingual degradation as a routing problem, not only a lack of parametric knowledge. The method is incremental in scale, but the diagnosis is useful: improving low-resource language performance may require aligning expert activation patterns, rather than only adding more multilingual data or distilling output logits.
summary_en.technical_approach: SARA treats high-resource languages as semantic anchors. It first builds a semantically aligned parallel instruction corpus and applies correctness-based filtering so that the anchor responses reflect reliable high-resource inference behavior. It then runs offline forward passes on the high-resource samples to collect router probability distributions across MoE layers. During fine-tuning, it adds a Jensen-Shannon divergence loss that pulls the routing distribution of the low-resource counterpart toward the distribution of the high-resource anchor. The main difference from standard instruction tuning or logit distillation is the training signal: SARA regularizes internal expert-selection probabilities rather than only the final output distribution. The underlying assumption is that competent experts already exist, while low-resource inputs fail to trigger them consistently.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses two MoE models and three multilingual benchmarks. The reported gains include about +0.8 percentage points on Qwen3-30B-A3B and +1.2 percentage points on Phi-3.5-MoE-instruct on Global-MMLU, outperforming standard instruction tuning. The gains are modest but consistent with the routing-alignment hypothesis. The most important ablations are the comparison against vanilla instruction tuning, the effect of applying JS alignment at intermediate layers, and the sensitivity to anchor quality. The provided text gives limited per-language details, so the exact distribution of improvements should be checked in the experimental tables.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim should take around 30 minutes. Focus on the proposed framework: how the parallel instruction data is filtered, how routing priors are extracted, and where the JS divergence constraint is applied. In the experiments, inspect the main multilingual benchmark tables and ablations on router alignment, anchor language choice, and layer selection. For MoE pretraining work, the main point to examine is whether routers should be explicitly regularized for cross-lingual semantic invariance, and whether such alignment interferes with expert specialization or load balancing.

recommendation.zh: 这类工作值不值钱，全看路由统计是否干净；先看 router entropy、expert overlap 和低资源增益是否同时成立，若成立，值得在 multilingual MoE 里做一次内部复现。
recommendation.en: This is only as good as its routing diagnostics; check expert overlap, router entropy, and low-resource gains together—if all hold, it is worth a direct multilingual MoE ablation.

paper.title: DART: Draft-Agreement Routing for Training-Free Adaptive Thinking Budgets in Hybrid Reasoning Models
paper.abstract: Hybrid reasoning models can answer directly or spend extra tokens on extended thinking. A practical router should choose between these modes for each query, so easy problems avoid unnecessary reasoning and hard problems receive enough budget to finish the answer. Existing routers move in this direction, but they typically require labeled training data or fix thinking budgets up front, ignoring answer-level evidence from the model itself. We introduce DART, a training-free routing framework that

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是 hybrid reasoning model 的推理预算分配问题：简单问题不应总是进入长思考模式，困难问题又需要足够预算完成推理和最终答案。
summary.importance: 这篇工作更偏推理与服务策略，不是预训练方法。它对基座研究的启发在于模型自身生成的短答案一致性可以作为难度和置信度信号。相比训练一个 router，DART 使用 NoThink draft 的一致性做决策，降低了对标注难度数据、模型特定微调和闭源接口权限的依赖。它也提醒评测 reasoning model 时要区分思考 trace 和最终答案的截断问题，否则 always-thinking baseline 可能被生成上限低估。
summary.technical_approach: DART 是一个无训练的两阶段路由框架。第一阶段 SC-Route 对同一问题采样 K 个 NoThink draft，论文主设定使用 K=2。系统先抽取每个 draft 的答案，再用任务相关的 equivalence function 判断是否等价。如果两个 draft 的答案一致，就直接接受 NoThink 答案；如果不一致，则认为该问题需要 Think 模式。第二阶段只作用于 disagreement cases：当模型提供 token log-probability 和可控 thinking budget 时，DART 用 draft entropy 预测查询级预算，把更多 token 分给不确定性更高的问题。这个设计的取舍很明确：Stage 1 只依赖文本输出，适合 API-only 模型；Stage 2 能进一步省 token，但需要更强的接口能力。
summary.experiments: 论文在 Qwen3 8B 到 32B 以及 DeepSeek-V3.2 上评估。作者报告，在主要比较中，DART 的准确率通常可以持平或超过 always-thinking，同时减少 thinking token。数学任务上，DART 在部分设置中相对 always-thinking 最高提升 9.0 个百分点，并减少 15% 到 69% 的 thinking token。代码任务中，在 execution-based equivalence 下，最高提升 22.5 个百分点，并减少 51% 到 63% 的 thinking token。监督 router 诊断实验显示，draft unanimity 比 entropy 或 draft length 更能预测 always-thinking 是否会答对。论文还指出，单次调用中把 reasoning trace 和 final answer 放在同一个生成上限下，会让 always-thinking 因答案未完整输出而被低估，附录 C 专门量化了这一评测伪差。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20 到 30 分钟。优先看方法部分的 Algorithm 1、SC-Route 的 K=2 unanimity 设计、answer extraction 与 equivalence function 的定义。实验部分重点看 token saving 与 accuracy 的 trade-off 表，以及数学和代码任务中 DART 相对 always-thinking 的结果。附录 C 值得快速看，因为它涉及 reasoning model 评测协议：如果思考和答案共享同一个 generation cap，结论可能混入截断效应。若关心 serving，可进一步看 Stage 2 的 entropy-to-budget 映射；若只关心 API 可用方案，Stage 1 已经是主要贡献。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies adaptive inference for hybrid reasoning models: the system should answer easy queries directly, while allocating enough thinking budget to queries that genuinely need extended reasoning.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly an inference-time routing paper, not a pretraining contribution. Its relevance to foundation-model research is the use of the model’s own short no-think drafts as a difficulty signal. DART avoids labeled difficulty data and model-specific router training, and it works with text-only APIs for its first stage. The paper also makes a useful evaluation point: always-thinking baselines can be underestimated when the reasoning trace and final answer share a tight generation cap.
summary_en.technical_approach: DART has two stages. Stage 1, SC-Route, samples K no-think drafts for the same query, with K=2 as the main setting. It extracts the answer from each draft and checks agreement using a task-specific equivalence function. If the drafts unanimously agree, DART accepts the direct answer. If they disagree, the query is routed to Think mode. Stage 2 applies only to routed queries. When log probabilities and budget controls are available, DART maps draft entropy to a query-specific thinking budget, giving more tokens to higher-uncertainty cases. The design separates a broadly usable text-only routing signal from an optional budget-allocation module that requires richer model access.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates DART on Qwen3 models from 8B to 32B and on DeepSeek-V3.2. In the main reported comparisons, DART often matches or exceeds always-thinking accuracy while using fewer thinking tokens. On math tasks, the best reported point estimate is a 9.0-point accuracy gain with 15% to 69% fewer thinking tokens. On code tasks, using execution-based answer equivalence, the reported gain reaches 22.5 points with 51% to 63% fewer thinking tokens. A supervised-router diagnostic finds that draft unanimity is more predictive than entropy or draft length. The paper also analyzes a truncation artifact in single-call evaluations, where extended reasoning can consume the generation cap before the final answer is emitted.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20 to 30 minutes. Read Algorithm 1 and the SC-Route section first, especially the strict unanimity rule, answer extraction, and equivalence checking. Then inspect the main accuracy-versus-token tables for math and code. Appendix C is useful for anyone evaluating reasoning models, because it explains how a shared generation cap can distort always-thinking baselines. For deployment use, focus on the entropy-to-budget mapping in Stage 2. For API-only use, Stage 1 is the central mechanism.

recommendation.zh: 这是干净的 test-time budget heuristic；先看 draft agreement 失败样例，若鲁棒可直接进内部 serving ablation。
recommendation.en: This is a clean test-time budget heuristic; read the draft-disagreement failure cases first, and if robust, it belongs in an internal serving ablation.

paper.title: How to Score Experts for One-Shot MoE Expert Pruning: A Unified Formulation and Selection Principle
paper.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models reduce per-token computation through sparse expert activation, yet deployment still requires storing the full expert pool, making one-shot expert pruning a practical approach for reducing memory usage. Although effective, existing criteria are largely heuristic, and no single criterion is universally optimal. Thus, establishing a principle for selecting pruning criteria suited to different deployment objectives remains an important yet largely underexplor

summary.core_problem: 解决 MoE 语言模型部署时虽然每 token 只激活少量专家，但仍需存储完整专家池，导致显存占用高的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 MoE 压缩和部署方法分析。它不是提出新的 MoE 架构，而是把 one-shot expert pruning 的打分准则统一到同一公式下，并给出面向不同部署目标的选择原则。
summary.technical_approach: 提出一个由三类因素构成的统一专家打分形式：routing frequency、gate weighting、activation strength。基于该形式，论文主张任务无关剪枝应偏向 routed-token-averaged、gate-free 的 activation-based 准则；任务特定剪枝则可以保留路由频率和 gate 权重信息。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 MoE 模型、参数规模、数据集和数值结果。实验应围绕 one-shot expert pruning 对不同打分准则的比较，目标是在减少专家存储的同时保持任务性能；论文声称统一公式还能推导出新准则。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the memory cost of deploying MoE language models: sparse activation reduces per-token compute, but the full expert pool still has to be stored.
summary_en.importance: This is a MoE compression and deployment analysis contribution. Rather than proposing a new MoE architecture, it unifies one-shot expert-pruning scoring rules and derives a criterion-selection principle for different deployment objectives.
summary_en.technical_approach: The unified formulation decomposes expert scores into routing frequency, gate weighting, and activation strength. It argues that task-agnostic pruning should favor routed-token-averaged, gate-free activation-based criteria, while task-specific pruning can benefit from preserving routing-frequency and gate-weight information.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify MoE model sizes, datasets, or numerical results. The experiments appear to compare one-shot expert-pruning criteria under memory reduction while preserving task performance, and the formulation is said to yield additional criteria.

recommendation.zh: 读准则统一公式和任务无关/任务特定分界即可；对 MoE serving 有用，但不会改变预训练路由设计。
recommendation.en: Read the unified scoring formula and the task-agnostic versus task-specific split; useful for MoE serving, unlikely to change pretraining router design.

paper.title: When Does Routing Become Interpretable? Causal Probes on Block Attention Residuals
paper.abstract: Block Attention Residuals (Block AttnRes) by replace fixed additive residuals with a learned softmax over earlier depth-source representations, surfacing cross-layer routing as an inspectable tensor in the forward pass. This is a tempting interpretability target: information flow normally inferred indirectly is now directly observable. We ask whether such exposure suffices for mechanistic interpretation. We probe two same-scale ($0.6$B) Block AttnRes checkpoints under identical routing-ablation

summary.core_problem: 检验 Block Attention Residuals 暴露出的跨层 routing 权重，什么时候真的能被解释为模型内部信息流，而不是结构或加载方式造成的伪信号。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制分析和因果 probing：它针对一种把 residual connection 改成 learned softmax routing 的架构，比较“推理时包一层 routing schedule”的伪 routing 与“从头训练 routing”的真实 routing，帮助判断可观测 routing tensor 是否具备解释价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者在两个同规模 0.6B checkpoint 上做相同 routing-ablation 干预：一个是 vanilla Qwen3 经 deterministic recency-bias schedule 包装成 routing-equivalent loading path，另一个是从头训练的 Block AttnRes Qwen3。分析重点是 routing 权重是否 content-independent、是否符合解析 schedule，以及训练后是否出现局部化 routing motifs。
summary.experiments: 实验使用两个 0.6B 规模模型。wrapped baseline 的 routing 权重与内容无关，并复现预设 recency schedule 的解析预测；从头训练的 AttnRes checkpoint 出现三类局部 routing motif，包括 embedding-source pathway through early-layer MLP、current-source 等模式。摘要未给出标准下游指标提升。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks when the routing weights exposed by Block Attention Residuals correspond to meaningful information flow rather than artifacts of the loading path or architectural wrapper.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic analysis of a routing-based residual architecture. It is relevant because observable routing tensors are tempting interpretability targets, but the paper tests whether visibility alone is enough for causal interpretation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The author compares two same-scale 0.6B checkpoints under identical routing-ablation interventions: a vanilla Qwen3 model wrapped at inference time with a deterministic recency-bias schedule that acts as a routing-equivalent path, and a Block AttnRes Qwen3 trained from scratch with routing optimized during training.
summary_en.experiments: The wrapped baseline shows content-independent routing weights matching the analytic schedule. The trained AttnRes checkpoint instead exhibits localized routing motifs, including an embedding-source pathway through early MLP layers and current-source routing patterns. The abstract does not report standard task-level gains.

recommendation.zh: 看 routing-ablation setup 就够了；结论别过读，但它很好地提醒“可见 routing”不等于可解释机制。
recommendation.en: Skim the routing-ablation setup; do not over-read the claims, but it usefully separates visible routing from interpretable mechanism.

paper.title: ARMOR-MAD: Adaptive Routing for Heterogeneous Multi-Agent Debate in Large Language Model Reasoning
paper.abstract: Multi-agent debate (MAD) can improve large language model reasoning, but fixed debate pipelines often waste computation and can amplify correlated errors among similar agents. We propose ARMOR-MAD, a training-free heterogeneous MAD framework that treats debate as conditional computation. ARMOR-MAD combines three components: Pre-debate Agreement Routing (PAR) decides whether independently generated Round-0 answers require debate; Early Agreement Stopping Evaluator (EASE) stops debate after conver

summary.core_problem: 固定轮数的多智能体辩论会浪费 test-time compute，并可能放大相似模型之间的相关错误。
summary.importance: 贡献是一个训练-free 的多智能体推理控制方法。它把辩论过程看作条件计算，尝试在准确率和推理成本之间做动态折中；对 test-time scaling 和 agentic reasoning 有参考意义，但不是基座预训练工作。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ARMOR-MAD，由三个模块组成：PAR 在辩论前根据初始答案一致性决定是否需要进入辩论；EASE 在辩论过程中检测收敛并提前停止；SOD 在最终聚合时下调语义离群答案的权重。方法强调异构模型池，而不是同质模型反复采样。
summary.experiments: 在 MATH Level 5、GSM8K、MMLU、MMLU-Pro 上，相比固定轮数异构 debate 提升准确率或效率，报告分数分别为 65.5%、96.5%、90.0%、81.5%。摘要未给出模型池组成、调用成本、统计显著性和每个模块的消融细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Fixed-round multi-agent debate wastes test-time compute and can amplify correlated errors among similar agents.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a training-free control method for multi-agent reasoning. It treats debate as conditional computation and attempts to trade off accuracy and inference cost dynamically. This is relevant to test-time scaling and agentic reasoning, but not directly to foundation pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: ARMOR-MAD has three components: PAR decides before debate whether independent round-0 answers warrant discussion; EASE stops the debate once agreement is reached; SOD down-weights semantic outlier answers during final aggregation. The method emphasizes heterogeneous model pools rather than repeated sampling from homogeneous agents.
summary_en.experiments: On MATH Level 5, GSM8K, MMLU, and MMLU-Pro, it improves over fixed-round heterogeneous debate and reports accuracies of 65.5%, 96.5%, 90.0%, and 81.5%, respectively. The abstract does not specify the model pool, inference cost, statistical significance, or full component ablations.

recommendation.zh: 只看 routing 和 early-stop 消融即可；这是 test-time compute 控制的小信号，不会改变预训练判断。
recommendation.en: Read only the routing and early-stop ablations; this is a small signal on test-time compute control, not a pretraining prior changer.

paper.title: DIRECT: When and Where Should You Allocate Test-Time Compute in Embodied Planners?
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly deployed as high-level planners for embodied agents, with an emerging strategy of scaling test-time compute to improve capability. However, we observe that doing so increases latency, token usage, and FLOPs while yielding uneven, often diminishing gains in downstream success, limiting where embodied agents can be deployed. We argue that choosing when and where to spend test-time compute is central to bringing frontier performance to the real world.

summary.core_problem: 具身规划中，将测试时算力（CoT 深度、模型大小、记忆历史）统一开高会显著增加延迟和 token 开销，但成功率提升并不均匀、很多场景甚至边际收益为负；问题在于每个任务应分配多少算力、沿哪条轴分配，而不是固定使用最强配置。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接启示是：test-time compute 不是单维杠杆，不同 compute axis 对应不同能力维度，且收益高度依赖任务分布。这里观察到的“大模型/thinking 模型在不少任务上并不优于小模型/非 thinking 模型”，与通用 LLM 推理中关于算力路由、预算分配、以及 post-train 后能力分布非单调的问题相通；也提醒做 planner/VLM 统一建模时，静态部署成本与能力边界需要被显式建模。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Direct（Dynamic Inference Router for Embodied Compute Tradeoffs），在一个固定的 planner 候选池上做逐任务路由。候选池沿三条轴变化：是否使用 thinking/更长 CoT、不同参数规模的 VLM（如 Qwen3-VL 2B 到 235B）、不同历史记忆策略（FrameSamp、TokenDrop、SimpleSG、GroundSG、MemER）。路由器根据多模态场景图像和指令输入，推断当前任务需要的是语义约束推理、更广技能覆盖、还是长历史依赖，再选择最划算的配置，而不是统一调用最强模型。设计动机来自一组诊断实验：三条 compute axis 的收益在任务间分布极不均匀，且没有单一配置 Pareto 占优。
summary.experiments: 在 VLABench、RoboMME 和 Franka DROID 真机上评估。诊断结果显示：Qwen3-VL 8B Instruct 与 Thinking 相比，在 44% 的任务上持平或更好，但 Thinking 延迟高很多，真机上慢 3.8 倍且总体成功率未必更高；模型从 2B 扩到 235B 时，分数和延迟都不单调，32B 因生成更长甚至比 235B 慢，大模型的优势主要集中在需要更宽技能覆盖的任务；记忆策略上，短历史任务中轻量 FrameSamp 比 MemER 更优，长历史依赖任务才反过来。Direct 在匹配最强模型性能的同时，报告最多降低 65% 延迟。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点看第 3 节关于三条 scaling axis 的诊断图和第 4 节 router 设计，尤其关注 Fig. 2–4 中不同 compute 配置的非单调表现。预计阅读时间 20–30 分钟。若更关心通用 LLM 的 test-time compute 路由，可跳过机器人系统细节，重点抽取“不同 compute 轴对应不同能力、且需要按任务选择”的经验事实。

summary_en.core_problem: In embodied VLM planners, uniformly scaling test-time compute—across CoT depth, model size, and memory history—substantially increases latency and token/FLOP cost, but downstream success gains are uneven and often diminishing; the real problem is deciding when and along which axis to allocate compute per task rather than always using the strongest planner.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance to pretrain research is that test-time compute is not a single axis: different compute levers map to different capability dimensions, and their returns are strongly task-dependent. The observation that larger or thinking models do not dominate smaller non-thinking models on a large fraction of tasks mirrors broader questions in LLM inference routing, budget allocation, and the non-monotonic capability profile produced by post-training. It is also a useful data point for unified multimodal planner modeling, where static deployment of one heavy model is rarely Pareto-optimal.
summary_en.technical_approach: Direct is a routing framework over a fixed pool of VLM planners. The pool varies along three axes: CoT depth (non-thinking vs thinking), model scale (e.g., Qwen3-VL from 2B to 235B), and memory-history strategy (FrameSamp, TokenDrop, SimpleSG, GroundSG, MemER). Given multimodal scene context and instruction, a lightweight router infers whether the task requires deeper reasoning over semantic/physical/spatial constraints, broader skill coverage from a larger model, or long-horizon memory, then selects the cheapest capable configuration. The design is motivated by diagnostic analyses showing that none of the compute axes gives uniform gains and no single planner dominates across task difficulties.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on VLABench, RoboMME, and Franka DROID hardware. Diagnostics show that Qwen3-VL 8B Instruct matches or outperforms the Thinking variant on 44% of tasks, while Thinking is 3.8× slower on hardware with no uniform success gain. Scaling from 2B to 235B yields non-monotonic score and latency; the 32B model can be slower than 235B because verbosity is not tied to parameter count, and gains are concentrated on tasks requiring broader command repertoires. For memory, lightweight FrameSamp outperforms MemER on short-recall tasks at much lower FLOPs, while MemER/GroundSG are better when distant history is needed. Direct is reported to match the strongest model at up to 65% lower latency.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the paper. Focus on Section 3 for the diagnostic analyses across the three compute axes and Section 4 for the router formulation; Figures 2–4 are the most information-dense parts. Estimated reading time: 20–30 minutes. Readers interested mainly in general LLM test-time compute can skip robot-specific system details and extract the empirical pattern that different compute levers serve different capability needs and should be selected conditionally.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改 pretrain recipe，但会改你对 test-time scaling 的先验：算力轴不是可互换的，只看固定大模型/长CoT曲线会误判，重点读三条 scaling 轴的拆分实验。
recommendation.en: It won’t change your pretraining recipe, but it should update your prior on test-time scaling: compute axes are not interchangeable, and fixed big-model/long-CoT curves can be misleading—read the axis-wise ablations.

paper.title: INFRAMIND: Infrastructure-Aware Multi-Agent Orchestration
paper.abstract: Existing multi-agent LLM orchestration methods, ranging from brute-force ensembles to learned routers, select models and topologies based on task and model features. However, these methods do not consider the runtime state of the serving infrastructure. On shared GPU clusters under concurrent load, this infrastructure blindness causes systematic resource underutilization: preferred models accumulate deep request queues while equally capable alternatives sit idle. In multi-agent pipelines, where

summary.core_problem: 多 agent LLM 编排通常只看任务和模型能力，不看服务基础设施的实时状态，导致共享 GPU 集群下延迟和资源利用率恶化。
summary.importance: 贡献偏系统侧，讨论的是 agent 编排与 serving 状态的耦合，而不是模型训练本身；对做大规模推理服务和在线评测的人有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 INFRAMIND，把基础设施信号纳入整个多 agent 栈：规划器在拓扑和角色选择时感知 infra 状态，路由器在每一步根据队列、KV-cache 压力和延迟做模型选择，调度器再联合优化执行顺序。
summary.experiments: 从摘要看，重点是在共享 GPU、并发负载和多步 agent pipeline 场景下比较 infra-aware 与 task-only orchestration 的吞吐和延迟；未见与预训练或模型能力提升直接相关的实验。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing multi-agent LLM orchestration ignores live serving-state signals, causing poor utilization and compounded latency on shared GPU clusters.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a systems contribution around agent orchestration and serving awareness rather than model training, but it is relevant to large-scale inference operations.
summary_en.technical_approach: INFRAMIND injects infrastructure signals into the full multi-agent stack: an infra-aware planner chooses topology and roles, a per-step router uses queue depth, KV-cache pressure, and latency signals, and a scheduler coordinates execution accordingly.
summary_en.experiments: Based on the abstract, the evaluation focuses on throughput and latency under concurrent shared-cluster settings for multi-step agent pipelines, not on pretraining or model-quality gains.

recommendation.zh: 更像 serving-aware agent orchestration，不是 pretrain 论文；若你管线上线或大规模评测，只看系统图和延迟分解就够了。
recommendation.en: This is serving-aware agent orchestration, not a pretraining paper; read it only if you care about deployment or large-scale eval latency breakdowns.

paper.title: From Observation to Intervention: A Causal Audit of Expert Importance in Mixture-of-Experts Models
paper.abstract: Interpretability methods routinely use population-level summary statistics over observed model behaviour to license claims about the effects of targeted interventions on specific computations; in Pearl's terms, they treat rung-1 associational evidence as if it supported rung-2 interventional conclusions, a move whose validity is rarely tested. We examine one concrete instance: the use of routing statistics in Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) pruning, where utilization rates, activation norms, and routin

summary.core_problem: 这篇文章要解决的问题很明确：MoE 剪枝里常用的 expert importance 指标，究竟是在描述“看起来常被用到的专家”，还是在预测“把这个专家拿掉后模型会不会真的变”。现有文献大量使用 utilization、activation norm、routing weight 分布这类观测统计来排序专家，再据此剪枝并微调恢复能力。但这些指标属于关联层面的证据，默认它们能外推到干预层面，即预测某个 expert 被消融后的功能损失。作者直接检验这个假设，问的是一个因果问题：观测到的路由统计，能否预测 token 级别的 expert ablation 效应。
summary.importance: 对预训练和模型设计研究，这篇工作的价值很高，原因有两层。第一，它不是单纯做 interpretability 争论，而是直接打到了 MoE 训练后分析和压缩方法的一个常用前提：很多 pruning pipeline 之所以看起来有效，未必是因为它们真的找到了不重要的 expert，而可能只是因为高冗余层里删谁都差不多。这个结论会影响 MoE 的容量利用、冗余分析、专家 specialization 评估，以及后续的稀疏化和蒸馏策略。第二，它把“观测统计”和“可干预功能”之间的断裂讲得很清楚。对做训练动态、路由机制、专家分工的人，这意味着不能再把 population-level routing summary 当成 expert causal importance 的替代品。量级上，这不是一个小修小补的负结果，而是对一类方法学假设的系统审计。
summary.technical_approach: 方法设计很干净。作者选了三类高冗余 MoE 语言模型：OLMoE-1B-7B-0924、Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B、DeepSeek-V2-Lite，覆盖了当下 MoE 设计中的几个主要维度，包括不同的 load balancing 目标、不同 top-k 激活比例、从头训练与 dense upcycling、以及是否有 shared experts。然后在每个模型的五个代表层上，针对四个经典观测指标做审计：expert utilization rate、activation norm、active 时的平均 routing weight、activation standard deviation。这些指标都先在语料上按 expert 聚合，属于典型的 population-level summary。真正的因果测量则是 token-aware per-expert ablation：对某个 token t 上被激活的 expert i，把该 expert 输出置零，测量该 token 位置的 loss change ΔL_i^(t)=L_t^(-i)-L_t，以及 residual stream displacement，也就是 gap norm δ_i^(t)=||y_t-y_t^(-i)||_2。前者衡量功能重要性，后者衡量表征层面的扰动。为了排除“统计量没信号只是因为实验功效不够”，作者还做了一个更强的 control：不用 population 平均指标，而是直接用该 token 上的 routing weight g_i(x_t) 作为排序依据。这个量是 token-conditioned 的，等于给 routing-derived family 一个更有利的上界测试。整个设计的关键在于把比较单位固定在同一 token、同一层、同一 expert 激活事件上，从而真正检验 observational ranking 是否能预测 interventional effect。
summary.experiments: 主结果很硬：在三个模型、五个层位、四类观测指标组成的 60 个 metric-layer 组合上，没有任何一个达到 Bonferroni 校正后的显著性。效应量整体都很小，Cohen's d 全部低于 0.17，而且不同层之间连符号都不稳定。这说明 utilization、activation norm、平均 routing weight、activation std 这些常见指标，对 token 级 expert ablation 的功能影响几乎没有预测力。作者还用 routing weight control 证明这不是样本量不足导致的假阴性：在完全相同的实验 machinery 和 n 下，token-conditioned routing weight 至少在一个设置里能恢复显著信号。具体是 OLMoE 的最后一个 MoE 层，d=+0.231，p=0.0013；而且该层 expert ablation 引起的 residual stream 位移大约是早期层的 40 倍。Qwen 和 DeepSeek-V2-Lite 没有出现类似的后层集中效应。文章还做了 progressive ablation，结论是现有 pruning 方法之所以常能工作，更多是因为早层冗余高，导致大多数选择准则彼此可替代，而不是因为这些观测指标真的识别出了可删专家。这个解释很关键，因为它把“pruning 有效”与“importance metric 有效”拆开了。
summary.reading_guide: 精读时先抓住引言里的两个结论边界：一个是 general 的 observational null，另一个是 narrow 的 OLMoE late-layer token-conditioned effect。然后重点看 setup 部分对两个因变量的定义：loss change 和 gap norm 分别回答什么问题，它们为什么都要报。实验部分建议按顺序看三类内容。第一，看主表和显著性检验，确认四个观测指标在三模型五层上的系统性失效。第二，看 routing weight control，判断作者是否充分排除了统计功效不足。第三，看 progressive ablation，理解为什么很多剪枝工作在经验上仍然能成功。若要深挖，值得关注的是 OLMoE 最后 MoE 层为什么出现集中效应：可能和 shared experts、训练 recipe、负载均衡目标、或后层 specialization 程度有关，但文章很克制，没有过度归因。图表上优先看 metric-layer 相关性/效应量图、late-layer residual displacement 对比，以及 progressive ablation 曲线。对做 MoE 的人，这篇最好连附录一起看，因为实验控制和统计处理决定了结论是否站得住。
summary.authors_note: 文中可确认的模型与机构背景包括 AllenAI 的 OLMoE、阿里的 Qwen1.5-MoE、DeepSeek 的 DeepSeek-V2-Lite。论文作者与所属机构在给定内容中未完整列出，无法可靠确认。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a precise causal question in MoE pruning: do standard expert-importance statistics identify experts whose removal actually matters, or do they merely describe experts that appear active in observational data? The pruning literature commonly ranks experts by utilization, activation norm, or routing-weight summaries, removes the lowest-ranked ones, and then fine-tunes. That workflow assumes associational routing statistics can predict the effect of an intervention. This paper tests that assumption directly at the token level.
summary_en.importance: This matters well beyond interpretability rhetoric. For pretraining and model-design work, it challenges a widely used premise behind MoE compression and redundancy analysis. If pruning pipelines succeed mainly because early MoE layers are highly redundant, rather than because the ranking metric truly identifies dispensable experts, then many conclusions about expert specialization, capacity allocation, and routing quality need to be revisited. The paper is valuable because it separates two claims that are often conflated: pruning can work, yet the importance metric used to choose experts can still be causally invalid. That is a meaningful methodological correction for anyone studying MoE training dynamics or expert specialization.
summary_en.technical_approach: The audit is clean and well targeted. The authors study three high-redundancy MoE LMs: OLMoE-1B-7B-0924, Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B, and DeepSeek-V2-Lite. These models span major MoE design choices: different load-balancing objectives, different top-k activation ratios, scratch training versus dense upcycling, and the presence or absence of shared experts. At five representative layers per model, they evaluate four standard observational metrics: utilization rate, activation norm, mean routing weight when active, and activation standard deviation. These are corpus-level expert summaries. They then compare them against token-level interventional effects using router-aware ablation. For an expert active at token t, they zero that expert’s output and measure the resulting next-token loss change, ΔL_i^(t), as the functional-importance target. They also report residual-stream displacement, the gap norm, as a representation-level effect size. To rule out lack of statistical power, they add a stronger control: instead of using population-averaged routing summaries, they use the token-conditioned routing weight g_i(x_t) itself. This gives routing-derived signals their best possible chance. The key design choice is that the comparison is made on the same token, layer, and active-expert event, so the paper is genuinely testing whether observational rankings predict interventional consequences.
summary_en.experiments: The main result is a strong null. Across 60 metric-layer combinations—four observational metrics, five layers, three models—none reaches Bonferroni-corrected significance. Effect sizes remain small throughout, with Cohen’s d below 0.17, and even the sign is not stable across layers. In other words, standard observational metrics have essentially no predictive value for token-level expert ablation effects in these models. The routing-weight control shows this is not a power issue: under the same machinery and sample size, token-conditioned routing weight recovers one Bonferroni-significant effect. It appears only in OLMoE, at the final MoE layer, with d = +0.231 and p = 0.0013. In that setting, expert ablation moves the residual stream by roughly 40 times more than in early layers. Qwen and DeepSeek-V2-Lite do not show a comparable late-layer concentration. The progressive-ablation analysis is also important: it suggests many pruning methods work because early layers are redundant enough that many selection criteria are interchangeable, not because the metrics truly identify causally unimportant experts.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the introduction carefully first, because it draws a useful boundary between two findings: a general observational null and a narrow late-layer effect in OLMoE under direct token conditioning. Then go to the setup and make sure the two targets are clear: loss change measures functional importance, while gap norm measures representational disturbance. In the experiments, focus on three pieces. First, the main significance and effect-size tables showing the failure of all four observational metrics across models and layers. Second, the routing-weight control, which is the paper’s answer to the obvious power objection. Third, the progressive-ablation results, which explain why pruning can still appear effective in practice. If you want to dig deeper, the most interesting open question is why OLMoE’s final MoE layer behaves differently. The paper is appropriately cautious there. For MoE researchers, this is worth reading closely, including the appendix, because the conclusion depends on careful intervention design and statistical treatment.
summary_en.authors_note: The paper explicitly studies models from AllenAI/OLMoE, Alibaba/Qwen, and DeepSeek. The full author list and affiliations are not recoverable from the provided text alone.

recommendation.zh: 应立刻对内部 MoE pruning 指标复现；若成立，utilization-based expert importance 基本只能当监控信号，不能当剪枝依据。
recommendation.en: This should be replicated on internal MoE pruning metrics; if it holds, utilization-based expert importance is only a monitoring signal, not a pruning criterion.

paper.title: BUDDY: BUdget-Driven DYnamic Depth Routing for Adaptive Large Language Model Inference
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) incur high inference cost due to their depth and parameter scale. Depth pruning can reduce latency by skipping redundant Transformer blocks, but existing methods (i) provide limited control under user-specific compute budgets and (ii) typically fix the routing path, failing to adapt as the context grows during decoding. We propose Buddy, a budget-driven dynamic depth routing framework. Buddy uses a lightweight Decision Module to score intermediate layers conditioned

summary.core_problem: 在不显著牺牲生成质量的前提下，让 LLM 推理时能按“用户给定算力预算”动态跳层，并且在解码过程中随上下文变化自适应路由。
summary.importance: 属于推理侧的“动态深度/早退”路线，但把“预算可控”与“decode-time 自适应”作为核心约束来做，直接对应线上 serving 的成本-质量控制问题。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Buddy：用轻量 Decision Module 对各层打分，在每步推理中确定性选择 top-k 层执行以满足预算；为降低解码阶段路由开销，复用第一层 KV cache 作为全局上下文特征，并与最新 token 表示池化后再做路由决策；可选 Budget Predictor 在未给定预算时预测输入相关的计算量，实现自动的质量-成本折中。
summary.experiments: 在 Llama-family 与 Qwen 模型上评测（摘要未给出具体规模/数据与完整指标）；对比深度剪枝/固定路由等基线，主张在相同或更低计算下保持更好的质量-延迟折中，并展示随解码步数动态调整路径的效果。

summary_en.core_problem: Enable budget-controlled, decode-time adaptive layer skipping for LLM inference without large quality loss as context grows during generation.
summary_en.importance: A practical take on dynamic-depth/early-exit inference, explicitly targeting per-request compute budgets and step-wise adaptation—two constraints that matter in real serving.
summary_en.technical_approach: Buddy uses a lightweight decision module to score layers and deterministically executes the top-k layers to meet a given budget. For low-overhead decode-time adaptation, it reuses the first-layer KV cache as a global context feature and pools it with the newest token representation before each routing decision. An optional budget predictor estimates an input-dependent compute level when no budget is provided.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on Llama-family and Qwen models (abstract does not specify sizes/datasets/metrics). Compared against depth pruning and fixed routing baselines, reporting improved quality–latency trade-offs and demonstrating dynamic routing across decoding steps.

recommendation.zh: 把“预算约束”做成一等公民且支持 decode-time 动态路由，适合对照你们线上早退/跳层方案；重点看路由特征用首层 KV 的设计是否真能跨任务泛化。
recommendation.en: Treats compute budget as a first-class constraint and supports decode-time routing; worth comparing to your early-exit setup—focus on whether the first-layer-KV feature actually generalizes across tasks.

paper.title: WAV: Multi-Resolution Block Residual Routing for Deep Decoder-Only Transformers
paper.abstract: Residual connections are central to training deep Transformers, but standard PreNorm residual streams aggregate sublayer updates with fixed unit weights. Recent Attention Residuals replace this fixed accumulation with content-dependent depth-wise routing, and Block Attention Residuals make the mechanism efficient by routing over block-level residual summaries. However, a single block summary stores only the low-frequency total residual displacement inside a block, discarding directional structur

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的是深层 decoder-only Transformer 里残差流如何聚合的问题。标准 PreNorm 残差把每个子层更新都以固定权重 1 直接加到 residual stream 上，深度上去以后，信息会越来越像“无差别累加”，单层贡献被稀释。Attention Residuals 试图用内容相关的 depth-wise routing 代替固定累加，Block Attention Residuals 再把路由粒度从层级压缩到 block 级，降低开销。但作者指出，单个 block summary 只保留了块内所有更新的总和，相当于只保留低频分量，丢掉了块内轨迹的方向结构，比如 attention 与 MLP 谁主导、块前半段与后半段是否朝不同方向走。论文要解决的核心问题，就是在不回到昂贵 layer-wise routing 的前提下，给 block-level residual routing 补上足够便宜、但更有表达力的块内结构信息。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在架构与训练稳定性，而不是直接给出一个可立即迁移到大模型的 recipe。它提出了一个值得注意的视角：残差流不只是“累积了多少”，还包含“怎么走到这里”的轨迹信息；当网络很深时，这种轨迹信息可能越来越重要。这个视角对做深层 Transformer、替代残差机制、以及 depth scaling 的人有参考价值。不过当前证据还比较早期，实验只在 TinyStories 和 Text8 这类小规模字符级语言建模上，离大规模 LLM 还有明显距离。因此它更像一个结构性想法的初步验证，而不是已经成熟的基座模型方案。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 WAV v1，是对 Block AttnRes 的轻量扩展。原始 Block AttnRes 对每个 block 只存一个 summary C_b，即块内所有子层残差更新的和。WAV v1 在此基础上再加两个 zero-sum detail basis。第一个是 phase basis，记作 D_phase，用 attention 子层更新和 MLP 子层更新的带符号差来表示，捕捉这个 block 更偏 attention 还是更偏 MLP。第二个是 split basis，记作 D_split，用块前半段更新和后半段更新的带符号差来表示，捕捉 early-vs-late 的粗粒度方向变化。这样，一个 block 不再只有“总位移”，还多了两个描述块内轨迹形状的方向基。作者很克制地处理了训练稳定性问题。首先，detail source 在路由 mixer 中带负初始化偏置 beta_D=-2，使模型初始行为接近 Block AttnRes，只有在确实有用时才逐渐启用 detail。其次，对 detail tensor 做 RMS matching，并用最大缩放因子 rho 限制其幅度，避免 detail 只是因为尺度更大而被路由器偏好。最后，最终 prediction mixer 默认不读取 detail source，只让中间层路由使用这些细节信息。这样做的目的很明确：尽量把新机制限制在 block-level routing 上，而不去改动 attention、MLP、embedding 和 output head 的主体功能。复杂度上，路由源从 O(N) 个 block summary 增加到大约 O(3N) 个 block-basis source，但仍是 block-level，而不是回到 layer-level 全历史路由；额外参数也很少，每层只多几个标量 bias。
summary.experiments: 实验规模不大，但结果模式比较清楚。作者在 12、24、48 层 GPT decoder-only 模型上，用 TinyStories 和 Text8 做验证。结论是明显的深度依赖：12 层时，WAV v1 还不如 Block AttnRes，说明浅层网络里块内方向细节未必值得建模，甚至可能带来不必要自由度；24 层时，两者接近；48 层时，WAV v1 在两个数据集上都最好，同时明显优于 ReZero 和 LayerScale。这个趋势支持作者的核心假设：随着 residual trajectory 变长，只存 block sum 已经不够，块内轨迹的多分辨率信息开始变得有用。摘要没有给出具体 loss 数字，正文片段也未展示完整表格，因此很难判断提升幅度是否足以支撑更大规模迁移。但至少从实验设计看，作者是在比较不同残差机制，而不是混入太多其他变量，这让结论相对干净。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时建议先看引言前两页，理解作者为什么把 block residual routing 重新表述成 multi-resolution representation 问题。然后直接看方法里 C_b、D_phase、D_split 的定义，以及 detail bias 和 RMS matching 这两个稳定化设计；这几处就是全部创新点。最后看 12/24/48 层的结果表，重点不是绝对分数，而是深度变化下的相对排序是否稳定。预计 15 到 20 分钟可以读完并形成判断。如果你关心的是大模型可迁移性，这篇不需要深挖太久；如果你在研究深层 Transformer 的残差机制或 depth scaling，可以把它当成一个值得记住的结构假设，再等更大规模验证。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a structural limitation in residual aggregation for deep decoder-only Transformers. Standard PreNorm residual streams simply add every sublayer update with fixed unit weight. As depth grows, this can dilute layer-specific contributions and make the residual trajectory increasingly redundant. Attention Residuals replace fixed accumulation with content-dependent depth-wise routing, and Block Attention Residuals make that idea cheaper by routing over block summaries instead of all previous layers. The authors argue that a single block summary is still too coarse: it preserves only the total displacement inside a block and discards directional structure such as attention-versus-MLP imbalance or early-versus-late block dynamics. The core problem is therefore how to enrich block-level residual routing with cheap intra-block trajectory information without returning to expensive layer-wise routing.
summary_en.importance: The main value is conceptual rather than immediately recipe-level for large-scale pretraining. It suggests that residual streams should not be viewed only through total accumulated magnitude, but also through the path taken within a block. That perspective is relevant to deep Transformer design, residual alternatives, and depth scaling. At the same time, the evidence is still preliminary: experiments are limited to small character-level language modeling settings such as TinyStories and Text8. So this is better read as an early architectural hypothesis with some clean supporting evidence, not yet as a mature foundation-model design.
summary_en.technical_approach: WAV v1 is a lightweight extension of Block AttnRes. In Block AttnRes, each block stores only a summary C_b, the sum of all residual updates inside the block. WAV v1 keeps this summary and adds two zero-sum detail bases. The first is a phase basis, D_phase, defined by the signed difference between attention and MLP updates, capturing whether the block is more attention-dominant or MLP-dominant. The second is a split basis, D_split, defined by the signed difference between the first-half and second-half updates in the block, capturing coarse early-versus-late directional change. This gives each block not only a total displacement but also two cheap descriptors of its internal trajectory shape. The stabilization choices are conservative. Detail sources are initialized with a negative routing bias, beta_D = -2.0, so the model starts close to Block AttnRes and only uses details when useful. Detail tensors are RMS-matched to the corresponding block summary and clipped by a maximum scale factor rho, preventing them from dominating merely due to larger raw scale. The final prediction mixer does not read detail sources by default; they are used only in intermediate routing. The attention, MLP, embeddings, and output head remain unchanged. Computationally, the number of routing sources grows from about O(N) block summaries to about O(3N) block-basis sources, still block-level rather than layer-level, and the parameter overhead is negligible.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments are small but the pattern is clear. The authors evaluate 12-, 24-, and 48-layer GPT-style decoder-only models on TinyStories and Text8. The main finding is strongly depth-dependent. At 12 layers, WAV v1 underperforms Block AttnRes, suggesting that intra-block directional detail is not useful, or not worth the extra flexibility, when the residual trajectory is short. At 24 layers, it becomes competitive. At 48 layers, WAV v1 is consistently the best on both datasets and clearly outperforms ReZero and LayerScale. This trend supports the paper’s central claim that multi-resolution residual information becomes more valuable as depth increases. The excerpt does not include exact validation-loss numbers, so it is hard to judge the absolute effect size or likely transfer to large-scale LLMs. Still, the comparisons are relatively clean because the paper is isolating residual mechanisms rather than changing many other ingredients at once.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, start with the introduction and focus on the reframing of block residual routing as a multi-resolution representation problem. Then read the method definitions of C_b, D_phase, and D_split, along with the two conservative stabilization devices: negative detail bias and RMS matching. Those are the actual innovations. Finally, inspect the 12/24/48-layer result tables and focus on the depth-dependent ranking rather than the absolute losses. Around 15 to 20 minutes should be enough. If your main question is large-model transfer, there is not much to mine beyond the core idea. If you work on deep Transformer residual design or depth scaling, this is a useful architectural hypothesis to keep in mind and revisit when larger-scale evidence appears.

recommendation.zh: 残差路由方向有新意，但单作者、实验规模不明，可信度受限。只看方法部分（§3）了解相位基/分裂基设计即可，不必复现。
recommendation.en: Novel direction in residual routing but single-author work with unclear experimental scale; limited credibility. Read §3 only for the phase/split basis design idea; do not reproduce.

paper.title: From Sampled Outcomes to Capability Distributions: Rethinking Supervision for LLM Routing
paper.abstract: Existing LLM routing methods typically treat a model's single response to a query as its capability label for training routers. However, because LLM generation is inherently stochastic, such single-shot supervision provides only a noisy observation of a query-model pair's behavior rather than a reliable capability estimate. We show that this assumption introduces systematic noise into routing supervision, making learned routing policies less reliable. To address this issue, we propose DARS (Dist

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM路由方法将模型对查询的单次响应作为能力标签训练路由，但LLM生成具有内在随机性，单次采样是噪声观测而非可靠能力估计。
summary.importance: 首次从模型行为的分布视角构建路由监督信号，纠正了现有路由框架中单样本监督的系统性偏差；对混合专家和模型路由的监督质量有直接启示。
summary.technical_approach: 提出DARS（分布感知路由监督）框架：从输入端（语义等价查询表述）和输出端（随机生成）两个维度考虑不确定性，基于分布感知观测构建更可靠的路由监督信号。
summary.experiments: 在多种路由任务和数据集上进行实验（摘要未给出具体模型规模和数值结果，仅说明有效性）。
summary.authors_note: Zhenguo Li (华为诺亚方舟，资深研究员)。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM routing methods treat a model's single response as its capability label, but LLM generation is inherently stochastic, making single-shot supervision a noisy observation rather than a reliable capability estimate.
summary_en.importance: First framework to construct routing supervision from a distributional view of model behavior, correcting the systematic bias in single-sample supervision; has direct implications for MoE routing and model routing quality.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes DARS (Distribution-Aware Routing Supervision): considers uncertainty from both input side (semantically equivalent query formulations) and output side (stochastic generations), building more reliable supervision signals for routing.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments across diverse routing tasks and datasets (specific model sizes and numbers not in abstract, only stated as effective).
summary_en.authors_note: Zhenguo Li (Huawei Noah's Ark Lab, senior researcher).

recommendation.zh: 单次响应作为监督确实是路由/RL中普遍被忽略的噪声源，DARS的分布视角有启发但论文未给出大规模实验；作为literature备查，不必读正文。
recommendation.en: Single-response-as-supervision is indeed a widely ignored noise source in routing/RL; DARS's distributional view is insightful but lacks large-scale experiments; reference only, skip the full text.

paper.title: IR3DE: A Linear Router for Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Foundational Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate proficiency on a wide range of general tasks, and achieve remarkable results on various specialized tasks via domain-expert LLMs. With the ever-growing list of available LLMs, inference routers are being proposed to select the most appropriate LLM for each prompt. However, existing routing methods either optimize cost across weak-to-strong generalist LLMs or require substantial training to support domain-expertise routing. In this paper, we p

summary.core_problem: 解决多专家 LLM 场景下，如何用极低训练和推理成本把 prompt 路由到合适领域模型的问题。
summary.importance: 这是一个路由系统小方法，价值在于用很简单的线性模型做 domain-expert routing。对基座预训练的直接启发有限，但对 MoE 外部路由、模型池编排和 cheap gating 有一点参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 IR3DE，用 ridge regression 作为 prompt router，在多个候选 LLM 间做域专家选择。作者强调其训练便宜、推理快，并在因果语言建模和 reasoning 设定下比较不同路由基线。
summary.experiments: 在两个 CLM 路由设定和一个 reasoning 路由设定中，线性路由器达到与其他基线相近的效果，并在 reasoning 设定中更强。摘要未给出模型规模、候选专家数量和具体提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to route prompts to the right domain-expert LLM with very low training and inference cost.
summary_en.importance: This is a lightweight routing paper. Its main value is showing that a very simple linear model can work for domain-expert routing. The direct relevance to pretraining is limited, though it may be mildly useful for thinking about external MoE-style gating.
summary_en.technical_approach: IR3DE uses ridge regression as a prompt router to select among candidate LLMs. The emphasis is on cheap training and fast routing, evaluated in causal language modeling and reasoning settings.
summary_en.experiments: Across two CLM routing setups and one reasoning setup, the linear router is reported to be competitive with baselines and better in the reasoning setting. The abstract does not provide model sizes, number of experts, or exact gains.

recommendation.zh: 像是外部模型池的 cheap gating，不是基座训练问题；若你关心 router complexity，看看线性基线能打到哪就够了。
recommendation.en: This is cheap gating for an external model pool, not a foundation-training result; only worth a quick look if you care how far a linear router can go.

paper.title: Eigenvectors of Experts are Training-free Non-collapsing Routers
paper.abstract: Sparse Mixture of Experts (SMoE) architectures improve the training efficiency of Large Language Models (LLMs) by routing input tokens to a selected subset of specialized experts. Despite their remarkable success, both training and inference in SMoE models suffer from the expert collapse issue (Chi et al., 2022), which degrades model performance. Prior studies primarily focus on improving the router; however, such methods rely on training from scratch or fine-tuning, which requires high computat

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文处理的是已预训练 Sparse MoE 模型中的路由坍缩问题：即使模型已经完成大规模训练，router 仍可能把大量 token 偏向少数专家，导致专家利用不均、表示冗余和性能损失。作者进一步追问一个更具体的问题：在不重新训练 router、不微调模型的情况下，能否直接利用专家 FFN 权重自身的信息来完成路由。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在 MoE 机制分析和训练后诊断。它不是一个新的 MoE 预训练 recipe，但给出了一种观察专家结构的角度：专家权重的谱结构可能已经编码了可用于路由的语义方向。这个结论如果稳定成立，会影响两类问题：一是 MoE 训练中如何理解专家分化，二是预训练完成后如何做 router 替换、专家裁剪和 serving 侧的内存优化。需要注意的是，它没有直接解决训练过程中的 router collapse，只是提出了一个 training-free 的替代路由和专家删除方案。
