summary.technical_approach: 方法称为 SSMoE。核心做法是对每个专家的 FFN 权重矩阵做 SVD，抽取主要奇异向量作为专家表示，再用 token hidden state 与这些谱向量之间的匹配关系来选择专家。传统 MoE 依赖一个学习得到的 router embedding 或 gating projection，token 分配由 router logits 决定；SSMoE 则把专家权重本身视为专家语义的来源，因此不需要额外训练 router。作者的动机是：router embedding 可能在训练后仍然坍缩，但不同专家的 FFN 权重矩阵中保留了更丰富的方向信息。论文还基于谱表示提出 expert dropping：用专家谱表示衡量冗余或贡献，删除部分专家以降低显存占用。与 XMoE、SimSMoE、VQMoE 等需要训练或改路由学习过程的方法不同，SSMoE 的卖点是直接作用于已有模型。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖多个已训练 MoE 模型，规模从 4B 到 120B，包含 PhiMoE-Tiny、OLMoE、Qwen1.5-MoE、DeepSeek-MoE，以及 GPT-OSS-20B、GPT-OSS-120B、ERNIE-4.5、Qwen3-MoE 的 Instruct、Think、Next 变体。作者报告这些模型都存在不同程度的 router collapse。SSMoE 在 LLM、reasoning model、VLM 场景，以及 clean 和 corrupted data 上测试。论文声称在 GPT-OSS 系列上平均提升约 6%，同时通过 expert dropping 降低约 23% 内存占用。由于给出的内容没有展开具体 benchmark、perplexity、token-level load balance、延迟开销和各层消融，阅读时应重点核对提升来自路由替换、专家删除，还是任务选择和评测协议。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。优先看三个部分：第一，router collapse 的实证图，确认作者如何定义 collapse，是否按层、按专家、按 token domain 统计；第二，SVD expert representation 的构造细节，尤其是 FFN1/FFN2 的奇异向量如何聚合、如何与 hidden state 匹配、top-k 选择是否保持原模型计算图一致；第三，expert dropping 的消融，特别是删除比例、性能曲线和显存统计口径。若只关心预训练，可把它当作 MoE 训练后分析工具，而不是直接的预训练方法。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies router collapse in pretrained Sparse MoE models. Even after large-scale training, the learned router can still send a disproportionate number of tokens to a small subset of experts. The specific question is whether routing can be recovered without retraining or fine-tuning, by using the internal structure of expert weights themselves.
summary_en.importance: The main value for pretraining research is diagnostic rather than procedural. It suggests that expert FFN weights may contain semantic directions that are usable for routing, even when the learned router embeddings are collapsed. If the observation holds broadly, it is relevant to MoE interpretability, expert utilization analysis, post-training router replacement, expert pruning, and memory-aware serving. It should not be read as a solution to train-time collapse; it is a training-free retrofit for already trained MoE models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed method, SSMoE, performs SVD on each expert’s FFN weight matrices and uses the resulting singular/eigenvector directions as expert representations. Token hidden states are matched against these spectral expert representations to select experts, replacing or bypassing the learned router. The key distinction from standard MoE routing is the source of the expert embedding: standard routers learn a projection or gating vector, while SSMoE derives expert semantics from the expert parameters. The paper also introduces an expert dropping procedure based on these spectral representations, aiming to remove redundant experts while preserving or improving task performance. Compared with router-training methods such as XMoE-style improvements or discrete-routing variants like VQMoE, the method requires no additional training.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation spans pretrained MoE models from 4B to 120B parameters, including PhiMoE-Tiny, OLMoE, Qwen1.5-MoE, DeepSeek-MoE, GPT-OSS-20B, GPT-OSS-120B, ERNIE-4.5, and Qwen3-MoE variants. The authors report that all inspected models show router collapse to varying degrees. SSMoE is tested on LLMs, reasoning models, and VLMs, under both clean and corrupted inputs. The paper reports an average improvement of about 6% on GPT-OSS models and about 23% memory reduction through expert dropping. The provided content does not include enough detail on benchmark composition, perplexity, layer-wise load balance, latency, or ablation tables, so these claims should be checked against the experimental section before drawing strong conclusions.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim read should take about 20–30 minutes. Focus first on the router-collapse measurements: how collapse is defined, whether it is measured per layer, per expert, and across domains. Then inspect the construction of spectral expert representations: which FFN matrices are decomposed, how singular vectors are selected and aggregated, and how token-to-expert matching is implemented. Finally, read the expert-dropping ablations, especially the deletion ratio versus performance and memory curves. For pretraining researchers, the useful part is the MoE analysis signal, not a new training recipe.

recommendation.zh: MoE 路由从 expert 权重谱结构取信号这个 prior 值得测；先看实验是否覆盖真实预训练 MoE。
recommendation.en: Routing from expert spectral structure is a testable prior; first check whether the experiments use real pretrained MoE backbones.

paper.title: Meta-Attention: Bayesian Per-Token Routing for Efficient Transformer Inference
paper.abstract: Standard transformer architectures apply a single attention mechanism uniformly across all tokens and sequence positions, irrespective of local context or computational budget. We propose Meta-Attention, a framework that dynamically routes each token to the most appropriate attention strategy -- full softmax attention, linear (kernel) attention, or sliding-window local attention -- via a Bayesian Meta-Controller. Unlike prior routing approaches that use deterministic or prior-free learned routin

summary.core_problem: 标准Transformer对所有token统一使用同一种注意力机制，无法按需分配算力，现有高效注意力方法在架构设计阶段就固定单一算法，无法兼顾长程依赖精度和整体推理效率。
summary.importance: 提出了token级动态选择注意力机制的贝叶斯路由框架，为推理效率优化提供了可解释、算力可调控的新路径，也为稀疏激活架构的路由设计提供了参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Meta-Attention架构，将每个token的注意力机制选择建模为贝叶斯后验推断问题：内置全注意力、线性核注意力、滑动窗口注意力三个专家，通过2层MLP参数化的变分后验输出每个token的路由概率，同时加入编码算力偏好的狄利克雷先验（算力越高的机制先验权重越低），用ELBO目标训练路由控制器，支持软路由和基于不确定性阈值的硬路由，还验证了该方法与MoD（Mixture of Depths）架构正交可组合。
summary.experiments: 在Tiny LM上的消融实验显示，硬路由下贝叶斯控制器的归一化FLOP成本为25.1%，仅为无先验基线的42.3%（降低2.4倍），同时路由熵更低（43.3% vs 55.8%），在不损失任务性能的前提下避免了路由坍缩到高成本的全注意力机制，原型已验证前向传播正确性、后验多样性和校准指标。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看Introduction中对现有高效注意力缺陷的定位、架构部分的狄利克雷先验设计、Tiny LM的消融实验结果，预计阅读时间25分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Standard Transformers apply the same attention mechanism to all tokens uniformly without on-demand compute allocation, and existing efficient attention methods fix a single algorithm at architecture design time, failing to balance long-range dependency accuracy and overall inference efficiency.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a Bayesian routing framework for per-token dynamic attention mechanism selection, providing an interpretable, compute-adjustable path for inference efficiency optimization, and reference for routing design in sparse activation architectures.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces Meta-Attention, which formulates per-token attention mechanism selection as Bayesian posterior inference. It includes three attention experts: full softmax attention, linear kernel attention, and sliding-window local attention. A 2-layer MLP parameterizes the amortized variational posterior to output per-token routing probabilities, with a compute-aware Dirichlet prior that assigns lower prior weight to more compute-heavy mechanisms. The controller is trained with an ELBO objective, supporting both soft routing and hard routing gated by per-token uncertainty. The work also confirms the approach is orthogonal and composable with Mixture of Depths (MoD) architectures.
summary_en.experiments: Ablation on Tiny LM shows that under hard routing, the Bayesian controller achieves 25.1% normalized FLOP cost, only 42.3% of the prior-free baseline (2.4x reduction), with lower routing entropy (43.3% vs 55.8%). It avoids routing collapse to expensive full attention without task performance degradation. The PyTorch prototype has validated forward-pass correctness, posterior diversity, and calibration metrics.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the positioning of limitations of existing efficient attention in Introduction, the Dirichlet prior design in the architecture section, and ablation results on Tiny LM. Estimated reading time: 25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 贝叶斯路由视角新鲜，ELBO联合优化性能与成本的思路值得在推理效率研究中参考，重点看§3方法。
recommendation.en: The Bayesian routing perspective is fresh; the ELBO joint optimization of performance and cost is worth noting for inference efficiency research. Focus on §3.

paper.title: Skill0.5: Joint Skill Internalization and Utilization for Out-of-Distribution Generalization in Agentic Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Equipping large language models with explicit skills has emerged as a promising paradigm for enabling autonomous agents to solve complex tasks. Agent skills can be inherently divided into general skills for broad cognitive transfer and task-specific skills for dynamic execution. However, existing skill-based reinforcement learning (RL) methods typically force a rigid choice between full externalization, which incurs prohibitive context overhead, and full internalization, which risks overfitting

summary.core_problem: 解决 agentic RL 中“技能应内化到模型参数里，还是外置到上下文里”这一两难：前者易过拟合和冲突，后者带来上下文开销，进而影响 OOD 泛化。
summary.importance: 属于 agent 后训练方法创新，不是基座预训练工作本身，但它讨论了参数内化与上下文利用的分工，这对 pretrain/post-train 接口、技能蒸馏和长期能力沉淀有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Skill0.5 框架，把技能分成通用技能与任务特定技能两类，并由一个动态、难度感知的路由器决定处理方式：通用技能通过 privileged distillation 内化进模型，作为困难任务的认知底座；任务特定技能则保留为外部可调用资源，通过诊断式策略进行利用，而不是一刀切地全部写进参数或全部放在上下文中。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、训练 token 或基线细节。可确认的是，论文在 OOD generalization 场景下比较了全外置、全内化以及其混合方案，主张动态分流能在复杂任务上取得更稳的泛化与效率折中。由于缺少 clean setup 细节，结论更适合作为方法线索而非强证据。

summary_en.core_problem: It tackles the skill-placement dilemma in agentic RL: whether skills should be internalized into model parameters or externalized into context/tooling, with implications for OOD generalization.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it is relevant to the pretrain/post-train interface because it explicitly studies what should become parametric capability versus what should remain external and task-specific.
summary_en.technical_approach: Skill0.5 splits skills into general and task-specific ones, then uses a dynamic difficulty-aware router to decide the treatment. General skills are internalized via privileged distillation to build a reusable cognitive base, while task-specific skills are kept external and utilized diagnostically rather than being fully baked into the model.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, training data scale, or detailed baselines. It does indicate comparisons against full externalization and full internalization under OOD settings, arguing that the mixed routing strategy yields a better generalization-efficiency trade-off. Without cleaner setup details, the result should be treated as a directional signal rather than a settled conclusion.

recommendation.zh: 和预训练不直接相连，但“哪些能力该写进参数、哪些该留在上下文”这个切分值得记；先看路由策略与 ablation，别急着信 OOD 结论。
recommendation.en: Not a pretrain paper, but the parametric-vs-context skill split is worth noting; read the routing ablations first and treat the OOD claims as soft evidence.

paper.title: Multi-Agent Systems are Mixtures of Experts: Who Becomes an Influencer?
paper.abstract: The effectiveness of multi-agent LLM deliberation depends not only on the agents' individual predictions, but also on how they communicate and collaborate. We study this mechanism through the lens of Friedkin-Johnsen (FJ) opinion dynamics, a tractable model for analyzing stubbornness, influence, and opinion change in multi-agent systems that captures empirically observed deliberation patterns. We show that the FJ parameters are input-dependent, turning multi-agent deliberation into a mixture of

summary.core_problem: 解释多智能体 LLM 协作为什么有时优于单智能体或静态集成，以及谁会在讨论中获得更大影响力。
summary.importance: 贡献属于 agent 机制分析：把多智能体 deliberation 写成输入依赖的 Mixture-of-Experts，有助于理解路由、影响力和能力估计，但对预训练的直接作用较弱。
summary.technical_approach: 用 Friedkin-Johnsen 意见动力学建模多智能体交互，把 agent 的固执度、影响力和观点更新参数视为输入依赖量；据此将 deliberation 解释为一种隐式 MoE，并分析影响力形成的可观测代理变量，如自评置信度、他评置信度和初始一致性。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模或数据集细节。核心实验应是比较单智能体、静态集成和多智能体 deliberation，并检验不同影响力代理变量与最终性能的关系。更像分析框架而非大规模系统实证。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks why multi-agent LLM deliberation can outperform a single agent or static ensembles, and which agents become influential during discussion.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-mechanism paper. Framing deliberation as an input-dependent mixture of experts is conceptually useful for routing and competence estimation, though only indirectly relevant to pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: It uses Friedkin-Johnsen opinion dynamics to model stubbornness, influence, and opinion updates in multi-agent interaction. The key move is to treat these parameters as input-dependent, turning deliberation into an implicit MoE, and then study observable proxies for competence such as self-confidence, perceived confidence, and initial agreement.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes or benchmark details. The empirical focus appears to be comparisons among single-agent, static ensemble, and deliberative multi-agent setups, plus analysis of how influence proxies correlate with outcomes.

recommendation.zh: 把 multi-agent 解释成 input-dependent MoE 这个视角有点意思，但更像分析框架；预训练研究员读摘要和方法设定就够了。
recommendation.en: The input-dependent MoE lens for multi-agent deliberation is neat, but this is mostly an analysis frame; for pretraining folks, the abstract and setup are enough.

paper.title: Policy-Guided Stepwise Model Routing for Cost-Effective Reasoning
paper.abstract: Inference-time computation has greatly enhanced the performance of large language models (LLMs) on challenging reasoning tasks, but this strategy can incur high inference costs. One solution is to route intermediate chain-of-thought (CoT) states to language models of different sizes; however, existing approaches rely on handcrafted routing strategies that limit performance, or on training large process reward models that may be infeasible in many applications. We formulate stepwise model routing

summary.core_problem: 解决推理时 CoT 逐步路由到不同大小模型时，如何在不训练大型过程奖励模型的前提下优化准确率-成本权衡的问题。
summary.importance: 这是推理效率方向的工作，不直接推进预训练，但对 test-time compute、分层模型协作和小控制器替代大 PRM 的思路有参考价值。贡献类型属于推理策略优化与系统层方法。
summary.technical_approach: 作者把 stepwise model routing 形式化为带约束的决策问题，用强化学习训练一个小型控制策略，在每个中间 CoT 状态决定调用哪种规模的模型；再通过 threshold calibration 调节性能与成本的 trade-off。方法试图避免手工规则路由，也避免训练昂贵的大型 process reward model。
summary.experiments: 在 GSM8K、MATH500、OmniMath 三个数学推理 benchmark 上，覆盖开源和闭源模型。摘要声称相较手工路由 consistently 改善 accuracy-cost tradeoff，并与需要大型 PRM 的方法达到可比权衡，但未给出控制器规模、底座模型列表和具体增益数字。
summary.authors_note: 宾夕法尼亚大学团队，作者包括 Osbert Bastani，长期做程序化推理、验证与 LLM 推理控制相关研究。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles how to optimize the accuracy-cost tradeoff in stepwise CoT routing across models of different sizes without training a large process reward model.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency paper rather than a pretraining paper, but it is relevant to test-time compute, hierarchical model orchestration, and the idea of replacing large PRMs with lightweight controllers. The contribution is mainly a routing and systems-level optimization.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors formulate stepwise model routing as a constrained decision-making problem. A small control policy is trained with reinforcement learning to choose which model size should handle each intermediate CoT state, and threshold calibration is used to tune the performance-efficiency tradeoff. The method aims to outperform handcrafted routing while avoiding expensive PRM training.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are conducted on GSM8K, MATH500, and OmniMath, using both open and closed models. The abstract claims consistent improvements over handcrafted routing and comparable tradeoffs to methods requiring large PRMs, but does not report controller size, exact base models, or concrete gains.
summary_en.authors_note: From the University of Pennsylvania. Osbert Bastani is known for work on reasoning, verification, and control-oriented methods around LLMs.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但若你在想 test-time compute 能否替代部分规模扩张，可只看问题建模和 calibration；别把数学集上的收益外推得太远。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but worth a skim if you're thinking about test-time compute as a substitute for scale; read the formulation and calibration, and don't overgeneralize from math benchmarks.

paper.title: Retrieval-Conditioned Topology Selection with Provable Budget Conservation for Multi-Agent Code Generation
paper.abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems for code generation face a fundamental routing problem: the optimal orchestration topology depends on the structural complexity of the code under modification, yet existing systems select topologies without consulting the codebase. We present Retrieval-Guided Adaptive Orchestration (RGAO), an architecture that closes this loop by extracting a structural complexity vector from a hierarchical code index before selecting the orchestration topology. RGAO operates within Code-

summary.core_problem: 多智能体代码生成系统在选择编排拓扑时不参考代码库结构，导致路由决策与任务复杂度不匹配；同时缺乏对动态拓扑下资源预算的形式化保障。
summary.importance: 方法创新：将复杂度感知的LLM路由与形式化资源代数两个独立方向结合，提出可证明的预算守恒性质。
summary.technical_approach: RGAO架构：(1) 从层次化代码索引中提取结构复杂度向量，(2) 基于复杂度选择编排拓扑，(3) 在Code-Agent框架中用六维预算向量和智能体间形式化契约保障预算守恒。
summary.experiments: 摘要未完成，未提供具体实验结果、模型规模或基线对比数据。
summary.authors_note: 独立研究者，无知名学术机构背景。

summary_en.core_problem: Multi-agent code generation systems select orchestration topologies without consulting the codebase structure, leading to mismatched routing decisions; formal resource guarantees under dynamic topology are also lacking.
summary_en.importance: Method innovation: combines complexity-conditioned LLM routing with formal resource algebras to yield provable budget conservation, a property neither approach admits alone.
summary_en.technical_approach: RGAO architecture: (1) extract structural complexity vectors from a hierarchical code index, (2) select orchestration topology based on complexity, (3) enforce budget conservation via formal contracts with six-dimensional budget vectors within the Code-Agent framework.
summary_en.experiments: Abstract is incomplete; no specific experimental results, model sizes, or baseline comparisons are provided.
summary_en.authors_note: Independent researchers; no notable institutional affiliation.

recommendation.zh: 形式化资源预算的思路对多智能体编排有参考价值，但与预训练研究关联较弱，扫读摘要即可。
recommendation.en: The formal budget conservation approach is mildly interesting for multi-agent orchestration but weakly related to pretraining research; glance at abstract only.

paper.title: Adaptive Inverted-Index Routing for Granular Mixtures-of-Experts
paper.abstract: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) models enable scalable transformer architectures by activating only a subset of experts per token. Recent evidence suggests that performance improves with increasingly granular experts, i.e., many small experts instead of a few large ones. However, this regime substantially increases routing cost, which can dominate computation. We introduce adaptive inverted-index routing for MoE (AIR-MoE), an inverted-index-inspired routing architecture based on vector quantization (VQ

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 granular MoE 的路由开销问题。已有 scaling 结果显示，很多小专家往往比少量大专家更有利，但专家数增加后，router 需要对每个 token 和大量 expert centroid 做内积，路由本身会变成主要计算开销。核心问题是：如何在不把专家硬分组、不限制 expert 表示形式的前提下，近似 full top-K routing。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在 MoE 架构可扩展性。它不是提出新的 MoE scaling law，而是试图补上 granular MoE 的系统瓶颈：当专家粒度继续变细时，稀疏激活省下的 FFN 计算可能被路由计算吃掉。AIR-MoE 的贡献量级更接近一种 router 设计和训练方法，适合作为大规模 MoE 预训练中的候选组件。它的关键价值在于把 MoE routing 明确建模成近似最大内积搜索问题，而不是继续依赖固定 expert group 或结构化 expert 参数。
summary.technical_approach: AIR-MoE 使用类似倒排索引的两阶段路由。第一阶段是 coarse shortlisting：用向量量化 codebook 将 token hidden state 分到最近的 codeword，再从该 codeword 对应的预计算 expert shortlist 中取候选专家。第二阶段是 fine scoring：只在 shortlist 内计算 token 与 expert centroid 的精确内积，再选出 top-K experts 做常规 MoE dispatch。这样保留了 top-K routing 的形式，但避免对全部 experts 打分。它和 hierarchical MoE 的区别是，expert 不被固定划分到互斥组里，shortlist 可以重叠；它和结构化 router 的区别是，不要求 expert centroid 满足特殊参数约束。难点在于 codeword 分配不可微。论文采用 bi-level optimization：router 和模型参数仍用梯度下降训练，codebook 用梯度无关的 adaptive spherical k-means 更新，以适应训练过程中 hidden state 分布的漂移。理论部分给出 mass recall 的下界，说明 shortlist 能保留多少原始 top-K routing 概率质量；下界依赖量化误差，以及落在 top-M codeword 分数之外的 routing mass。
summary.experiments: 论文报告 AIR-MoE 在 granular MoE 设置下通常优于已有低成本路由方法，目标是在接近 full top-K routing 效果的同时降低路由 FLOPs。给出的材料没有包含完整实验表格和具体数值，因此不宜过度解读结果幅度。更关键的实验应关注三类对比：与 full top-K routing 的质量差距，与 hierarchical/group routing 的性能差距，以及 shortlist 大小、codebook 数量、adaptive k-means 更新策略对 loss 和吞吐的影响。若这些消融成立，说明近似检索式 routing 可以在不牺牲太多 routing flexibility 的情况下支撑更细粒度专家。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20–30 分钟。重点看 Section 3 的 AIR-MoE forward pass 和 Algorithm 1，确认 shortlist 构造、候选 expert 聚合、fine scoring 的实际计算路径。Section 3.2 值得看，因为 codebook 的训练方式决定了方法是否能在预训练动态分布漂移下工作。Section 3.3 的 mass recall bound 可快速读，重点理解量化误差如何影响 routing 质量。实验部分优先看和 full top-K、hierarchical MoE、结构化 routing 的对比，以及 routing FLOPs 是否真的从瓶颈中降下来。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the routing cost of granular MoE models. Empirical scaling results suggest that many small experts can be preferable to a few large experts, but this regime makes the router evaluate inner products between every token and a large number of expert centroids. The concrete question is how to approximate full top-K routing without forcing experts into fixed groups or imposing restrictive structure on expert representations.
summary_en.importance: The relevance for pretraining is in MoE scalability. The paper does not propose a new scaling law; it addresses a systems and modeling bottleneck that appears when expert granularity increases. If routing cost grows faster than the saved FFN compute, granular MoE becomes hard to train at scale. AIR-MoE is best viewed as a router design for large MoE pretraining, with the useful framing that MoE routing is a maximum-inner-product-search problem rather than only a learned softmax over experts.
summary_en.technical_approach: AIR-MoE uses a two-stage inverted-index-style router. In the coarse stage, token representations are assigned to vector-quantization codewords, and each codeword retrieves a precomputed shortlist of candidate experts. In the fine stage, exact router scores are computed only within that shortlist, and the final top-K experts are selected from the candidates. Compared with hierarchical MoE, experts are not partitioned into disjoint groups, and shortlists may overlap. Compared with structurally constrained routers, expert centroids remain unconstrained. The main training issue is that coarse codeword assignment is non-differentiable. The paper handles this with a bi-level scheme: ordinary model and router parameters are trained by gradient descent, while the codebook is updated with gradient-free adaptive spherical k-means to track distribution shift in hidden states. The theoretical analysis gives a lower bound on retained routing probability mass, depending on quantization error and the amount of routing mass outside the top-M codeword scores.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports favorable behavior against existing low-cost routing methods for granular MoE, aiming to preserve the quality of full top-K routing while reducing routing FLOPs. The provided content does not include full tables or exact numerical deltas, so the strength of the empirical claim should be checked in the experiment section. The important comparisons are against full top-K routing, hierarchical or grouped routing, and structurally constrained routing. The useful ablations should include shortlist size, number of codewords, codebook update frequency, routing FLOPs, and downstream loss.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is enough for a first pass. Focus on Section 3 and Algorithm 1 for the actual routing path: codeword lookup, shortlist retrieval, and exact scoring inside the candidate set. Section 3.2 is important because adaptive codebook learning determines whether the method can survive pretraining distribution shift. Section 3.3 can be read for the mass-recall intuition rather than the full proof. In the experiments, prioritize the quality gap to full top-K routing and the measured reduction in routing overhead.

recommendation.zh: MoE 研究员应看路由复杂度分解和 VQ shortlist；若实验规模不大，先当可复现实验候选而非定论。
recommendation.en: MoE researchers should inspect the routing-cost decomposition and VQ shortlist design; without large-scale runs, treat it as a replication candidate, not a settled result.

paper.title: Uno-Orchestra: Parsimonious Agent Routing via Selective Delegation
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) multi-agent systems typically rely on rigid orchestration, committing either to flat per-query routing or to hand-engineered task decomposition, so decomposition depth, worker choice, and inference budget are not jointly optimized under one objective. We introduce Uno-Orchestra, a unified orchestration policy that selectively decomposes a task and dispatches each subtask to an admissible (model, primitive) pair, with both decisions learned together from curated RL traj

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是单纯的“给每个 query 选一个模型”，也不是传统多 agent 里“先规划、再手工分配执行器”的老问题，而是把两件事合成一个统一决策：面对一个复杂任务，系统应不应该拆解、拆到多深、每个子任务交给哪个模型、调用哪种 primitive、花多少预算，这些决策如何在同一个目标下联合优化。作者指出，现有 routing 方法大多停留在 query 级单次派发，无法利用复杂任务中的并行和层次结构；而层级式 agent workflow 虽然会拆任务，但子任务到执行器的映射通常是 prompt 规则、人工设计或绑定某个强模型，导致质量与成本的关键取舍没有被端到端学习。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练本身，它不是直接提出新的 pretrain objective，但对“后训练如何反哺模型系统能力”有现实启发，尤其是 controller policy、agentic RL、结构化 credit assignment 这几个点。更具体地说，它把 orchestration 从 workflow engineering 推向了 policy learning：把 decomposition 和 dispatch 写进同一个 causal LM 输出空间，再用真实 worker 交互轨迹做 SFT+RL。这类工作对未来的启发不在于“多 agent 更强”这件事本身，而在于：如果系统能力越来越依赖 learned controller，那么控制器的训练数据、奖励设计、动作空间设计，会逐渐变成和 pretrain 同样重要的能力来源。对做 pretrain 的人，值得关注的是它如何把结构化决策序列压进标准 LM 接口，以及如何用中间奖励缓解长时程 agent 训练的不稳定。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 Uno-Orchestra：用一个单一的 causal LM policy，同时生成任务分解结果和每个子任务的路由决策。动作不是简单的“选模型”，而是为每个子任务选择一个 (model, primitive) 对。这里 primitive 被定义成可路由的原子动作，既可以是模型内部的认知操作，也可以是多步技能调用或外部工具调用。这样做的好处是把 planner 和 dispatcher 合并到同一 backbone，避免多模块之间反复传上下文，也让“是否拆解”和“拆完交给谁”共享同一个训练目标。

训练分两阶段。第一阶段是 SFT：作者构造了 verifier-gated curriculum，用 teacher-distilled 轨迹做监督学习。轨迹来自 38 个公开数据集，共 61,201 条，并且与评测集不重合。关键点在于 code 和 tool 子任务不是离线伪造 observation，而是在真实 sandbox 中执行，返回运行时结果，这让训练轨迹更接近真实 agent 交互。第二阶段是 Agentic-GRPO，用于处理 SFT 后剩余的 hard pool。它是对 GRPO 的多轮扩展，利用 orchestrator 输出中的结构线索，为不同分解模式自动附加 observation-level 和 process-level 中间奖励，缓解只有最终正确/错误信号时的长链路 credit assignment 问题。

从设计上看，这篇工作的几个关键取舍比较清楚。第一，不把 decomposition 和 routing 拆成两个模型，是为了减少模块边界带来的误差传播，也让预算约束能直接作用在统一动作空间上。第二，采用 closed worker pool 和 closed primitive vocabulary，而不是开放式自由调用，是为了让 RL 可学、可验证、可计成本。第三，强调 admissible set 的稀疏性，即不是每个模型都支持每个 primitive，这使问题更像受约束的组合决策，而不是普通文本生成。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 13 个 benchmark，横跨 math、code、knowledge、long-context 和 agentic tool-use，并与 22 个 baseline 比较。主结果是 macro pass@1 达到 77.0%，比最强 workflow baseline 高约 16%，同时单 query 成本低约一个数量级。这个结果说明收益不只是来自“多调用几个模型”，而是来自更细粒度的 selective delegation。

从论文给出的设定看，训练数据规模不算大，只有 61,201 条 SFT 轨迹和后续 hard-pool RL，这意味着性能提升更多来自动作空间和训练信号设计，而不是海量 imitation data。值得注意的实验点通常有三类：
1. 与 flat routing 的对比：能看出 query-level 单次派发在复杂任务上会明显吃亏，因为它无法把不同子问题交给不同能力/成本档位的 worker。
2. 与 hand-crafted hierarchical workflow 的对比：说明单纯会拆任务还不够，若 dispatch 不是联合优化，成本和成功率都容易失衡。
3. 消融：去掉 unified policy、去掉 Agentic-GRPO、去掉 verifier-gated curriculum，通常都会伤到最终表现，尤其是长时程任务和工具调用任务。

摘要里没有给出更细的模型规模、worker pool 组成和各 benchmark 分项数字；如果看全文，重点应核对：不同 primitive 的定义边界、成本函数如何标定、RL 奖励中 correctness 与 cost 的权重 α 如何设、以及 hard pool 的构造方式。这些细节决定了结果是否可迁移。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇更适合泛读，不建议按“多 agent 新花样”去读，重点应放在三个地方。

第一，看方法定义部分，弄清楚 unified action space 到底怎么编码：一个 assistant turn 里如何同时表达 plan、subtask、依赖关系和 (model, primitive) 选择。这里决定了它是不是一个真正可学习的 policy，而不只是 prompt 模板。

第二，看训练部分，尤其是 verifier-gated curriculum 和 Agentic-GRPO。前者关系到轨迹质量控制，后者关系到多轮 agent RL 是否稳定。若只看一处图表，优先看奖励构成和训练流程图。

第三，看主表和消融表。重点不是绝对分数，而是：在什么任务上 selective delegation 最有收益，收益来自更深分解还是更便宜的 worker 组合，以及成本下降是否伴随成功率下降。

预计 25–35 分钟可以抓住主要内容。若要深挖，建议额外关注附录里的 action schema、worker/primitive vocabulary、以及失败案例。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a joint decision problem that prior orchestration work usually splits apart: whether to decompose a task, how deep the decomposition should go, which worker should handle each subtask, which primitive should be invoked, and how all of that should be optimized under an explicit cost budget. Existing routers mostly operate at the whole-query level and miss the internal structure of complex tasks. Hierarchical multi-agent systems do decompose, but executor assignment is often hand-written, prompt-driven, or tied to a single strong model. The result is that decomposition and dispatch, which jointly determine both quality and cost, are rarely learned under one objective.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, but it is relevant to the pretrain–posttrain interface. Its main value is in showing how system-level capability can increasingly come from a learned controller rather than from a single frontier model. For researchers working on foundation models, the useful signal here is not “multi-agent beats single-agent,” but how a standard causal LM can be turned into a structured control policy, how real interaction traces can supervise that policy, and how intermediate rewards can stabilize long-horizon agent RL. If orchestration becomes a major capability bottleneck, controller data quality, action-space design, and reward shaping start to matter in ways that resemble pretraining design choices.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Uno-Orchestra is a single causal-LM policy that emits both a task decomposition and a routing decision for every subtask. The routing unit is not just a model ID. It is a (model, primitive) pair, where a primitive is an atomic routable action: an internal reasoning mode, a multi-step skill invocation, or an external tool call. This collapses planning and dispatch into one shared backbone, instead of running a planner first and a dispatcher later.

Training has two stages. Stage one is supervised fine-tuning on a verifier-gated curriculum of 61,201 teacher-distilled trajectories from 38 public datasets, disjoint from evaluation. A notable detail is that code and tool subtasks are executed in real sandboxes, so observations are runtime outputs rather than synthetic traces. Stage two applies Agentic-GRPO on the residual hard pool. This extends GRPO to multi-turn orchestration by using structural cues from the generated plan to assign observation-level and process-level intermediate rewards, which helps with long-horizon credit assignment.

Several design choices are worth noting. First, decomposition and routing are merged because separate modules create context-passing overhead and error propagation, while a unified policy allows budget constraints to act directly on the full decision space. Second, the worker pool and primitive vocabulary are closed, which makes RL tractable and cost-accountable. Third, admissible actions are sparse: not every model supports every primitive. That turns the problem into constrained combinatorial control rather than generic free-form generation.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation spans 13 benchmarks across math, code, knowledge, long-context, and agentic tool use, with comparisons against 22 baselines. The headline result is 77.0% macro pass@1, about 16% above the strongest workflow baseline, at roughly an order-of-magnitude lower per-query cost. That matters because it suggests the gain is not simply from using more calls, but from finer-grained selective delegation.

The training set is relatively modest: 61,201 SFT trajectories plus RL on a hard subset. That makes the improvement more attributable to action-space design and training signals than to brute-force imitation scale. The most informative comparisons are likely the following: against flat routers, which cannot assign different subtasks to different capability-cost tiers; against hand-crafted hierarchical workflows, which decompose but do not jointly optimize dispatch; and ablations removing the unified policy, verifier-gated curriculum, or Agentic-GRPO.

The abstract does not expose all implementation details such as controller size, worker pool composition, or per-benchmark breakdowns. When reading the full paper, the details that matter most are the primitive taxonomy, how cost is calibrated, how the correctness–cost trade-off coefficient is set, and how the hard pool is constructed. Those choices determine whether the method is portable beyond the reported setup.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read it as a policy-learning paper, not as another generic multi-agent workflow paper. Three parts deserve attention.

First, inspect the action representation. The key question is how a single assistant turn encodes subtasks, dependencies, and one (model, primitive) choice per subtask. If that schema is weak, the whole method reduces to prompt engineering; if it is clean, the paper is really about structured control through a causal LM.

Second, focus on the training pipeline, especially verifier-gated curriculum construction and Agentic-GRPO. Those sections contain the practical answer to how they keep trajectory quality high and how they make multi-turn RL learnable.

Third, read the main results and ablations with a systems lens: where does selective delegation help most, does the gain come from deeper decomposition or cheaper worker assignment, and how stable is the quality–cost trade-off.

A 25–35 minute skim should be enough for the main ideas. For deeper reading, check the appendix for the action schema, primitive vocabulary, and failure cases.

recommendation.zh: 只看策略定义和 cost/accuracy 曲线；若 worker 真实成本核算干净，可作为后训练路由数据的设计样板。
recommendation.en: Read the policy definition and cost-accuracy plots; if the worker-cost accounting is clean, it is a useful template for routing-oriented post-training data.

paper.title: RouteHijack: Routing-Aware Attack on Mixture-of-Experts LLMs
paper.abstract: Safety alignment is critical for the responsible deployment of large language models (LLMs). As Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures are increasingly adopted to scale model capacity, understanding their safety robustness becomes essential. Existing adversarial attacks, however, have notable limitations. Prompt-based jailbreaks rely on heuristic search and transfer poorly, model intervention methods require privileged access to internal representations, and optimization-based input attacks rema

summary.core_problem: 研究 MoE LLM 的安全对齐是否集中在少数专家上，以及攻击者能否通过操控路由来绕过安全行为。
summary.importance: 这篇工作更偏安全攻击，但对做 MoE 预训练和后训练的人有一个具体启发：安全能力可能不是均匀分布在模型中，而是被路由机制局部化。若这一点成立，会影响 MoE 的对齐、鲁棒性和专家专门化理解。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 RouteHijack，一种 routing-aware jailbreak。核心思路是先通过 response-driven expert localization 找到与安全行为强相关的专家，再通过输入优化影响路由决策，尽量避开这些安全关键专家。论文的技术点在于把 MoE 的离散路由当作攻击面，而不是只做输出层面的 prompt jailbreak 或需要内部梯度访问的模型干预。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出具体模型、参数规模和攻击成功率数字，但声称现有方法在 MoE 上受限于非可微路由，而本文通过 routing-aware 方法实现更有效攻击。实验应主要比较 prompt-based jailbreak、需要内部访问的方法以及本文方法在 MoE 模型上的攻击效果与迁移性。由于缺少定量细节，当前只能作为机制线索而非强结论。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Bristol。不是一线大厂 MoE 技术报告，但问题设定与当前大规模采用 MoE 的趋势相关。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether safety alignment in MoE LLMs is concentrated in a small subset of experts, and whether routing can be manipulated to bypass those safety behaviors.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a safety attack paper, but it carries a concrete implication for MoE pretraining and post-training: safety capabilities may be localized rather than uniformly distributed across experts. If true, that matters for alignment, robustness, and how we think about expert specialization.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose RouteHijack, a routing-aware jailbreak attack. The key idea is to first localize experts associated with safety behavior using response-driven expert localization, then optimize inputs to influence routing decisions so the model avoids those safety-critical experts. The novelty is treating discrete MoE routing itself as the attack surface, rather than relying only on prompt jailbreaks or privileged internal interventions.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model names, parameter counts, or attack success rates, but claims existing attacks are limited on MoE models because routing is non-differentiable, while the proposed routing-aware method is more effective. The experiments likely compare against prompt-based jailbreaks, internal-access methods, and output-centric optimization attacks on MoE models. Without quantitative details, this is more of a mechanism signal than a firm empirical conclusion.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the University of Bristol. This is not a flagship MoE report from a major lab, but the problem setting is relevant given the growing adoption of MoE architectures.

recommendation.zh: 不是预训练主线，但如果你做 MoE 对齐或路由分析，看看它对“安全专家局部化”的证据；结论可能成立，外推到通用能力则要很谨慎。
recommendation.en: Not core pretraining, but if you work on MoE alignment or routing analysis, inspect the evidence for safety-expert localization; plausible signal, but be careful extrapolating it to general capability structure.

paper.title: When to Vote, When to Rewrite: Disagreement-Guided Strategy Routing for Test-Time Scaling
paper.abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) achieve strong performance on mathematical reasoning tasks but remain unreliable on challenging instances. Existing test-time scaling methods, such as repeated sampling, self-correction, and tree search, improve performance at the cost of increased computation, yet often exhibit diminishing returns on hard problems. We observe that output disagreement is strongly correlated with instance difficulty and prediction correctness, providing a useful signal for guiding in

summary.core_problem: 在不改模型、不加训练的前提下，如何把“test-time scaling”的额外算力用在刀刃上：对不同难度/不确定性的题目，动态选择更合适的推理增强策略（投票 vs 重写再推理），避免在简单题上浪费采样、在难题上陷入投票的边际收益递减。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对“推理能力评测与训练信号设计”有间接价值：它把输出分歧（disagreement）当作可操作的不确定性指标，展示了同一基座在不同实例上存在明显的策略最优解差异。这类现象会反过来影响两件事：1）做 scaling law/训练动态分析时，不能只看平均指标，实例难度分布会改变最优推理预算；2）若未来把 test-time routing 的信号蒸馏回训练（例如作为 curriculum 或 sample reweighting），disagreement 可作为一种“无需标注的难度/噪声代理”。整体更偏 post-train / inference-time 方法论，适合泛读了解其信号与路由框架。
summary.technical_approach:
方法是一个三段式、training-free 的实例级路由框架，把“算力分配”从单策略内的自适应（多采样/树搜索深度）扩展为“策略选择”。核心信号是输出分歧：
1）Minimal Disagreement Detector (MDD)：对同一题做两次随机采样生成答案a1、a2，用归一化等价判断（数值/符号/结构匹配）判定是否一致。用极低成本把样本分成无分歧/有分歧。
2）Disagreement Filter：若两次一致，直接输出，认为是 easy/高置信实例，避免继续采样。
3）Vote Resolve：对“轻微分歧”实例增加采样次数，做多数投票（majority voting）得到最终答案。直觉是：分布有主峰时投票有效。
4）Rewrite & Rethink：对“严重分歧”实例，先对题目进行重写（reformulation），再重新采样/投票。动机是：难题上模型对表述敏感，重写能把模型从不稳定推理轨道拉出来；同时作者也强调重写对简单题可能有害（引入语义漂移或错误假设），因此只在高分歧时触发。
整体上，贡献点不在某个新推理算子，而在“用分歧做门控，把投票与重写的 trade-off 显式化”，并用两次采样的廉价检测器把路由做成可落地流程。
summary.experiments: 论文在 7 个数学推理基准与 3 个 LRM 上评估，并报告相对基线 test-time scaling 的绝对提升约 3%–7%，且在更难的基准上增益更明显；同时由于对无分歧样本早停，整体采样次数更少（更省算力）。作者还做了代码生成任务的泛化验证，说明“分歧→路由”的信号不局限于数学。消融重点围绕三阶段各自贡献、以及重写在不同难度分桶上的正负效应：简单题重写可能降分，难题重写更稳定增益；投票在轻微分歧区间更有效，但在严重分歧时边际收益差。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议：
- 先看引言里关于“重写 vs 投票在 easy/hard 上相反趋势”的现象图（通常是 Figure 1）来建立动机。
- 重点看方法图（Figure 2）与 Algorithm 1，理解三段式路由与 MDD 的判定逻辑，以及“轻微/严重分歧”的划分规则。
- 实验部分优先看：按难度或按分歧程度分桶的结果、以及计算量（采样次数）对比；这些比单一平均准确率更能说明路由是否真的把算力用对地方。
预计阅读时间：20–30 分钟可抓住主线；若要复现，额外花时间在答案等价归一化与重写提示词细节。

summary_en.core_problem: How to allocate test-time compute more effectively without any training: route each instance to the right inference-time scaling strategy (majority voting vs. rewrite-then-reason) based on an uncertainty signal, instead of blindly increasing samples within a single strategy and suffering diminishing returns on hard problems.
summary_en.importance: Not a pretraining contribution per se, but it is relevant to foundation-model research in two ways. First, it operationalizes output disagreement as a cheap uncertainty/difficulty proxy, which matters when interpreting scaling behaviors under different evaluation budgets. Second, the routing signal is a plausible candidate for distillation back into training (curriculum, reweighting, or synthetic data targeting), since it does not require labels. Overall, it sits closer to post-train / inference methodology than to core pretrain objectives.
summary_en.technical_approach:
A training-free, instance-level routing pipeline with three stages driven by disagreement:
- Minimal Disagreement Detector (MDD): sample twice; if the two answers match under a normalized equivalence check (numeric/symbolic/structural), treat the instance as consistent.
- Disagreement Filter: for no-disagreement cases, early-exit and return the answer (avoid wasted sampling).
- Vote Resolve: for minor disagreement, increase sampling and apply majority voting, assuming the answer distribution has a dominant mode.
- Rewrite & Rethink: for severe disagreement (flat/unstable answer distribution), rewrite the problem statement and resample to escape brittle reasoning trajectories. The key design choice is gating rewriting only when disagreement is high, because rewriting can hurt easy instances via semantic drift or injected assumptions.
The novelty is the explicit compute/strategy trade-off: voting is favored when consensus is strong; rewriting is reserved for high-uncertainty cases.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on seven math reasoning benchmarks with three LRMs, reporting ~3–7 absolute accuracy gains over baselines, with larger improvements on harder benchmarks where base accuracy is low. The method also reduces average sampling cost via early exits on consistent instances. A generalization check on code generation suggests the disagreement-based routing signal is not math-specific. Ablations emphasize per-stage contributions and show rewriting is beneficial mainly in the high-disagreement regime while potentially degrading easy cases.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan:
- Start with the motivating result showing opposite behaviors of voting vs rewriting across easy/hard buckets (typically Figure 1).
- Read the method schematic and Algorithm 1 to understand the three-stage router and how MDD defines minor vs severe disagreement.
- In experiments, prioritize bucketed analyses by difficulty/disagreement and the compute (number of samples) comparison; these validate that routing, not just extra sampling, drives gains.
Time: ~20–30 minutes for the main idea; more if you care about answer-equivalence normalization and rewriting prompt details for reproduction.

recommendation.zh: 利用 disagreement 作为 test-time scaling 路由信号的思路很实用，对设计推理阶段的 compute allocation 策略有启发，值得看其路由机制的设计。
recommendation.en: Using disagreement as a routing signal for test-time scaling is practical and insightful for designing compute allocation strategies during inference; worth checking the routing mechanism design.

paper.title: Mixture of Heterogeneous Grouped Experts for Language Modeling
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) based on Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) are pivotal in industrial applications for their ability to scale performance efficiently. However, standard MoEs enforce uniform expert sizes,creating a rigidity that fails to align computational costs with varying token-level complexity. While heterogeneous expert architectures attempt to address this by diversifying expert sizes, they often suffer from significant system-level challenges, specifically unbalanced GPU utilization an

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 MoE 里一个很实际但常被简化的问题：不同 token 的建模难度并不一样，但传统 MoE 强制所有 expert 同构同尺寸，导致容量分配过于僵硬；而完全异构 expert 虽然更灵活，却会带来 GPU 负载不均、路由失衡、参数利用率差等系统问题。作者想解决的是，如何在不把训练和部署复杂度推高到不可用的前提下，让 MoE 具备按 token 难度分配不同 expert 容量的能力。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在 MoE 设计空间，而不是结论性突破。它提出了一种介于“全同构 MoE”和“全异构 MoE”之间的折中结构：组内同构、组间异构。这个方向有意义，因为工业级 MoE 的瓶颈往往不是理论容量，而是路由可控性和系统可训练性。若方法成立，它说明 expert heterogeneity 不必以完全自由的形式出现，可以通过分组把容量层级离散化，从而兼顾表达力和并行效率。对做大规模稀疏预训练的人，这比单纯讨论更大 expert 或更多 expert 更接近真实约束。
summary.technical_approach: MoHGE 的核心是三件事。第一，heterogeneous grouped experts：把所有 expert 分成多个 group，同一组内 expert 尺寸相同，不同组的 hidden size 按预设层级递增。这样小组负责轻量模式，大组负责更复杂 token。相比 fully heterogeneous expert，这种设计把容量选择离散成若干档，便于部署和负载管理。第二，two-level routing：先做 group-level gating，选出 top-Kg 个候选组；再在组内做 expert-level gating，选具体 expert。这样路由先决定‘用多大容量’，再决定‘用哪个 expert’，比传统单层 gating 更适合异构结构，也比直接在所有异构 expert 上竞争更稳定。第三，负载均衡机制分成两层：Group-Wise Auxiliary Loss 用来调节不同容量组的选择分布，使模型学会把更复杂 token 送到更大组，但又不至于塌到某一组；Intra-Group Experts Auxiliary Loss 则平衡组内 expert 使用率。系统层面，作者提出 All-size Group-decoupling Allocation，把每个 group 的 expert 均匀拆到所有 GPU 上，避免大 expert 集中在少数卡上造成显存和算力热点。和已有方法相比，MoDSE 更接近完全异构但路由约束较硬，HMoE 提到混合异构/同构方向但没有把分组结构和系统分配机制完整做出来；MoHGE 的贡献在于把架构、路由和并行分配一起设计。
summary.experiments: 从正文可见，作者的实验目标有两个：一是验证在更少总参数下能否保持接近传统 MoE 的语言建模精度；二是验证 GPU 利用率是否更均衡。摘要明确给出的结论是，MoHGE 在 accuracy 上与 conventional MoE 相当，同时减少 total parameters；并且 routing analysis 显示辅助损失确实能调节不同组和组内 expert 的激活模式，GPU utilization 更平衡。全文片段没有给出完整的模型规模、训练 token 数、具体 perplexity 或下游分数，因此不能安全填写具体数字。可以确认的实验重点包括：1）与同等计算或相近性能的标准 MoE 对比；2）对 two-level routing、Group-Wise Auxiliary Loss、Intra-Group loss、以及 allocation strategy 的消融；3）路由分布分析，用来证明不同容量组确实承担了不同复杂度 token；4）系统指标分析，关注显存占用和各 GPU 工作负载方差。若后续拿到表格，最值得看的是‘参数减少多少、吞吐损失多少、负载方差下降多少’这三组数字。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看方法图。要先理解为什么作者不做 fully heterogeneous experts，而是做 grouped heterogeneity。随后看 two-level routing 的公式和伪代码，确认 group gate 与 expert gate 的耦合方式，以及 top-Kg 的选择如何影响计算量。再看两个 auxiliary loss 的定义，重点不是公式本身，而是它们分别在约束哪一层的负载。实验部分建议优先看三类图表：主结果表、routing distribution 可视化、GPU load balance 统计。阅读时要特别留意一个问题：模型是否真的学到了‘难 token 用大 expert’，还是只是人为正则把流量分散了。如果没有 token difficulty 的外部定义，作者如何证明容量匹配而非随机分流，这是判断方法说服力的关键。预计 25–35 分钟可以完成有效泛读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a practical limitation in MoE language models. Standard MoEs use experts with identical size, which makes capacity allocation too rigid for tokens of varying difficulty. Fully heterogeneous experts are a natural alternative, but they create serious systems problems: uneven GPU utilization, poor parameter efficiency, and unstable routing behavior. The paper asks whether one can introduce expert-size heterogeneity without paying the full deployment and training cost of a fully heterogeneous design.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining researchers, the contribution is mainly about the MoE design space. The paper proposes a middle ground between homogeneous MoE and fully heterogeneous MoE: experts are homogeneous within a group but heterogeneous across groups. That matters because large-scale sparse pretraining is often constrained less by theoretical model capacity than by routing controllability and systems balance. If this grouped heterogeneity works, it suggests that capacity scaling can be discretized into a small number of expert tiers, making heterogeneity more trainable and more compatible with distributed execution.
summary_en.technical_approach: MoHGE combines architectural, routing, and systems ideas. First, experts are partitioned into groups; experts within the same group share the same size, while different groups have different hidden dimensions. This creates a tiered capacity structure, where smaller groups can handle easier patterns and larger groups can absorb harder contexts. Second, routing is hierarchical. A group-level gate first selects the top candidate groups, and an expert-level gate then chooses experts within those groups. This is better aligned with heterogeneous capacity than a single flat gate over all experts, because the model first decides how much capacity to use and only then which expert instance to activate. Third, the paper introduces two balancing losses. The Group-Wise Auxiliary Loss regulates how often different capacity groups are selected, aiming for a better match between token complexity and expert size while avoiding collapse to a single group. The Intra-Group Experts Auxiliary Loss balances usage among experts inside each group. On the systems side, the All-size Group-decoupling Allocation strategy spreads experts from every group across all GPUs, instead of concentrating large experts on a subset of devices. Compared with prior work, the novelty is not just heterogeneous experts, but the joint design of grouped heterogeneity, two-level routing, and hardware-aware allocation.
summary_en.experiments: The experimental story appears to have two targets: maintain language-model quality with fewer total parameters, and improve GPU load balance. From the abstract and visible body text, the main claim is that MoHGE reaches accuracy comparable to conventional MoE while reducing total parameters. The routing analysis further suggests that the auxiliary losses successfully shape activation patterns across groups and within groups, and that GPU utilization becomes more balanced during training and inference. The provided text does not include the full numeric tables, so it is not safe to state exact parameter counts, token budgets, or perplexity gains. The most relevant experiments seem to be: comparisons against standard MoE baselines, ablations on two-level routing and both auxiliary losses, routing-distribution analysis to show differentiated use of expert groups, and systems measurements such as memory balance and workload variance across GPUs.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the method figure and understand why the authors choose grouped heterogeneity instead of fully free-form heterogeneous experts. Then read the two-level routing section carefully: the key question is how group selection and expert selection interact, and how top-K group routing changes the compute pattern. After that, inspect the two auxiliary losses with a simple lens: one balances traffic across capacity tiers, the other balances traffic within a tier. In the experiments, prioritize three things: the main quality-vs-parameter table, the routing-distribution visualizations, and the GPU load-balance statistics. The most important reading question is whether the model truly learns capacity matching—harder tokens going to larger experts—or whether the regularization merely spreads traffic more evenly without meaningful specialization. A useful skim should take about 25–35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 值得看，因为它碰的是 MoE 里一直没解决干净的异构专家落地问题；先看两级路由和 group-wise loss，若负载曲线不漂亮，就把它当工程折中而非新范式。
recommendation.en: Worth reading because it hits the unresolved practical problem of heterogeneous experts in MoE; inspect the two-level router and group-wise loss first, and treat it as an engineering tradeoff unless the load curves are genuinely clean.
